Cracked LCD screen

The 4.7-inch LCD IPS Retina display cracks on drops. LCD-specific damage — white backlight bleed, colour banding, and unresponsive touch areas — require full assembly replacement. iPhone 7 screen replacement

data.title: Wifi Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone XS MAX has a new wireless firmware that can support up to 7GHz of wireless bandwidth speed. This gives the users unmatched speed in comparison to most of the smartphones in the market. However, there have been issues regarding the Wi-Fi of the iPhone XS MAX. And frankly, some users have taken issue with the phone saying that the phone disconnects from the wireless network frequently and without any warning.

Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most common reported iPhone XS MAX Wi-Fi issues are…

  • Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone XS MAX.
  • Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver.
  • Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi.
  • High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections
  • iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi
  • iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection.

These Wi-Fi issues found on iPhone XS MAX are pretty common issues found on other wireless supported devices too! And does not necessarily indicate that there is something specifically wrong with your iPhone XS MAX’s wireless hardware.

There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

  • Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issues have been resolved.
  • Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again.
  • Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection.
  • Restore the default network connection

( Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)

  • Update your iOS to the latest version available.

If none of the solutions mentioned above works to resolve your Wi-Fi issues on your iPhone XS MAX, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. data.title: Temperature High Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 13 comes with a generally better and more efficient better processor and battery than the iPhone X series. However, users have said that the phone tends to get hotter than the previous iPhones Apple has released. The new iPhone 13 comes with a special thermal compound in the back area of the phone which helps to omit heat faster and more efficiently than previous iPhones. It may make your iPhone seem a lot hotter than the previous iPhones.

However, that doesn’t make the iPhone 13 so warm that the users find it difficult to hold it down with their hands. This is a clear indication of overheating in the iPhone 13 . Some similar cases of overheating include:

Phone gets way too hot while charging and takes a long time to be fully charged

The phone gets hot and the battery drains drastically

You might see a notification that will say “Temperature high”

The iPhone gets warm in standby mode for no apparent reason whatsoever

(Note: if your phone gets too hot while transferring data for the first time from a previous iPhone, chances are it’s a one-time issue and will not happen again.)

These are some of the most discussed problems in Apple’s user threads and community. However, there are some DIY (Do it Yourself) fixes that you may try which may help you to resolve your overheating issues.

Disable background app refresh.

Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh

Turn off Bluetooth / Location services to reduce processes running in the background

Most of the users have reported that they are getting the heating issue in the latest iOS version, In that case

try updating your iOS to later versions to check if it works for your phone.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone 13 heating issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving your iPhone 13 issues on your phone. ifixit bd is located in four different service points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Temperature High Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 12 comes with a generally better and more efficient better processor and battery than the iPhone X series. Although, the users have said that the phone tends to get hotter than the previous iPhones Apple has released. The new iPhone 12 comes with a special thermal compound in the back area of the phone which helps to omit heat faster and more efficiently than the previous iPhones. It may make your iPhone seem a lot hotter than the previous iPhones.

However, that doesn’t make the iPhone 12 so warm that the users find it difficult to hold it down with their hands. This is a clear indication of overheating in the iPhone 12. Some similar cases of overheating include.

Phone gets way too hot while charging and takes a long time to be fully charged

Phone gets hot and the battery drains drastically

You might see a notification that will say “Temperature high”

The iPhone gets warm on standby mode for no apparent reason whatsoever

(Note: if your phone gets too hot while transferring data for the first time from a previous iPhone, chances are it’s a one-time issue and will not happen again.)

These are some of the most discussed problems in Apple’s user threads and community. However, there are some DIY (Do it Yourself) fixes that you may try which may help you to resolve your overheating issues.

Disable background app refresh.

Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh

Turn off Bluetooth / Location services to reduce processes running in the background

Most of the users have reported they get the heating issue in the latest iOS version, In that case

try updating your iOS to later versions to check if it works for your phone.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone 12 heating issues. data.title: Rear Camera Replacement
data.description:
Even with such an amazing camera, it has been found that some users have found some issues regarding the camera. The most common issues regarding the rear camera of the iPhone 13 found in the Apple support forum and on the internet are

  • Black display when the camera turns on/nothing shows on the camera
  • The LED flash is not working.
  • Photos seem too noisy/grainy.
  • The camera or iPhone freezes while zooming in.
  • The camera freezes/shows a black screen after an iOS update.
  • Blurry, unclear photos
  • Out-of-sync flash. This is a problem where a user wants to take a photo with the flash, but the flash gets triggered after the photo has been taken.

These are the most common issues that are often reported by users in Apple service centers and user forums. However, there are some DIY (do it yourself) fixes available that work as a remedy for these issues. If you are facing any of the above-mentioned problems, try doing so.

  • Remove any protective cases for your phone. Especially metallic or magnetic cases, which may hamper the proper functioning of your phone’s camera
  • Try restarting your phone.
  • Try cleaning your lenses with a microfiber cloth. Be careful not to scratch it.
  • If your camera flash isn’t working, try turning on the flash from the control center and see if it works.
  • Try disabling VoiceOver settings for your iPhone. From Settings > General > Accessibility > Turn off VoiceOver.
  • Try switching between camera lenses in settings.
  • You can also try resetting your previous settings.

If none of the solutions work for you, you might need to get your iPhone looked at by professionals. data.description:
The new iPhone 15 Pro Max has ensured maximum safety and precaution to reduce user-end damage on display. The iPhone 15 Pro Max has a specially made gorilla glass by corning in front with an oleophobic coating. Which means that it is oil and sweat-resistant. Apple claims it is one of the toughest displays of the market. However, accidents happen. An accident that may lead to cracking or damaging the front glass of your display calls for repairing the phone.

Now after you accidentally drop your iPhone you should check the following to see if there’s any significant damage. See that if:

The Touches works and gives back the proper response

Has no colored lines or off-color spots anywhere in the display

Has no dead pixel (no black dots in the display)

You should look forward to replacing your iPhone 15 Pro Max display if

The phone has visible cracks but the touch still works

The fall which damaged the front glass of the iPhone 15 Pro Max doesn’t damage any other functions such as camera, speaker, or proximity sensor

data.title: Face ID Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 comes with a distinct feature named Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. This feature was made available from the iPhone X models and the later Apple A12x Bionic chipsets. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided with the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

Face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature.

  • Face not recognized
  • Face ID is not available at the moment
  • Move the camera a bit lower/higher
  • Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me into Passcode and not Face ID

These common issues however have some home remedies which may work for your iPhone. These fix attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

  • Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode
  • if you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way.
  • Make sure you face the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing between your face and camera region.
  • Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy.
  • Update your iOS to the latest version.

If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID instead prompts with a passcode. The reasons may be:

  • User might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone.
  • The user may have just restarted the device.
  • The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours.
  • The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days.
  • The device has not been unlocked by face ID in the last 4 hours.
  • The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from safe space.
  • If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts.
  • If at Face ID set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all

If your iPhone 11 Face ID problems can’t be categorized and sorted by the above-mentioned issues and fixes, you may just need to take it to an extremely diligent iPhone technician to deal with Face ID issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in issues regarding your iPhone 11. ifixit bd is located in four different locations across Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.description:
The new iPhone 15 Pro Max comes with a distinct feature named Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. This feature was made available from the iPhone X models and the later Apple A12x Bionic chipsets. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided with the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

Face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature.

Face not recognized

Face ID is not available at the moment

Move the camera a bit lower/higher

Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me into Passcode and not Face ID

These common issues however have some home remedies which may work for your iPhone. These fix attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode

if you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way

Make sure you face the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing between your face and camera region

Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy

Update your iOS to the latest version

If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID instead prompt with a passcode. The reasons may be:

User might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone

The user may have just restarted the device

The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours

The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days

The device has not been unlocked by face ID in the last 4 hours

The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from a safe space

If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts

If at Face ID set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all

then:

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water. However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:

Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth

You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there.

Never charge your phone until you have made sure it is completely dry

If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth. If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers. The new iPhone 12 Pro has a new wireless firmware that can support up to 7GHz of wireless bandwidth speed. This gives the users unmatched speed in comparison to most of the smartphones in the market. However, there have been issues regarding the Wi-Fi of the iPhone 12 Pro. And frankly, some users have taken issue with the phone saying that the phone disconnects from the wireless network frequently and without any warning.

Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone 12 Pro

Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver

Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi

High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections

iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi

iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection

These Wi-Fi issues found on iPhone 12 Pro are pretty common issues found on other wireless supported devices too! And does not necessarily indicate that there is something specifically wrong with your iPhone 12 Pro’s wireless hardware. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issues have been resolved

Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again

Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection

Restore the default network connection

( Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)

Update your iOS to the latest version available

If none of the solutions mentioned above works to resolve your Wi-Fi issues on your iPhone 12 Pro, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. data.description:
The new iPhone XS MAX comes with a special thermal compound in the back area of the phone which helps to omit heat faster and more efficiently than the previous iPhones. It may make your iPhone seem a lot hotter than the previous iPhones. However, that doesn’t make the iPhone XS MAX so warm that the users find it difficult to hold it down with their hands. This is a clear indication of overheating in the iPhone XS MAX. Some similar cases of overheating include.

  • Phone gets way too hot while charging and takes a long time to be fully charged
  • Phone gets hot and the battery drains drastically.
  • You might see a notification that will say “Temperature high”
  • The iPhone gets warm on standby mode for no apparent reasons whatsoever.

(Note: if your phone gets too hot while transferring data for the first time from a previous iPhone, chances are it’s a one-time issue and will not happen again.)

These are some of the most discussed problems in Apple’s user threads and community. However, there are some DIY (Do it Yourself) fixes that you may try which may help you to resolve your overheating issues.

  • Disable background app refresh.
  • Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh
  • Turn off Bluetooth / Location services to reduce processes running in the background
  • Most of the users have reported they get the heating issue in the latest iOS version, In that case,
  • try updating your iOS to later versions to check if it works for your phone.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone XS MAX heating issues. iPhone 16e Repair Service in Bangladesh

An iPhone 16e repair service restores your handset to full working order through diagnostics, part replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, and motherboard repair.

Repair costs in Bangladesh sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a speaker swap cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an original display replacement cost the most.

Most repairs finish the same day. Motherboard and water damage work runs longer because it needs board-level diagnosis.

You pick your display grade before work starts. Original, OEM-grade, high-quality after-market soft, high-quality after-market hard, and copy displays each carry a different price — and a different warranty period.

Our Dhaka service center covers Dhanmondi, Gulshan, Uttara, Mirpur, Motijheel, and Panthapath, with courier pickup for Chattogram and Sylhet. Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic.

What does our iPhone 16e repair service cover?

An iPhone 16e repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16e, replaces the failed part, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults on the A18 chip platform. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired part and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16e repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16e screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.1-inch OLED display assembly and calibrates brightness, color, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16e battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16e charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16e back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked matte back glass and reseals the aluminium frame so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16e camera repair — Replaces the single rear camera module or the front camera assembly when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16e facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16e speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16e microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16e water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16e motherboard repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.

How much does an iPhone 16e repair cost?

An iPhone 16e repair costs between BDT 1,500 and BDT 32,000, depending on the failed part and the grade you select. The failed component sets the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Entry-level repairs cost between BDT 1,500 and BDT 4,500. This tier covers speaker replacement, microphone replacement, charging port cleaning, action button repair, and software fault recovery. These repairs use low-cost components and finish within a single visit.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 5,000 and BDT 14,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 15,000 and BDT 32,000. This tier covers original display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and motherboard repair. Original display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest part and labor cost on the iPhone 16e.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16e screen replacement cost in Bangladesh?

An iPhone 16e screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 26,000 in Bangladesh, depending on the display grade you select. The display assembly is the most expensive single part in the device, and the local market supplies five grades at five price points. A display assembly charge covers fitting and calibration and appears as a separate line on your quotation.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 11,000. This tier uses a copy display or a high quality after-market hard display that restores picture and touch at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 12,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier uses a high quality after-market soft display or an OEM-grade display, both of which reproduce OLED contrast and match original touch sensitivity.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 19,000 and BDT 26,000. This tier uses an original display pulled from a genuine device, which preserves factory color accuracy, brightness range, and True Tone behavior.

You keep Face ID after any of these five grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

  • Copy display — Budget replacement panel that restores picture output and touch function at the lowest price point.

Adaptive color temperature data transfers from your original display where the feature remains active after the swap.

data.title: Error Solution
data.description:
Sometimes when you update your iPhone, or when you try to run your phone you may see some sort of black screen with some sort of Error with a number on your iPhone’s screen out of nowhere. These messages with errors and numbers can be seen while booting up the phone or trying to upgrade the IPSW files from iTunes from a PC. These are Error Codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy. They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen in the iPhones are as follows:

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error codes – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

To check if your iPhone is updated

If the update still fails try updating from another pc

To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)

Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.

Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info pages with possible DIY (Do it yourself) solutions.

The whole error code list: Error code list

However, not all problems can be fixed only by DIY fixes. Some errors might require some handy work around the inner parts of the phone which should be done by a professional iPhone technician. That is where ifixit bd comes in, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving errors in iPhone 12 Pro or any other iPhone device. ifixit bd is a prominent Apple gadget servicing center based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We have service points in 4 different locations. We specialize in iPhone repairs and replacements of parts.

data.description:
The new iPhone 11 Pro is an IP68-rated dust- and water-resistant phone. However, when you have opened your iPhone once for repair or any replacement of parts,. The rating becomes null and void, and your phone loses the IP68 rating. When your iPhone doesn’t have that IP68 rating, it means it can easily catch dirt or any form of debris from outside. Because it does not have those dust-resistant substances and machine-formed compact bonding like when it came from the company.

If you have dirt, dust, or debris on your iPhone, it may get in the way of the functionality of your phone, for example,

  • Dirt can damage your speakers; therefore, you might get very low audio output.
  • Dirt can get in your charging dock and can cause interruptions in charging.
  • Dirt can cause your iPhone camera lens to be damaged or to be foggy.
  • Dust may get in your iPhone, which can sit and slow down other components, take up space in free areas, and cause heating issues in your phone. Which may result in poor performance and slow your phone down.

data.description:
The new iPhone 11 Pro Max offers dual speakers (one on the top and one at the bottom with a receiver mic) and provides users with excellent sound quality. The iPhone 11 Pro Max has two speaker grills at the bottom of the phone. Keep in mind that one speaker grill is for the mic to catch your voice inputs for your calls and Siri. This should not be confused with a broken or damaged speaker with no audio output.

If the top or the bottom speaker of your iPhone 11 Pro Max is not working, you should check something before reaching any conclusions. Check if:

  • Make sure the ringer switch is on in the sound mode.
  • Check for dirt or debris in the speaker grill at the bottom and the speaker hole at the top.
  • Check your volume settings in Settings > Sound and Haptics > Ringer and Alerts > Volume Slider and make sure it’s on the optimum level.
  • If there’s still an issue of not hearing anything through the speakers of the iPhone 11 Pro Max or the volume levels seem too low, it may need to be repaired or replaced.

On iFixit BD, we have specialist technicians who specialize in repairing your iPhone 11 Pro Max. We have service points where you may have your phone looked at by our expert repairmen. We are located in service points all over Dhaka, Bangladesh. We offer the best service for iPhones in Bangladesh. We offer quick service for your ease of access and also a 30-day service warranty on repair services you receive. We also use genuine Apple parts for repairing and replacing parts of your iPhone. So, come to your nearest iFixit BD service center for fixing your iPhone woes.

data.title: Face ID Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 16 comes with a distinct feature named Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. This feature was made available from the iPhone X models and the later Apple A12x Bionic chipsets. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided with the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

The face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature.

Face not recognized

Face ID is not available at the moment

Move the camera a bit lower/higher

Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me into Passcode and not Face ID

These common issues however have some home remedies which may work for your iPhone. These fix attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode

if you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way

Make sure you face the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing between your face and camera region

Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy

Update your iOS to the latest version

If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID instead prompt with a passcode. The reasons may be:

User might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone

The user may have just restarted the device

The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours

The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days

The device has not been unlocked by face ID in the last 4 hours

The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from a safe space

If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts

If at Face ID set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all

If your iPhone 16 Face ID problems can’t be categorized and sorted by the above-mentioned issues and fixes, you may just need to take it to an extremely diligent iPhone technician to deal with Face ID issues.

Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issue has been resolved

Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection

Restore the default network connection

data.description:
Sometimes when you update your iPhone, or when you try to run your phone you may see some sort of black screen with some sort of Error with a number on your iPhone’s screen out of nowhere. These are Error Codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy. They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore, saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen in the iPhones are as follows:

  • ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error code – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

  • To check if your iPhone is updated
  • To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)
  • If the update still fails try updating from another pc.

data.description:
The new iPhone 13 offers one of the best displays of high DPI. It has also ensured maximum safety for its users by putting gorilla glass in both back and the front. However, not all damage to the display comes from dropping the device from the hands and shattering it. Some users of the iPhone 13 have reported a sudden black screen with no prior damage history. The No light on Display issue of the iPhone 13 is where the user can’t see what’s happening on the phone. The phone is running okay. The phone vibrates and the user can hear the notification sounds and other inputs. But the problem is they can not see any of it because the phone display is just plain black. The phone will respond or might even have incoming calls.

The key symptoms of the “No light on Display” issues are:

The phone's display boots up with an Apple logo but doesn’t get past the black screen (iPhone 6 – 8Plus) 

The phone has calls and notifications but doesn’t show anything on display

iPhone can charge (you can hear the sound that the phone makes while charging) but won’t show anything on the display

This “No light on display” is usually an internal issue with the LCD connector. However, Apple recommends some processes to practice on your phone to make sure the black screen is not a software glitch.

Force Restart your iPhone. (Press the volume up (+) and volume down (-) and then press and hold the power button until the Apple logo appears on the screen) 

Connect the lightning cable and charge it for 10 minutes. Then try force restarting the iPhone

UNCONVENTIONAL: But press the screen into the phone so it may reconnect to any dislodged LCD connector. This fix is not recommended, however it resolved a lot of the user's Black Display issues. It might be risky for any layman. 

If none of the fixes work to resolve the issue on your iPhone, you may need to get it looked at by experienced professionals who specialize in iPhone issues. data.title: Button Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 14 Pro Max has 3 physical buttons and 1 switch to ensure maximum accessibility to its users. The buttons and the switches are:

  • Volume Up (+) button
  • Volume down (-) button
  • Ringer Switch
  • Power Button

Newer iPhone models have discontinued the Home button, which used to serve both the purpose of a home button and a fingerprint sensor. Apple has discontinued Home Buttons since the iPhone X models and has continued on the same policy till now. The iPhone 14 Pro Max has no home buttons. Instead, it has a Face ID or face unlock feature. Now with time, the buttons of your iPhone 14 Pro Max may face wear and tear and may cease to function properly.

The most common issues faced regarding the buttons of smartphones are:

  • The Sound doesn’t increase/decrease when I press the volume up or down key
  • The buttons are stuck and can’t be pressed

data.title: Touch Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 12 Pro offers a haptic touch system instead of a 3D touch system that was available in the previous versions of the iPhones. The new haptic touch does not require assessing the strength of users like it needed to in the 3D touch system. Instead, it measures the area of your fingertips to decide the strength and length of the touch input provided by the user. This haptic touch is also a way to ensure your touch works for a long time. However, you just might face an issue anytime soon on your iPhone 12 Pro regarding your phone’s touch.

The most common issues faced by the users that are reported in the iPhone 12 Pro users community forum are as follows:

Too sensitive screen/screen response intermittently (means responses without the user having to input or auto touch)

Touchscreen in your iPhone does not respond at all

Delayed Touch issue

Touch doesn’t respond after dropping from hand. (Everything else seems to work fine)

There are some fixes you might try to see if any of them work for your phone. Those are the following listed below:

Make sure your touch screen protector doesn’t interfere with the proper operation

Make sure there’s no internal/external damage (cracking or shattering glass)

Disconnecting your USB-lightning port to check if it works

If your phone is above normal temperature wait for it to cool down and then try again

Restart your device

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get your iPhone checked by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues regarding touch on your iPhone 12 Pro. ifixit bd is located in 4 different service points. data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water. However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage. If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:

  • Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth
  • You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there.
  • Never charge your phone until you have made sure it is completely dry

If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth. If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers. Therefore saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen on iPhones are as follows:

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error codes – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

To check if your iPhone is updated

If the update still fails try updating it from another pc

To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)

Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.

Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Turn off background iCloud/iTunes sync to save battery by a considerable amount

When not in use turn off WiFi/Cellular Data/Location/Bluetooth service in your iPhone

Don’t overcharge/ Frequently charge your iPhone 12 Pro Max. It may reduce battery health

Turn on optimized battery charging to save your battery life and protect it from draining

Adjust your brightness settings in iPhone 12 Pro Max to auto-brightness

Turn off Background app refresh

From here: Settings > general > Background app refresh

Try running it on low power mode

from here: Settings > Battery > Low power mode ON

Turn off “reduce motion” to turn off aesthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help

repair_info.image_alt_text: iPhone 14 No Light On Display Issue

data.description:
The new iPhone 14 offers one of the best displays of high DPI. It has also ensured maximum safety for its users by putting gorilla glass in both the back and the front. However, not all damage to the display comes from dropping the device from the hands and shattering it. Some users of the iPhone 13 Pro Max have reported a sudden black screen with no prior damage history. The No light on Display issue of the iPhone 14 is where the user can’t see what’s happening on the phone. The phone is running okay. The phone vibrates and the user can hear the notification sounds and other inputs. But the problem is they can not see any of it because the phone display is just plain black. The phone will respond or might even have incoming calls.

The key symptoms of the “No light on Display” issues are:

The phone's display boots up with an Apple logo but doesn’t get past the black screen (iPhone 6 – 8Plus) 

The phone has calls and notifications but doesn’t show anything on display

iPhone can charge (you can hear the sound that the phone makes while charging) but won’t show anything on the display

This “No light on display” is usually an internal issue with the LCD connector. However, Apple recommends some processes to practice on your phone to make sure the black screen is not a software glitch.

Force Restart your iPhone. (Press the volume up (+) and volume down (-) and then press and hold the power button until the Apple logo appears on the screen) 

Connect the lightning cable and charge it for 10 minutes. Then try force restarting the iPhone

UNCONVENTIONAL: Press the screen into the phone so it may reconnect to any dislodged LCD connector. This fix is not recommended, however, it resolved a lot of the user's Black Display issues. It might be risky for any layman. 

If none of the fixes work to resolve the issue on your iPhone, you may need to get it looked at by experienced professionals who specialize in iPhone issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in resolving no light-on-display issues on your iPhone 14. We are a service center that operates based on 4 different and convenient points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Temperature High Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone XS comes with a generally better and more efficient processor and battery than the iPhone X series. Although the users have said that the phone tends to get hotter than the previous iPhones Apple has released,. The new iPhone XS comes with a special thermal compound in the back area of the phone, which helps to omit heat faster and more efficiently than the previous iPhones. It may make your iPhone seem a lot hotter than the previous iPhones.

However, that doesn’t make the iPhone XS so warm that the users find it difficult to hold it down with their hands. This is a clear indication of overheating in the iPhone XS. Some similar cases of overheating include.

  • The phone gets way too hot while charging and takes a long time to be fully charged.
  • The phone gets hot, and the battery drains drastically.
  • You might see a notification that will say “Temperature high.”
  • The iPhone gets warm on standby mode for no apparent reason whatsoever.

(Note: if your phone gets too hot while transferring data for the first time from a previous iPhone, chances are it’s a one-time issue and will not happen again.)

These are some of the most discussed problems in Apple’s user threads and community. However, there are some DIY (do it yourself) fixes that you may try that may help you to resolve your overheating issues.

  • Disable background app refresh.
  • Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh
  • Turn off Bluetooth/location services to reduce processes running in the background.
  • Most of the users have reported they get heating issues in the latest iOS version. In that case,
  • Try updating your iOS to later versions to check if it works for your phone.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone XS heating issues. data.description:
The new iPhone XS MAX comes with a lightning port which is one of the most important parts of the smartphone. It can be charged with a lightning cable and charges at a whopping 18 Watt (fast charging). This can charge your phone to 50 percent in 30 minutes. And it can also be used as a USB 2.0 port. However, after using the phone for a long time or by an accident; your charging dock of the phone may get faulty or damaged, and you might need to get it replaced.

The most common issues of the iPhone XS MAX charging dock are:

  • The battery charges very slowly
  • iPhone XS MAX not charging beyond 80 %.
  • Charging Not available or Liquid has been detected in the charging port error.
  • The charging dock can’t be connected to a USB-supported device through the lightning cable.

If your phone has any one of these issues or something not mentioned in the list of the common issues. You will still like to check out these DIY (Do it yourself) fixes that may solve the problem regarding the charging dock in your iPhone XS MAX.

  • Make sure you don’t have any debris or dirt on your charging dock. This may prevent charging.
  • Make sure your power outlet isn’t faulty.
  • Make sure you do not have the “optimized battery charging” option checked on your iPhone XS MAX. if you do have it make sure to disable it to charge your phone past 80%.
  • Disable optimized Charging in here: Settings > Battery > Battery Health.
  • Note: This option is only available on iOS 13 or later updates.
  • If your phone is wet, wait until it is dry to charge your phone.
  • If none of the fixes cut it for you, you may need to get your phone looked at by professionals.

Therefore, we use genuine Apple products for replacing or repairing your iPhone XS MAX charging dock issue. It is quite frustrating when you see there’s no network bar/ Wi-Fi signal strong enough near you. There’s no network bar available at the top of the display. Restarting or reinstalling the SIM card doesn’t help. There is always “Searching” shown on the network bar.

You can’t connect to your Bluetooth devices like Apple Watch, Bluetooth headphones, and stereo speakers through your phone. It appears that you cannot connect to anything wireless through your iPhone 13  Pro

If you are facing this issue go to Settings > General > About and see if you can find information regarding IMEI, Bluetooth location, Modem Firmware, etc. If there is nothing there then you are having an issue with the modem firmware

There are no DIY (Do It Yourself) fixes available for this issue. You are going to be needing to take your iPhone 13 Pro to an expert repair technician to resolve the “No modem firmware” issue. data.title: Audio Issue
data.description:
The iPhone XS MAX is one of the best phones on the market, considering its audio output quality. It has a dual stereo speaker with noise cancellation and spatial audio features. It has two speaker grills in the bottom part of the phone. It should be kept in mind that the left speaker grill is not a speaker, but instead it is there to catch audio inputs for your voice calls and Siri. The audio only comes out of the right speaker grill, and it is not a faulty feature. The two speakers of the iPhone XS MAX are located on the top and the bottom of the phone. The top speaker also serves its purpose as an ear speaker when in calls.

However, some users have reported a lot of different audio issues. The most common audio issues faced by iPhone XS Max users are...

  • No sound in audio playback
  • No sound in voice calls
  • Distorted sound/low sound on the speakers
  • Headphones not working
  • Audio not working or audio levels low after an update.
  • Phone stuck in headphone mode
  • Ringer switch not working/audio level increases or decreases automatically/physical audio level buttons not working

These issues are the most common audio issues reported by users in the Apple support forum. There are some “do it yourself” fixes available and advised to be attempted as a “first aid” for your audio issues by Apple professionals and users. Those are

  • Checking the ringer switch to see if it is on the sound mode
  • Restarting Your Phone
  • Disabling your Bluetooth in the iPhone XS MAX
  • Check if your phone is in DND (Do not disturb) mode.
  • Check sound notification settings and try turning noise cancellation off.
  • Try using headphones and check if the sounds come through okay in headphones.
  • Try removing any protective cases.
  • Clean the speaker grills of dirt and debris.

If none of the fixes works for your phone, you need to get it checked by professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones. In ifixit bd, we have experienced technicians who specialize in repairing iPhone XS MAX. Our service points are located at locations in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We also offer quick service for your ease of access, and on top of that, a 30-day warranty on applicable services you receive from ifixit bd.

data.title: Temperature High Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 Pro comes with a generally better and more efficient better processor and battery than the iPhone X series. Although, the users have said that the phone tends to get hotter than the previous iPhones Apple has released. The new iPhone 11 pro comes with a special thermal compound in the back area of the phone which helps to omit heat faster and more efficiently than the previous iPhones. It may make your iPhone seem a lot hotter than the previous iPhones. However, that doesn’t make the iPhone 11 pro so warm that the users find it difficult to hold it down with their hands.

This is a clear indication of overheating in the iPhone 11 pro. Some similar cases of overheating include.

  • Phone gets way too hot while charging and takes a long time to be fully charged
  • Phone gets hot and the battery drains drastically
  • You might see notification which will say “Temperature high”
  • The iPhone gets warm on standby mode for no apparent reasons whatsoever

(Note: if your phone gets too hot while transferring data for the first time from a previous iPhone, chances are it’s a one-time issue and will not happen again.)

These are some of the most discussed problems in Apple’s user threads and community. However, there are some DIY (Do it Yourself) fixes that you may try which may help you to resolve your overheating issues.

  • Disable background app refresh.
  • Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh
  • Turn off Bluetooth / Location services to reduce processes running in the background
  • Most of the users have reported they get heating issues in the latest iOS version, In that case, try updating your iOS to later versions to check if it works for your phone.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone 11 pro heating issues. data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 12 Mini offers a set of microphones to ensure your iPhone makes the best out of the audio inputs it receives. The iPhone offers the users a mono speaker and microphone to ensure the best listening experience for their users. However, it is often reported by iPhone 12 Mini users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones.

The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are:

Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/ voice memos.

Low or unclear voice in Facetime, skype, or video recording.

Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic.

Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands.

The iPhone 12 Mini has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes.

The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls

One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri

The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.

Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.

Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works

If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone 12 Mini go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues in your iPhone 12 Mini.

What are the common iPhone 17e problems we fix?

Battery draining fast or shutting down unexpectedly

Heavy app usage, background activity, and Bangladesh's heat accelerate battery cell degradation. When your iPhone 17e shuts off at 20% or barely lasts half a day, the battery capacity has dropped below usable levels. Battery replacement restores full all-day performance, takes under an hour, and is one of the best-value repairs for this model. iPhone 17e battery replacement

Cracked or dead OLED screen

The iPhone 17e uses an OLED Super Retina panel. It cracks more easily than older LCD models on low-impact drops and can show green lines, black patches, or dead touch zones after impact. We replace the full display assembly — digitiser, OLED panel, and frame — and run touch calibration and colour checks before handing back the device. iPhone 17e screen replacement

USB-C port not charging or devices not connecting

The USB-C port collects dust, lint, and moisture over time. Intermittent charging, the cable only working at one angle, or the phone not recognised by a computer are all common symptoms. We clean the port during every free diagnosis — if that resolves it, you pay nothing. If the flex cable is physically damaged, we replace it. iPhone 17e charging issues

Rear camera blurry or not focusing

A drop to the camera bump can misalign the lens module or damage the optical image stabilisation mechanism. Autofocus failure, persistent blur, and app crashes during photo or video are all signs of camera module damage. We inspect under magnification and replace only the component that is confirmed faulty. iPhone 17e camera repair

Face ID stopped working after a drop or screen repair

Face ID relies on the TrueDepth sensor array behind the front camera. A drop that cracks the front glass or a screen replacement done elsewhere without proper pairing can disable Face ID entirely. iFixit BD preserves Face ID function during screen repairs and can diagnose TrueDepth sensor damage independently. iPhone 17e Face ID repair

data.title: No Modem Firmware
data.description:
It is quite frustrating when you see there’s no network bar/ Wi-Fi signal strong enough near you. We use our phones mostly to stay connected with others most of the time, and problems like that keep us from staying connected. You may face a similar kind of problem with your iPhone 14. This usually happens after a faulty or incomplete update where you might see this:

There’s no network bar available at the top of the display. Restarting or reinstalling the SIM card doesn’t help. There is always “Searching” shown on the network bar.

There is no Cellular connection available for your phone. You can’t turn on, discover, or connect to available wireless Hotspot networks available near you through your iPhone 14.

You can’t connect to your Bluetooth devices like Apple Watch, Bluetooth headphones, and stereo speakers through your phone. It appears that you cannot connect to anything wireless through your iPhone 14.

Possible Causes of Failure:

Physical Damage: Dropping the phone or exposing it to water can damage internal components.

Software Bugs: Sometimes, a software issue may mimic hardware failure. Perform a factory reset or update the iPhone before deciding on hardware repair.

Wear and Tear: Over time, mechanical components can degrade and stop working properly.

  • If your camera flash isn’t working, try turning on flash from the control center and see if it works.
  • Try disabling Voiceover settings for your iPhone. From Settings > General > Accessibility > Turn off voiceover
  • Try Switching between camera lenses in settings.

data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 12 pro max offers a set of microphones to ensure your iPhone makes the best out of the audio inputs it receives. The iPhone offers the users a dual speaker and microphone to ensure the best listening experience for their users. However, it is often reported by iPhone 12 pro max users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones. The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are:

Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/ voice memos

Low or unclear voice in Facetime, skype, or video recording

Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic

Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands

The iPhone 12 pro max has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes.

At the bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls

One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri

The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes

Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there

Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works

If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone 12 pro max go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. data.title: Back Glass Replacement
data.description:
The new iPhone XS has a glass back finish like most of the previous iPhones released by Apple in the market. It has a frosted matte finish which looks sleek and stylish. Not only that, but it is also scratch and oil resistant. However, even after having a Gorilla glass in the back and IP certified, it is still vulnerable to damages by insecure actions by its users such as dropping it from hand or any other form of accident. The Most Common back glass damage in iPhone XS is the back glass getting cracked.

Apple introduced and installed the back glass in iPhones even after knowing that the phones shall be vulnerable to damage. They did it because of the wireless charging feature. Glass back increases conductivity for your iPhone to charge wirelessly.

Signs that indicate you should repair your iPhone Xs back glass are:

  • Scratched up/ Multiple visible scratches
  • Shattered glass / small glass parts coming out of the back

One of the three is a reason that you should repair the back glass of your iPhone XS as soon as possible. Broken back glass in an iPhone not only hampers a full flowing wireless charging but also hampers the overall iPhone experience.

iPhone Xs repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone Xs fault. The 5.8-inch Super Retina OLED, A12 Bionic chip, dual camera, and IP68 water resistance made the Xs Apple's compact flagship of 2018. We repair cracked OLED screens, critically degraded batteries, Lightning port faults, camera damage, Face ID sensor issues, and board-level problems. Screen replacement starts from ৳5,500, battery from ৳2,000, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone Xs problems we fix?

Battery in critical condition — needs immediate replacement

Seven-plus years of charge cycles have severely degraded iPhone Xs batteries. Most units have dropped below 70% capacity and show iOS performance throttling, unexpected shutdowns, and very short on-time. Battery replacement at this device age is the repair we recommend before anything else. [→ iPhone Xs battery replacement]

Cracked OLED screen

The 5.8-inch Super Retina OLED panel produces permanent OLED damage — green lines, dead touch zones, and display bleed — when cracked. We replace the full assembly and verify Face ID sensor alignment post-repair. [→ iPhone Xs screen replacement]

Face ID failure

Face ID sensor failure on the iPhone Xs is common — TrueDepth sensors degrade with age and can be damaged by liquid ingress even on IP68-rated devices. A prior screen repair that broke sensor pairing is another frequent cause. [→ iPhone Xs Face ID repair]

Dual camera portrait mode blur or telephoto failure

The telephoto lens, OIS mechanism, and rear camera flex cable all wear over 7 years. Blur on the telephoto lens, Portrait Mode depth failure, and autofocus hunting are the common symptoms. [→ iPhone Xs camera repair]

Lightning port worn or charging slowly

Seven years of daily use compacts lint firmly and wears the Lightning port pins. Port cleaning and flex cable replacement are both available. [→ iPhone Xs charging issues]

data.title: Button Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone XS has 3 physical buttons and 1 switch to ensure maximum accessibility to its users. The buttons and the switches are

  • Volume Up (+) button
  • Volume down (-) button
  • Ringer Switch
  • Power Button

The newer iPhone models have discontinued the Home button, which used to serve both the purpose of a home button and a fingerprint sensor. Apple has discontinued Home Buttons since the iPhone X models and has continued on the same policy till now. The iPhone XS has no home button. Instead, it has a Face ID or a face unlock feature. Now, with time, the buttons of your iPhone XS may face wear and tear and may cease to function properly. The most common issues faced regarding the buttons of smartphones are...

  • The sound doesn’t increase/decrease when I press the volume up or down key.
  • The buttons are stuck and can’t be pressed.
  • The switch doesn’t work/automatically switches between ringer and silent mode.

These are the most common issues regarding the physical buttons in the iPhone. However, Apple recommends restarting the device and updating the iOS in this case. And if it still does not fix the issues, it needs to be looked at by professionals. iPhone recommends using AssistiveTouch for the longevity of the physical buttons of the iPhone XS.

data.title: Audio Issue
data.description:
The iPhone 7 plus is one of the best phones in the market, considering its audio output quality. It has a mono stereo speaker with noise cancellation and spatial audio features. It has a speaker grill in the bottom part of the phone. It should be kept in mind that, the speaker grill is there to catch audio inputs for your voice calls and Siri. The two speakers of the iPhone 7 plus are located on the bottom of the phone. The top speaker also serves its purpose as an ear speaker when in calls.

However, some users have reported a lot of different audio issues. The most common audio issues faced by iPhone 7 plus users are:

  • No sound in audio playback
  • No sound in voice calls
  • Distorted sound/Low sound on the speakers
  • Headphones not working
  • Audio not working or audio levels low after an update.
  • Phone stuck in Headphone mode
  • Ringer Switch not working/ Audio level increases or decreases automatically/ Physical audio level buttons not working.


These issues are the most common audio issues reported by users in the Apple support forum. There are some “Do it yourself” fixes available and advised to be attempted as a “first aid” for your audio issues by Apple professionals and users. Those are:

  • Checking the ringer switch to see if it is on the sound mode
  • Restarting Your Phone
  • Disabling your Bluetooth in the iPhone 7 plus
  • Check if your phone is in DND (Do not disturb) mode
  • Check sound notification settings and try turning noise cancellation off.
  • Try using headphones and check if the sounds come okay in headphones.
  • Try removing any protective cases
  • Clean the speaker grills for dirt and debris


If none of the fixes works for your phone you need to get it checked by professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhone. In ifixit bd, we have experienced technicians who specialize in repairing iPhone 7 plus. Our service points are located at locations in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We also offer quick service for your ease of access and on top of that, a 30-days warranty on applicable services you receive from ifixit bd. We do not compromise with your phone’s well-being and use genuine Apple parts for repair and replacement of your iPhone issues. Visit your nearest ifixit bd service point for fixing your iPhone 7 plus audio or any other issues.

iPhone 6 repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD is one of Bangladesh's most established iPhone repair centres. We repair every iPhone 6 fault — cracked Retina HD screens, dead batteries, charging port failures, liquid damage, and board-level logic board issues — using both A-grade and Original parts with full pricing transparency. Screen replacement starts from ৳1,800, battery replacement from ৳900, and every repair begins with a free written diagnosis. Most common repairs are completed same-day.

What are the common iPhone 6 problems we fix?

Battery draining fast or shutting down suddenly

Every iPhone 6 in use in 2026 is running a battery that is at minimum 10–12 years old. At that age, lithium-ion cells hold a fraction of their original capacity — you may see 15% drop to 0% with no warning, or the phone shut off at 30%. Battery replacement takes 30 minutes and is the single best-value repair for this device. We replace approximately iPhone 6 batteries every month across our Dhaka branches. [ iPhone 6 battery replacement]

Cracked or unresponsive screen

The iPhone 6's 4.7-inch Retina HD IPS LCD display is still a sharp, usable panel — worth replacing rather than tolerating cracks or dead touch zones. We fit a full display assembly (digitizer, LCD, and frame together) and run a post-repair touch calibration and colour check before handing the phone back. [ iPhone 6 screen replacement]

Not charging or charging only at an angle

The Lightning port on the iPhone 6 collects dust and pocket lint over years of use — often what feels like a charging fault is simply a blocked port. data.title: Proximity Sensor Replacement
data.description:
The new iPhone 16 plus is a smartphone that has a lot of ambient sensors such as an accelerometer, a gyroscopic sensor, and a proximity sensor. The proximity sensor is probably the most used on your iPhone. This sensor is used for turning your phone’s screen off when it is placed near your face during a phone call. So that it may conserve battery or avoid unnecessary touch inputs by your face when talking. It may also be used for features like “Raise and Wake” and other minimal yet handy features.

However, you may face problems with the proximity sensor of your iPhone 16 plus over time. Some issues with the iPhone 16 plus proximity sensor reported by users of the iPhone 16 plus in the users' community are:

The phone display doesn’t turn off during a phone call

The phone display doesn’t turn on automatically as it should after the phone call ends

The proximity sensor is not working/ too sensitive. And turning the phone screen on and off during calls

These are the most common issues found in the iPhone 16 plus proximity sensor. There are some DIY (do it yourself) fixes you may try which may solve issues regarding your proximity sensor if they are very minor. Apple recommends:

Update your iOS

Restart your iPhone

Try removing your screen protector, which may block the proximity sensors' proper working

If you have already tried the above-mentioned fixes and none of the fixes work for you, you might need to get your phone checked by a professional technician. data.title: Camera Issues
data.description:
If You have bought a new iPhone 8 plus, chances are that you bought it for the outstanding camera Apple promised in its launch. With its single camera setup in the back and a camera in the front, it has revolutionized the iPhone as we know it in this model. The iPhone 8 Plus has a camera that is very “critically acclaimed”. However, there are some users left unsatisfied who feel like the camera is underperforming and malfunctioning. They have reported that they are facing some problems with the camera in their iPhone 8 plus. There have been some different kinds of problems reported by users in both the front and the back camera of the iPhone 8 plus. However, most users have faced similar problems that are listed down below.

Common Camera problems:

  • Grainy/ Out of focus image.
  • Black screen when the camera opens
  • Foggy lens
  • Camera/ The iPhone freezes while zooming or switching lenses
  • Camera fails to open/shows a black screen/quality degrades after an iOS update.

Specific Front Camera problems:

  • Camera shows a black screen after switching from the rear camera.

Specific Back Camera problems:

  • LED Flash doesn’t work
  • Camera Freezes when zooming in on the telescopic lens.
  • Desync in Flash photography. Flash goes off after clicking the picture.

(All these issues reported by users in the Apple user community and other forums)

These problems are unique and may happen to an iPhone 8 plus randomly. However, you may try some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes at home and see if it fixes your camera issues of iPhone 8 plus. Try Doing some common fixes such as:

  • Cleaning Your lenses with a microfiber cloth.
  • Try removing metallic or magnetic protective cases if you use one
  • Use a flashlight from control center if you got flash problems
  • Try different camera settings. Switch between camera lenses and see if it works.
  • Restart Your Phone.

If none of the solutions work for your iPhone 8 plus, you should get it looked at by professionals who specialize in iPhone troubleshooting and solving. Here at ifixit bd, we have experienced and professional technicians who specialize in servicing iPhones. We are located at service points in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We offer quick service for your ease of access to our service and on top of that, we provide a 30-days warranty on applicable services of repairing your iPhone 8 plus.

data.title: Temperature High Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 8 Plus comes with a generally better and more efficient better processor and battery than the previous iPhone series. Although, the users have said that the phone tends to get hotter than the previous iPhones Apple has released. Sometimes the iPhone 8 plus is so warm that the users find it difficult to hold it down with their hands. This is a clear indication of overheating in the iPhone 8 plus. Some similar cases of overheating include.

  • Phone gets way too hot while charging.
  • Phone gets hot and the battery drains drastically.
  • The iPhone can perform simple tasks e.g., Making a phone call, watching a YouTube video, taking a photo without getting hot.
  • The iPhone gets warm on standby mode for no apparent reasons whatsoever.

(Note: if your phone gets too hot while transferring data for the first time from a previous iPhone, chances are it is a one-time issue and will not happen again.)

These are some of the most discussed problems in Apple’s user threads and community. However, there are some DIY (Do it Yourself) fixes that you may try which may help you to resolve your overheating issues:

  • Disable background app refresh.
  • Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh
  • Turn off Bluetooth / Location services to reduce processes running in the background
  • Most of the users have reported they only get heating in older iOS, try updating your iOS to later versions to check if it works for your phone.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone 8 plus heating issues. We care about your iPhone and understand how important it is for your daily use. So we offer quick service for your ease of access. We also offer a 30-days service warranty on applicable services. We do not compromise with our repair and quality. We ensure to use genuine Apple parts for repairing and replacing issues on your smartphone. So, visit ifixit bd, to repair your Heating issues of iPhone 8 plus by our professional technicians today.

data.title: Error Solution
data.description:
These are error codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy. They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore, it saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen in the iPhones are as follows: ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an error code 9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error codes—4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

  • To check if your iPhone is updated
  • To check if the lightning cable works. (Error codes 4013, 4014, and 4015 usually indicate this issue.)
  • If the update still fails, try updating from another PC.
  • Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and Apple detects it.
  • Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info pages with possible DIY (do it yourself) solutions.

The whole error code list: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201444

However, not all problems can be fixed only by DIY fixes. Some errors might require some handy work around the inner parts of the phone, which should be done by a professional iPhone technician. That is where iFixit BD comes in. We have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving errors in iPhone XS or any other iPhone device. ifixit bd is a prominent Apple gadget servicing center based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We have service points in 4 different locations. We specialize in iPhone repairs and replacements of parts.

Battery in critical condition — needs immediate replacement

Seven-plus years of charge cycles have severely degraded iPhone Xs batteries. Most units have dropped below 70% capacity and show iOS performance throttling, unexpected shutdowns, and very short on-time. Battery replacement at this device age is the repair we recommend before anything else. [→ iPhone Xs battery replacement]

Cracked OLED screen

The 5.8-inch Super Retina OLED panel produces permanent OLED damage — green lines, dead touch zones, and display bleed — when cracked. We replace the full assembly and verify Face ID sensor alignment post-repair. [→ iPhone Xs screen replacement]

Face ID failure

Face ID sensor failure on the iPhone Xs is common — TrueDepth sensors degrade with age and can be damaged by liquid ingress even on IP68-rated devices. A prior screen repair that broke sensor pairing is another frequent cause. [→ iPhone Xs Face ID repair]

Dual camera portrait mode blur or telephoto failure

The telephoto lens, OIS mechanism, and rear camera flex cable all wear over 7 years. Blur on the telephoto lens, Portrait Mode depth failure, and autofocus hunting are the common symptoms. [→ iPhone Xs camera repair]

Lightning port worn or charging slowly

Seven years of daily use compacts lint firmly and wears the Lightning port pins. Port cleaning and flex cable replacement are both available. [→ iPhone Xs charging issues]

When the motherboard becomes unstable, the device stops responding properly to power, charging, Face ID, and iOS system processes. The iPhone motherboard controls power distribution, charging IC communication, Touch IC response, and Face ID authentication. Any damage in these circuits creates unpredictable performance issues even if the display and battery look normal.

At iFixit BD in Dhaka, every iPhone 17 Pro motherboard issue starts with structured diagnostics. The repair technician checks power flow, short circuits, liquid damage traces, and CPU-level response before confirming repair steps.

We use professional diagnostic tools to identify whether the fault is in the Power IC, Charging IC, or logic board circuits. This prevents unnecessary replacements and ensures accurate repair decisions using original Apple repair standards. Motherboard instability often develops gradually after overheating, impact damage, or liquid exposure. When ignored, it leads to complete device failure and permanent data loss risk.
