data.title: Network Problem
data.description:
Despite these technological advancements from the previous iPhone models, users have reported issues regarding the iPhone XR’s network connectivity. Such as loss in the network, prompt disconnections, and inability to find or locate the network. The most common issues, however, are often discussed on Apple’s user forum, and the most common problems found regarding network in the iPhone XR are:

  • The iPhone XR gets down to 0 network bars randomly.
  • Network quality drops from 4G to 2G/3G.
  • Cannot access metered/cellular internet connection through the carrier or the SIM company.
  • The network never reaches the full level.

These common issues, however, can be a network receptor hardware glitch of the iPhone XR. To resolve these, Apple recommends its iPhone XR users some DIY (do it yourself) fixes as a home remedy, such as:

  • Toggle Airplane Mode on and off to reset the previous network settings and cache.
  • Remove your SIM card and reinstall it again. (requires a restart of the device)
  • Set up the internet for your phone if you’re facing internet issues through the network for the first time.
  • To set up, go to Settings > Mobile Data > Mobile Data Network.

then:

  • Insert the APN (Access Point Name) provided by your carrier.
  • Insert username (provided by your carrier).
  • Insert Password (provided by your carrier)
  • Save the settings by pressing the left arrow at the top.
  • Make sure your data connection is on after setting up the network before you access the internet.
  • Install the carrier update for your iPhone (check in Settings > General > About).
  • Restart your iPhone.
  • Soft reset your iPhone.

If none of the solutions work for your iPhone, you might need to get your phone checked by a professional technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in resolving your network issues in your iPhone XR. ifixit bd has 4 service points, which are located at points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Some of the common error codes seen in the iPhones are as follows: ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error code – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

  • To check if your iPhone is updated
  • To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)
  • If the update still fails try updating from another pc.
  • Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it. Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info pages with possible DIY (Do it yourself) solutions. The whole error code list: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201444. However, not all problems can be fixed only by DIY fixes. Some errors might require some handy work around the inner parts of the phone which should be done by a professional iPhone technician. That is where ifixit bd comes in, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving errors in iPhone 6s or any other iPhone device. ifixit bd is a prominent Apple gadget servicing center based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 6 Plus fault. What are the common iPhone 6 Plus problems we fix?

Battery completely depleted — replacement is essential

A 10–12 year old lithium-ion cell holds almost no practical charge. iPhone 6 Plus batteries in service today require immediate replacement for any continued use — this is not a question of "when" but "now." iPhone 6 Plus battery replacement

Cracked 5.5-inch LCD screen

The 5.5-inch Retina HD LCD display shows standard LCD damage after cracks — white backlight spots, touch dead zones, and dark bleed patches. Full display assembly replacement restores complete function. iPhone 6 Plus screen replacement

Touch Disease — flickering grey bar and unresponsive touch

The iPhone 6 Plus has a known board-level fault called Touch Disease. A design weakness in the touch IC solder joints on the logic board causes a flickering grey bar to appear at the top of the screen, followed by complete touch failure. This is not a screen fault — it is a logic board fault requiring micro-soldering re-work to fix. iFixit BD's board-level lab addresses Touch Disease directly. iPhone 6 Plus Touch Disease repair

Touch ID home button not working

The physical home button and Touch ID sensor wear after 10+ years of use. Mechanical failure, touch sensor degradation, and broken pairing from prior repairs all cause Touch ID failure. iFixit BD restores Touch ID function where the board-level pairing is intact. iPhone 6 Plus home button / Touch ID repair

Lightning port completely worn after 10 years

A decade of daily cable connections has worn the Lightning port pins past usability. Port cleaning alone cannot restore function at this age — flex cable replacement is required. iPhone 6 Plus charging issues

data.description:
MacBook Air 13 inch M1 speaker replacement in Bangladesh

MacBook Air 13 inch M1 speaker replacement is the repair process of removing a faulty left or right speaker unit from a MacBook M1 air and fitting a working replacement in its place. Signs that a speaker needs replacing include no sound from one side, crackling or distorted audio, and buzzing at higher volumes. In Bangladesh, a single speaker replacement costs 4,000 to 8,000 BDT and replacing both speakers costs 7,000 to 15,000 BDT depending on part quality. The repair is completed in 1 to 2 hours at most Dhaka service centers. ifixit BD provide a full audio diagnosis, individual speaker unit replacement, and a service warranty on every A2337 speaker repair Bangladesh.

What is MacBook Air 13 inch M1 speaker replacement?

MacBook Air 13 inch M1 speaker replacement is the repair process of taking out a broken or damaged speaker unit from the MacBook Air A2337 (Late 2020) and fitting a new working speaker in its place to fully restore the audio output. The MacBook Air M1 has two separate speaker units — a left speaker and a right speaker — each individually mounted inside the chassis on opposite sides of the logic board, and each connected to the logic board through its own dedicated speaker flex cable.

The key advantage of this independent speaker design is that only the faulty speaker needs to be replaced. If the left speaker MacBook Air has failed and the right speaker is still working normally, only the left unit is removed and replaced — there is no requirement to replace the MacBook Air M1 stereo speakers as a pair. This keeps the MacBook Air M1 audio repair Dhaka cost lower and avoids disturbing the working speaker during the repair.

data.title: Proximity Sensor Replacement
data.description:
The new iPhone 8 is a smartphone that has a lot of ambient sensors such as an accelerometer, a gyroscopic sensor, and a proximity sensor. The proximity sensor is probably the most used in your iPhone. This sensor is used for turning your phone’s screen off when it is placed near your face during a phone call.  So that it may conserve battery or avoid unnecessary touch inputs by your face when talking. It may also be used for features like “Raise and Wake” and other minimal yet handy features.

However, you may face problems in the proximity sensor of your iPhone pro max over time. Some issues of the iPhone 8 proximity sensor reported by users of the iPhone 8 in the users' community are:

  • The proximity sensor is not working/ too sensitive. And turning the phone screen on and off.
  • The phone display doesn’t shut down during a phone call.
  • The phone display doesn’t turn on automatically as it should after the phone call ends.
  • Proximity sensor doesn’t work after display replacement

These are the most common issues found in the iPhone 8 proximity sensor. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes you may try which may solve issues regarding your proximity sensor if they are very minor. Apple recommends:

  • Try removing your screen protector which may block the proximity sensors proper working.
  • Restart your iPhone
  • Update your iOS.

If you have already tried the above-mentioned fixes and none of the fixes work for you, you might need to get your phone checked by a professional technician. data.description:
The new iPhone 13 Pro Max comes with a generally better and more efficient better processor and battery than the iPhone X series. However, users have said that the phone tends to get hotter than the previous iPhones Apple has released. The new iPhone 13 Pro Max comes with a special thermal compound in the back area of the phone which helps to omit heat faster and more efficiently than previous iPhones. It may make your iPhone seem a lot hotter than the previous iPhones.

However, that doesn’t make the iPhone 13 Pro Max so warm that the users find it difficult to hold it down with their hands. This is a clear indication of overheating in the iPhone 13 Pro Max . Some similar cases of overheating include:

Phone gets way too hot while charging and takes a long time to be fully charged

The phone gets hot and the battery drains drastically

You might see a notification that will say “Temperature high”

The iPhone gets warm in standby mode for no apparent reason whatsoever

(Note: if your phone gets too hot while transferring data for the first time from a previous iPhone, chances are it’s a one-time issue and will not happen again.)

These are some of the most discussed problems in Apple’s user threads and community. However, there are some DIY (Do it Yourself) fixes that you may try which may help you to resolve your overheating issues.

Disable background app refresh.

Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh

Turn off Bluetooth / Location services to reduce processes running in the background

Most of the users have reported that they are getting the heating issue in the latest iOS version, In that case

try updating your iOS to later versions to check if it works for your phone.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone 13 Pro Max heating issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving your iPhone 13 Pro Max issues on your phone. ifixit bd is located in four different service points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Power Issue
data.description:
This correlation between the power button and the battery is unavoidable for the perfect operation of the iPhone. The iPhone has been designed to maintain it. However, many users have complained about issues regarding issues in their power supply and other power-related errors in their iPhones.

Phone does not turn on

The battery signal doesn’t show on the completely blacked-out phone. Therefore you can not determine the problem

iPhone won’t stay charged. The charge drains rapidly after disconnecting from the adapter.

iPhone doesn’t charge. It is stuck on the battery percentage you left it to charge on.

Can’t use the iPhone without keeping it on a constant power supply (eg: Connected to a wall adapter or power bank etc.

These frustrating problems are however the most common issues found on iPhone 13 Pro Max. There are some widely renowned DIY (Do It Yourself) fixes available on the internet which may help with the issue on your device. Such as...

Force restart your iPhone ( Press Volume up (+) and quickly press volume down (-) and then quickly press the power button to complete the restart process)

Check your Lightning cable and adapter to see if they are functioning properly

Check if there is any debris on the iPhone 13 Pro Max charging porthole

Limit background processes by stopping background app refresh

Try charging for 20 minutes while keeping your phone switched off

Sometimes excessive battery drain can happen due to a bug that can be resolved by a software update. So try updating your iOS to the latest version

If none of these methods work to resolve the issue on your smartphone, you might need to get it checked by professional technicians. ifixit bd is an iPhone servicing center located around 4 different service points around Dhaka, Bangladesh. data.title: Touch Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 13 Pro Max offers a haptic touch system instead of a 3D touch system that was available in the previous versions of the iPhones. The new haptic touch does not require assessing the strength of users like it needed to in the 3D touch system. Instead, it measures the area of your fingertips to decide the strength and length of the touch input provided by the user. This haptic touch is also a way to ensure your touch works for a long time. However, you might just face an issue anytime soon on your iPhone 13 Pro Max regarding your phone’s touch.

The most common issues faced by users that are reported in the iPhone 13 Pro Max user community forum are as follows:

Very sensitive screen/screen response intermittently (means responses without the user having to input or auto touch)

Touch screen in your iPhone does not respond at all

Delayed Touch issue

Touch doesn’t respond after dropping from hand. (Everything else seems to be working fine)

data.description:

data.title: Audio Issue
data.description:
The iPhone 14 Pro is one of the best phones on the market, considering its audio output quality. It has a dual stereo speaker with noise cancelation and spatial audio features. It has two speaker grills in the bottom part of the phone. Should keep in mind that, the left speaker grill is not a speaker but instead it is there to catch audio inputs for your voice calls and Siri. The audio only comes out of the right speaker grill and is not a faulty feature. The two speakers of the iPhone 14 Pro are located on the top and the bottom of the phone. The top speaker also serves its purpose as an ear speaker when on calls. However, some users have reported a lot of different audio issues.

The most common audio issues faced by iPhone 14 Pro users are:

No sound on audio playback

No sound on voice calls

Distorted/Low sound on the speakers

Headphones not working

Audio not working or audio levels low after an update.

Phone stuck in Headphone mode

Ringer Switch not working/ Audio level increases or decreases automatically/ Physical audio level buttons not working.

These issues are the most common audio issues reported by users in the Apple support forum. There are some “Do it yourself” fixes available and advised to be attempted as a “first aid” for your audio issues by Apple professionals and users. They are:

Check the ringer switch to see if it is in sound mode

Restarting Your Phone

Disabling your Bluetooth on the iPhone 14 Pro

Check if your phone is in DND (Do not disturb) mode

Check the sound notification settings and try turning noise cancelation off.

Try using headphones and check if the sounds come okay in headphones.

Try removing any protective cases

Clean speaker grills for dirt and debris

if none of the fixes work for your phone, you need to get it checked by professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones. data.title: Touch Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 14 Pro has new wireless firmware that can support up to 7GHz of wireless bandwidth speed. This gives the users unmatched speed in comparison to most of the smartphones in the market. However, there have been issues regarding the Wi-Fi of the iPhone 14 Pro. And frankly, some users have taken issue with the phone saying that the phone disconnects from the wireless network frequently and without any warning. Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most commonly reported iPhone 14 Pro Wi-Fi issues are…

  • Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone 14 Pro
  • Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver
  • Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi
  • High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections
  • iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi
  • iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection

These Wi-Fi issues found on iPhone 14 Pro are pretty common issues found on other wireless-supported devices too! It also does not necessarily indicate that there is anything specifically wrong with your iPhone 14 Pro wireless hardware. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

  • Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issue has been resolved
  • Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again
  • Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection
  • Restore the default network connection

(Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)

  • Update your iOS to the latest version available

If none of the solutions mentioned above work to resolve your Wi-Fi issue on your iPhone 14 Pro, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhone 14 Pro Wi-Fi and its related issues. iFixit bd has 4 service points located in prominent locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh

data.description:
The new iPhone SE 2020 has ensured maximum safety and precaution to reduce user-end damage on display. However, it has no gorilla glass protection.   • The Display lights up
  • The Touches works and gives back the proper response
  • Has no colored lines or off-color spots anywhere in the display
  • Has no dead pixel (no black dots in the display)

The fall which damaged the front glass of the iPhone SE(2) doesn’t damage any other functions such as camera, speaker, or proximity sensor.

data.title: Touch Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 14 offers a haptic touch system instead of a 3D touch system that was available in the previous versions of the iPhones. The new haptic touch does not require assessing the strength of users like it needed to in the 3D touch system. Instead, it measures the area of your fingertips to decide the strength and length of the touch input provided by the user. This haptic touch is also a way to ensure your touch works for a long time. However, you might just face an issue anytime soon on your iPhone 14 regarding your phone’s touch.

The most common issues faced by users that are reported in the iPhone 14 user community forum are as follows:

Delayed Touch issue

Touch screen in your iPhone does not respond at all

Very sensitive screen/screen response intermittently (means responses without the user having to input or auto touch)

Touch doesn’t respond after dropping from hand. (Everything else seems to be working fine)

There are some fixes you might try to see if any of them work for your phone. They are listed below:

Make sure your touchscreen protector doesn’t interfere with the proper operation

Make sure there’s no internal/external damage (cracking or shattering glass)

Disconnect your USB-lightning port to check if it works

If your phone is above normal temperature, wait for it to cool down and then try again

Restart your device

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get your iPhone checked by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues regarding touch on your iPhone 14. ifixit bd is located in 4 different service points. which are in convenient locations for you around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 is a standard IP68 rated, dust and water-resistant phone. This means it can resist dust and water coming in up to a certain level. However, it is not completely immune to water getting inside the iPhone and damaging it. Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water.

However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:

  • Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth
  • You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there.
  • NEVER CHARGE YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU HAVE MADE SURE IT IS COMPLETELY DRY

If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth. If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers. An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service restores your damaged handset to full working order through diagnostics, component replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, logic board repair, and software fault repair.

Repair costs sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a charging port cleanup cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an OLED display swap cost the most. Screen replacement pricing follows the same three tiers.

Turnaround times vary by repair type. A battery swap wraps up same day, while logic board and water damage work takes longer because part availability drives the schedule.

You pick the replacement part grade before work starts. New genuine parts, used genuine parts, OEM-grade parts, and certified after-market parts each carry a different price and a different effect on parts and service history reporting. Every repair ships with a parts and labor warranty.

Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic and ending when you collect a function-tested device. Walk in or reserve your slot ahead — booking ahead locks in the part you need.

What is an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max, replaces the failed component, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired component and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16 Pro Max repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16 Pro Max screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.9-inch LTPO OLED display assembly and calibrates True Tone, brightness, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked rear glass panel and reseals the housing so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max camera repair — Replaces the rear camera module, front camera assembly, LiDAR sensor, or camera lens when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max logic board repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max software fault repair — Recovers iOS when the device sticks on the Apple logo, restarts repeatedly, or fails a firmware update.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair costs between BDT 2,500 and BDT 55,000, depending on the failed component and the replacement part grade you select. The component determines the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 7,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 20,000 and BDT 55,000. This tier covers OLED display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and logic board repair. Display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest component and labor cost on the iPhone 16 Pro Max.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 52,000, depending on the display grade you select. The 6.9-inch LTPO OLED panel is the most expensive single component in the device, which places every screen replacement in the upper cost range.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 24,000. This tier uses a certified after-market OLED assembly that restores display output and touch response at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 26,000 and BDT 38,000. This tier uses an OEM-grade or used genuine display that matches original color accuracy and supports the ProMotion refresh rate.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 40,000 and BDT 52,000. This tier uses a new genuine Apple display that preserves True Tone, adaptive color temperature, Always-On display behavior, and clean parts and service history reporting.

You keep Face ID after any of these three grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

  • Certified after-market parts — Independently manufactured components that pass quality certification and carry the same repair warranty.

How long does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair take?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair takes 30 minutes to 5 working days. Component replacements finish within the same day, while board-level work extends across several days. Turnaround depends on part availability more than on repair difficulty, so a stocked display fits faster than a special-order camera module. Logic board repair and water damage repair take longer than component replacement, because both require diagnosis at circuit level, ultrasonic cleaning, micro-soldering, and staged testing between each step.

  6. Collect the device after function testing — Inspect the repaired component, verify the function test results, and receive your warranty invoice at handover.

data.description:
The new iPhone 12 Mini comes with a distinct feature named Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. This feature was made available from the iPhone X models and the later Apple A12x Bionic chipsets. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided with the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

  • Face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature.

Face not recognized

Face ID is not available at the moment

Move the camera a bit lower/higher

Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me into Passcode and not Face ID

  • These common issues however have some home remedies which may work for your iPhone. These fix attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode

if you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way

Make sure you face the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing between your face and camera region

Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy

Update your iOS to the latest version

  • If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID instead prompt with a passcode. The reasons may be:

The user might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone

The user may have just restarted the device

The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours

The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days

The device has not been unlocked by face ID in the last 4 hours

The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from a safe space

If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts

If at Face ID set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all

data.title: Stuck On Logo
data.description:
The new iPhone 14 Pro offers its users better optimization and balance in software than the previous iPhone models. However, no matter hard they try there can always be some technical issues that can result in your iPhone malfunctioning. The Apple logo stuck issue was also found in previous iPhones and it’s a frustrating issue. Your iPhone boots up, but instead of going to the home screen, it is stuck on the boot menu.

This problem happens mainly/most of the time because of a software issue that happens due to an unclean or interrupted update. This Stuck on Apple logo issue might happen in other instances too. Possible reasons might be:

The iPhone has taken some physical damage. (Dropping from hand)

Update was disrupted due to Wi-Fi disturbance/metered connection or cellular data loss

A third-party app may have access to vital permissions that can disrupt iPhones' productivity

It is rare, however, your phone might be facing a hardware issue. Sometimes faulty hardware prevents the phone from booting up

These issues however can be resolved if it is just a bug or a glitch in the iOS software. You may try the following steps and see if it works for you.

Force Restart your iPhone 14 Pro

(Press volume up (+) and then quickly press the volume down (-) button and hold the iPhone 14 Pro power button as long as the apple logo appears again)

Update your iOS Software.

(If, while in the progress of updating your software, the progress bar under the Apple logo has not moved for an hour, You may connect your iPhone to a PC and select “Update” when prompted)

Remove all third-party apps from your phone. Install Apps only from the Apple App store

Turn off the auto-update of your iOS apps to prevent further interruptions. BUT BE SURE TO UPDATE THEM ON A REGULAR BASIS MANUALLY.

If none of the fixes above work, for you. You might have an issue that needs the touch of a professional iPhone technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in fixing iPhones. ifixit bd is a prominent iPhone servicing center that is located in 4 locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

  • LED Flash is not working

  • Camera or iPhone freezes while zooming in
  • Camera freezes/ shows black screen after an iOS update
  • Blurry, unclear photos
  • Out of Sync flash. This is a problem where a user wants to take a photo with the flash, but the flash gets triggered after the photo has been taken

  • Try Restarting your phone
  • Try cleaning your lenses with a microfiber cloth. Be careful not to scratch it
  • If your camera flash isn’t working, try turning on the flash from the control center and see if it works
  • Try disabling Voiceover settings for your iPhone. From Settings > General > Accessibility > Turn off voiceover.
  • Try Switching between camera lenses in settings
  • You can also try resetting your previous settings

If none of the solutions work for you, you might need to get your iPhone looked at by professionals. data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
The new iPhone 8 is not a standard IP68 rated, dust and water-resistant phone. Which means it can not resist dust and water coming in up to it. However, it can resist certain levels of water. Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water.

However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

  • If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:
  • Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth
  • You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there.
  • NEVER CHARGE YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU HAVE MADE SURE IT IS COMPLETELY DRY
  • If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth.

If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers. data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
However, it is often reported by iPhone 7 plus users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones. The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are:

  • Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/ voice memos.
  • Low or unclear voice in Facetime, skype, or video recording.
  • Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic.
  • Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands.

The iPhone 7 plus has at least 3 different microphones in different places for phone for different purposes.

  • The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls
  • One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri
  • The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

  • Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.
  • Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.
  • Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works
  • If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone 7 plus. go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. data.title: Temperature High Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone X comes with a generally better and more efficient better processor and battery than the iPhone X series. Although, the users have said that the phone tends to get hotter than the previous iPhones Apple has released. The new iPhone X comes with a special thermal compound in the back area of the phone which helps to omit heat faster and more efficiently than the previous iPhones. It may make your iPhone seem a lot hotter than the previous iPhones.

However, that doesn’t make the iPhone X so warm that the users find it difficult to hold it down with their hands. This is a clear indication of overheating in the iPhone X. Some similar cases of overheating include

  • Phone gets way too hot while charging and takes a long time to be fully charged
  • Phone gets hot and the battery drains drastically.
  • You might see a notification that will say “Temperature high”
  • The iPhone gets warm on standby mode for no apparent reasons whatsoever.
  • (Note: if your phone gets too hot while transferring data for the first time from a previous iPhone, chances are it’s a one-time issue and will not happen again.)

These are some of the most discussed problems in Apple’s user threads and community. However, there are some DIY (Do it Yourself) fixes that you may try which may help you to resolve your overheating issues.

  • Disable background app refresh.
  • Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh
  • Turn off Bluetooth / Location services to reduce processes running in the background
  • Most of the users have reported they get heating issues in the latest iOS version, In that case,
  • try updating your iOS to later versions to check if it works for your phone.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone X heating issues. iPhone X repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone X fault. The original iPhone X — the first iPhone without a Home button, the first with Face ID, and the first with an OLED Super Retina display — changed how iPhones work. We repair cracked OLED screens, critically degraded batteries, Lightning port faults, camera damage, Face ID failure, and board-level issues. Screen replacement starts from ৳5,000, battery from ৳2,000, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone X problems we fix?

Battery at critical degradation after 8+ years

The iPhone X launched in 2017 — any battery still in that device has been through 8+ years of charge cycles. Most units have dropped to 60% or below, causing severe throttling, constant shutdowns, and extremely short on-time. Battery replacement is the first and most urgent repair on this model. [→ iPhone X battery replacement]

Cracked Super Retina OLED screen

The iPhone X OLED display was Apple's finest display at the time of launch and still produces good colours and contrast. Cracks cause permanent OLED damage — green or pink lines, dead touch zones — that require full assembly replacement. [→ iPhone X screen replacement]

Face ID failure — TrueDepth sensor degradation

The original TrueDepth sensor array in the iPhone X notch has had 8 years to degrade, absorb moisture through small seal gaps, and suffer impact damage. Face ID failure is extremely common on iPhone X units at this age. iFixit BD diagnoses TrueDepth sensor faults independently. [→ iPhone X Face ID repair]

Dual camera — blur on main or portrait mode failure

The iPhone X dual camera system introduced Portrait Mode to the main iPhone line. OIS mechanical failure, telephoto flex damage, and 8 years of normal wear all contribute to camera quality degradation. [→ iPhone X camera repair]

Lightning port pins worn after 8 years

Eight years of daily cable connections wear the Lightning port pins down completely. Cables become loose and fall out. Port replacement at this device age is often necessary rather than just cleaning. [→ iPhone X charging issues]

How does our repair process work?

Step 1 — Free diagnosis. Bring your iPhone X to any iFixit BD branch. Fault identified, written quote at no cost.

Step 2 — Report and fixed price. Written fault report, fixed price, A-grade and Original side by side.

Step 3 — Confirm and repair. Most repairs same day. Board-level repairs 1–2 days.

Step 4 — Test together and collect with warranty. Full test with you present. Warranty begins from this moment.

iPhone X repair price list at iFixit BD

All prices include parts and labour. Diagnosis is always free.

Why repair your iPhone X at iFixit BD?

Board-level micro-soldering lab. A11 component-level repair, ultrasonic cleaning, 18 years experience.

Dual-tier pricing. A-grade and Original prices disclosed before work starts.

70+ expert technicians, 4 dedicated Dhaka branches, 500,000+ devices repaired.

Is the iPhone X still worth repairing in 2026?

Yes for targeted, affordable repairs — with an honest iOS note.

Battery replacement is the single most important repair. At ৳2,000–3,500 for an 8-year-old phone, a fresh battery is practical and low-cost.

iOS 16 ceiling. The iPhone X is capped at iOS 16 with no further security updates from Apple. Security-sensitive apps and banking apps may not function reliably. For general use, iOS 16 is still functional.

model_data.allservice_page_description:
An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service restores your damaged handset to full working order through diagnostics, component replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, logic board repair, and software fault repair.

Repair costs sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a charging port cleanup cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an OLED display swap cost the most. Screen replacement pricing follows the same three tiers.

Turnaround times vary by repair type. A battery swap wraps up same day, while logic board and water damage work takes longer because part availability drives the schedule.

You pick the replacement part grade before work starts. New genuine parts, used genuine parts, OEM-grade parts, and certified after-market parts each carry a different price and a different effect on parts and service history reporting. Every repair ships with a parts and labor warranty.

Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic and ending when you collect a function-tested device. Walk in or reserve your slot ahead — booking ahead locks in the part you need.

What is an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max, replaces the failed component, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired component and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16 Pro Max repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16 Pro Max screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.9-inch LTPO OLED display assembly and calibrates True Tone, brightness, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked rear glass panel and reseals the housing so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max camera repair — Replaces the rear camera module, front camera assembly, LiDAR sensor, or camera lens when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max logic board repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max software fault repair — Recovers iOS when the device sticks on the Apple logo, restarts repeatedly, or fails a firmware update.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair costs between BDT 2,500 and BDT 55,000, depending on the failed component and the replacement part grade you select. The component determines the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Entry-level repairs cost between BDT 2,500 and BDT 6,000. This tier covers charging port cleaning, speaker replacement, microphone replacement, button repair, and software fault recovery. These repairs use inexpensive components and finish quickly.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 7,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 20,000 and BDT 55,000. This tier covers OLED display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and logic board repair. Display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest component and labor cost on the iPhone 16 Pro Max.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 52,000, depending on the display grade you select. The 6.9-inch LTPO OLED panel is the most expensive single component in the device, which places every screen replacement in the upper cost range.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 24,000. This tier uses a certified after-market OLED assembly that restores display output and touch response at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 26,000 and BDT 38,000. This tier uses an OEM-grade or used genuine display that matches original color accuracy and supports the ProMotion refresh rate.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 40,000 and BDT 52,000. This tier uses a new genuine Apple display that preserves True Tone, adaptive color temperature, Always-On display behavior, and clean parts and service history reporting.

You keep Face ID after any of these three grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

Which replacement parts are used for an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair?

The replacement part grades used for an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair are listed below.

  • New genuine manufacturer parts — Factory-new Apple components that deliver original performance and clean parts and service history reporting.
  • Used genuine manufacturer parts — Tested Apple components harvested from donor devices, offering genuine performance at reduced cost.
  • Original equipment manufacturer grade parts — Components built to Apple's specification by the same suppliers, matching original tolerances and materials.
  • Certified after-market parts — Independently manufactured components that pass quality certification and carry the same repair warranty.

You confirm the part grade in writing before the repair begins, so the quoted price and the fitted component always match. Genuine parts preserve adaptive color temperature, True Tone calibration, and accurate battery health reporting in Settings.

How long does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair take?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair takes 30 minutes to 5 working days. Component replacements finish within the same day, while board-level work extends across several days. Turnaround depends on part availability more than on repair difficulty, so a stocked display fits faster than a special-order camera module. Logic board repair and water damage repair take longer than component replacement, because both require diagnosis at circuit level, ultrasonic cleaning, micro-soldering, and staged testing between each step.

The turnaround time for each iPhone 16 Pro Max repair type is shown below.

Repair typeTypical turnaround timeSame-day availabilityScreen replacement45 to 90 minutesYesBattery replacement30 to 60 minutesYesCharging port repair60 to 120 minutesYesSpeaker or microphone repair45 to 90 minutesYesCamera repair60 to 120 minutesYesBack glass replacement2 to 4 hoursYesFace ID repair3 to 6 hoursYesSoftware fault repair1 to 3 hoursYesWater damage repair2 to 4 working daysNoLogic board repair2 to 5 working daysNo

You receive a turnaround estimate in writing alongside your quotation, and the service desk updates you when a repair moves between stages. Verify current figures against your own service records before publishing, since part supply changes turnaround ranges over time.

Does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair include a warranty?

Yes, an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair includes a warranty. Every repair carries parts and labor coverage that runs from the collection date. The warranty covers component failure and workmanship faults on the repaired part. Coverage applies to the specific component replaced during the repair, and the service desk records the covered part and the coverage period on your invoice at handover.

How do you book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

You book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service by describing the fault, requesting a free diagnostic, approving the written quotation, and confirming a collection time. The process moves from fault description to device collection in six steps, and each step produces a written record you keep. Our service center operates in Dhaka and covers customers across Bangladesh, including Gulshan, Banani, Dhanmondi, Uttara, Mirpur, and Mohakhali. Walk-in service runs during business hours, and booking ahead reserves the specific part your repair requires. You back up the device to iCloud or a computer before handover, since board-level and water damage repairs sometimes affect stored data.

The steps to book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service are outlined below.

  1. Describe the fault and request a free diagnostic — Report the symptom by phone, message, or in person, and the technician runs Apple Diagnostics to identify the failed component.
  2. Receive a written quotation and turnaround estimate — Review the itemized cost and completion time before you approve any work on your device.
  3. Confirm the replacement part grade — Select new genuine, used genuine, OEM-grade, or certified after-market parts, and the service desk records your choice in writing.
  4. Book a time slot or walk in — Reserve a slot to secure your part in advance, or bring the device directly during business hours for stocked repairs.
  5. Back up the device before handover — Sync your data to iCloud or a computer, and note your Apple ID credentials for post-repair activation.
  6. Collect the device after function testing — Inspect the repaired component, verify the function test results, and receive your warranty invoice at handover.

Your iPhone 16 Pro Max deserves a repair that holds up. Book your free diagnostic today and get a written price before anyone opens your device.

iPhone 17 repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 17 fault. The standard iPhone 17 delivers a 6.1-inch OLED display, A19 chip, dual-camera system, and USB-C charging in an aluminium body — Apple's 2025 everyday iPhone. We repair cracked screens, failing batteries, USB-C port issues, camera damage, and Face ID sensor faults using A-grade and Original parts. Screen replacement starts from ৳12,000, battery from ৳3,500, and every repair begins with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone 17 problems we fix?

Battery not lasting through the day

The iPhone 17's A19 chip is efficient, but Bangladesh's high ambient temperatures and always-on connectivity accelerate battery degradation. When the phone no longer reaches evening on a single charge, battery health has dropped. Replacement takes under an hour and immediately restores full-day performance. iPhone 17 battery replacement

Cracked OLED screen

The 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display cracks more visibly than older LCD models and can show discolouration, dead touch zones, or green lines after impact. A full display assembly replacement — OLED panel, digitiser, and bracket — restores the original display quality. iPhone 17 screen replacement

USB-C port loose or charging unreliably

The USB-C port is the only charging and data connection on the iPhone 17. Lint in the port is the most frequent cause of intermittent charging. We clean it during free diagnosis — port flex cable replacement is only performed when cleaning confirms the cable itself is damaged. iPhone 17 charging issues

data.title: Face ID Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 15 comes with a distinct feature named Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. This feature was made available from the iPhone X models and the later Apple A12x Bionic chipsets. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided with the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

The face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature.

Face not recognized

Face ID is not available at the moment

Move the camera a bit lower/higher

Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me into Passcode and not Face ID

These common issues however have some home remedies which may work for your iPhone. These fix attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode

if you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way

Make sure you face the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing between your face and camera region

Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy

Update your iOS to the latest version

If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID instead prompt with a passcode. The reasons may be:

User might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone

The user may have just restarted the device

The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours

The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days

The device has not been unlocked by face ID in the last 4 hours

The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from a safe space

If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts

If at Face ID set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all

If your iPhone 15 Face ID problems can’t be categorized and sorted by the above-mentioned issues and fixes, you may just need to take it to an extremely diligent iPhone technician to deal with Face ID issues. data.title: Charging Issues
data.description:
The new iPhone 12 Pro has a beautiful battery that is optimized for using it for a reasonable amount of time. However, most of the users have complained the iPhone 12 Pro charges very slowly in comparison to other smartphones on the market with almost the same range. The Apple company, recommends that you use an Apple 18-W USB Type-C charging brick if you face a slow charging issue. Which is the default charger with iPhone 12 Pro. Apple claims this charging brick can shoot your charging time up to 50% in 30 minutes only!

However, even with an 18-W charger, some users face issues while charging their iPhone 12 Pro. The most common issues are as follows:

The iPhone 12 Pro charges slowly or not at all

The iPhone is not charging beyond 80 %

An alert that shows that the accessory you are using to charge the iPhone is not certified or supported

These are the most reported issues for an iPhone 12 Pro with faulty charging. You may try some home fixes that may resolve the issues.

Try changing the wall adapter or cable

Check if there is no debris or dirt in both the charging dock and the charging adapter

Make sure the USB is connected firmly on both ends

Check the charging adapter or the lightning cable for visible signs of damage. Example: Bent pin, loose cable, etc.

if you have iOS 14 or above make sure you uncheck the “optimized battery charging” option to make sure it charges beyond 80 %.

To disable it go to: Settings > Battery > Battery Health > Optimized Battery Charging

Make sure you have no damage in your charging dock if unsupported device warning shows.

If none of the fixes seem to work for resolving your iPhone 11 pro charging issues. You may need to get it looked at by professionals. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who have expertise in resolving issues regarding iPhones. Our ifixit bd service points are located in four different locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Touch Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone XS offers a haptic touch system instead of a 3D touch system that was available in the previous versions of the iPhones. The new haptic touch does not require assessing the strength of users like it needed to in the 3D touch system. Instead, it measures the area of your fingertips to decide the strength and length of the touch input provided by the user. This haptic touch is also a way to ensure your touch works for a long time. However, you just might face an issue anytime soon on your iPhone XS regarding your phone’s touch.

The most common issues faced by the users that are reported in the iPhone XS users community forum are as follows:

  • Too sensitive screen/screen response intermittently (means responses without the user having to input or auto-touch)
  • The touchscreen in your iPhone does not respond at all.
  • Delayed Touch issue
  • Touch doesn’t respond after dropping from hand. (Everything else seems to work fine.)

There are some fixes you might try to see if any of them work for your phone. Those are the following listed below:

  • Make sure your touchscreen protector doesn’t interfere with proper operation.
  • Make sure there’s no internal/external damage (cracking or shattering glass).
  • Disconnect your USB-lightning port to check if it works.
  • If your phone is above normal temperature, wait for it to cool down and then try again.
  • Restart your device.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get your iPhone checked by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues regarding touch on your iPhone XS. ifixit bd is located in 4 different service points. iPhone Xs repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone Xs fault. The 5.8-inch Super Retina OLED, A12 Bionic chip, dual camera, and IP68 water resistance made the Xs Apple's compact flagship of 2018. We repair cracked OLED screens, critically degraded batteries, Lightning port faults, camera damage, Face ID sensor issues, and board-level problems. Screen replacement starts from ৳5,500, battery from ৳2,000, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone Xs problems we fix?

Battery in critical condition — needs immediate replacement

Seven-plus years of charge cycles have severely degraded iPhone Xs batteries. Most units have dropped below 70% capacity and show iOS performance throttling, unexpected shutdowns, and very short on-time. Battery replacement at this device age is the repair we recommend before anything else. [→ iPhone Xs battery replacement]

Cracked OLED screen

The 5.8-inch Super Retina OLED panel produces permanent OLED damage — green lines, dead touch zones, and display bleed — when cracked. We replace the full assembly and verify Face ID sensor alignment post-repair. [→ iPhone Xs screen replacement]

Face ID failure

Face ID sensor failure on the iPhone Xs is common — TrueDepth sensors degrade with age and can be damaged by liquid ingress even on IP68-rated devices. A prior screen repair that broke sensor pairing is another frequent cause. [→ iPhone Xs Face ID repair]

Dual camera portrait mode blur or telephoto failure

The telephoto lens, OIS mechanism, and rear camera flex cable all wear over 7 years. Blur on the telephoto lens, Portrait Mode depth failure, and autofocus hunting are the common symptoms. [→ iPhone Xs camera repair]

Lightning port worn or charging slowly

Seven years of daily use compacts lint firmly and wears the Lightning port pins. Port cleaning and flex cable replacement are both available. [→ iPhone Xs charging issues]

How does our repair process work?

Step 1 — Free diagnosis. Bring your iPhone Xs to any iFixit BD branch. Fault identified, written quote at no cost.

Step 2 — Report and fixed price. Written fault report, fixed price, A-grade and Original side by side.

Step 3 — Confirm and repair. Most repairs same day. Board-level repairs 1–2 days.

Step 4 — Test together and collect with warranty. Full test with you present. Warranty begins from this moment.

iPhone Xs repair price list at iFixit BD

All prices include parts and labour. Diagnosis is always free.

Screen replacement (OLED) — A-grade ৳5,500 | Original ৳11,000 | Turnaround: 2–3 hr

Battery replacement — A-grade ৳2,000 | Original ৳3,500 | Turnaround: 45–60 min

Lightning charging port — A-grade ৳1,200 | Original ৳2,500 | Turnaround: 1–2 hr

Wide / telephoto camera — A-grade ৳2,800–3,500 | Original ৳6,000–7,500 | Turnaround: 2–3 hr

Front camera / Face ID sensor — A-grade ৳3,000 | Original ৳7,000 | Turnaround: 2–3 hr

Back glass — A-grade ৳2,000 | Original ৳4,500 | Turnaround: same day

Liquid damage (ultrasonic board clean) — from ৳2,800 | Turnaround: 1–3 days

Logic board repair (micro-soldering) — from ৳4,200 | Turnaround: 1–3 days

Why repair your iPhone Xs at iFixit BD?

Free written diagnosis and fixed quote. No cost to inspect, written estimate before work starts.

Board-level micro-soldering lab. A12 component-level repair, ultrasonic cleaning, 18 years experience.

Dual-tier pricing. A-grade and Original prices disclosed before work starts.

Repair warranty. All parts and labour covered at /warranty-policy.

70+ expert technicians, 4 dedicated Dhaka branches, 500,000+ devices repaired.

Is the iPhone Xs still worth repairing in 2026?

Yes for common faults, with the iOS ceiling as a key consideration.

Battery replacement is essential. At ৳2,000–3,500, this is the most impactful repair for continued daily use.

iOS 16 ceiling. The iPhone Xs is capped at iOS 16, which no longer receives Apple security updates. Factor this into your decision for security-sensitive apps.

Battery, screen, and port repairs make clear financial sense if the iOS ceiling suits your needs in 2026.

data.description:
The new iPhone 12 Mini comes with a lightning port which is one of the most important parts of the smartphone. It can be charged with a lightning cable and charges at a whopping 18 Watt (fast charging). This can charge your phone to 50 percent in 30 minutes. And it can also be used as a USB 2.0 port. However, after using the phone for a long time or by an accident; your charging dock of the phone may get faulty or damaged, and you might need to get it replaced.

The most common issues of the iPhone 12 mini charging dock are:

The battery charges very slowly

iPhone 12 mini not charging beyond 80%

Charging Not available or Liquid has been detected in the charging port error

The charging dock can’t be connected to a USB supported device through the lightning cable

If your phone has any one of these issues or something not mentioned in the list of the common issues. You will still like to check out these DIY (Do it yourself) fixes which may solve the problem regarding the charging dock in your iPhone 12 mini.

Make sure you don’t have any debris or dirt on your charging dock. This may prevent charging

Make sure your power outlet isn’t faulty

If your phone is wet, wait until it is dry to charge your phone

Make sure you do not have the “optimized battery charging” option checked on your iPhone 12 mini. if you do have it make sure to disable it to charge your phone past 80%

Disable optimized Charging in here: Settings > Battery > Battery Health.

Note: This option is only available on iOS 13 or later updates.

If none of the fixes cut it for you, you may need to get your phone looked at by professionals. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing this type of issue on iPhones. ifixit bd is located in service points around Dhaka, Bangladesh. We also offer quick service for your ease of access and a 30 days service warranty on applicable services. We do not compromise the quality of our services. Therefore, we use genuine Apple products for replacing or repairing your iPhone 12 mini charging dock issue. So, visit your nearest ifixit bd service point today to fix your iPhone 12 mini charging dock or any other issues.

Battery — the most critical fault on this model

Battery life was limited even at full health — and after 5+ years of degradation, most 12 Mini batteries are significantly below useful capacity. Battery replacement is urgent and transformative on this device. iPhone 12 Mini battery replacement

MagSafe back glass cracked

The glass back enables MagSafe and wireless charging. Rear drops crack it and impair charger alignment. iFixit BD replaces back glass as a standalone repair. iPhone 12 Mini back glass repair

Main camera blur or OIS failure

The compact chassis means the camera bump protrudes significantly. Drops on the back of the phone often impact the camera module directly, causing OIS mechanical failure and primary camera blur. iPhone 12 Mini camera repair

Five years of daily use in Bangladesh compacts lint firmly into the Lightning port. Port cleaning during free diagnosis resolves most charging faults at zero parts cost. iPhone 12 Mini charging issues

model_data.allservice_page_description:
An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service restores your damaged handset to full working order through diagnostics, component replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, logic board repair, and software fault repair.

Repair costs sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a charging port cleanup cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an OLED display swap cost the most. Screen replacement pricing follows the same three tiers.

Turnaround times vary by repair type. A battery swap wraps up same day, while logic board and water damage work takes longer because part availability drives the schedule.

You pick the replacement part grade before work starts. New genuine parts, used genuine parts, OEM-grade parts, and certified after-market parts each carry a different price and a different effect on parts and service history reporting. Every repair ships with a parts and labor warranty.

Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic and ending when you collect a function-tested device. Walk in or reserve your slot ahead — booking ahead locks in the part you need.

What is an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max, replaces the failed component, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired component and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16 Pro Max repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16 Pro Max screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.9-inch LTPO OLED display assembly and calibrates True Tone, brightness, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked rear glass panel and reseals the housing so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max camera repair — Replaces the rear camera module, front camera assembly, LiDAR sensor, or camera lens when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max logic board repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max software fault repair — Recovers iOS when the device sticks on the Apple logo, restarts repeatedly, or fails a firmware update.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair costs between BDT 2,500 and BDT 55,000, depending on the failed component and the replacement part grade you select. The component determines the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Entry-level repairs cost between BDT 2,500 and BDT 6,000. This tier covers charging port cleaning, speaker replacement, microphone replacement, button repair, and software fault recovery. These repairs use inexpensive components and finish quickly.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 7,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 20,000 and BDT 55,000. This tier covers OLED display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and logic board repair. Display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest component and labor cost on the iPhone 16 Pro Max.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 52,000, depending on the display grade you select. The 6.9-inch LTPO OLED panel is the most expensive single component in the device, which places every screen replacement in the upper cost range.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 24,000. This tier uses a certified after-market OLED assembly that restores display output and touch response at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 26,000 and BDT 38,000. This tier uses an OEM-grade or used genuine display that matches original color accuracy and supports the ProMotion refresh rate.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 40,000 and BDT 52,000. This tier uses a new genuine Apple display that preserves True Tone, adaptive color temperature, Always-On display behavior, and clean parts and service history reporting.

You keep Face ID after any of these three grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

Which replacement parts are used for an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair?

The replacement part grades used for an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair are listed below.

  • New genuine manufacturer parts — Factory-new Apple components that deliver original performance and clean parts and service history reporting.
  • Used genuine manufacturer parts — Tested Apple components harvested from donor devices, offering genuine performance at reduced cost.
  • Original equipment manufacturer grade parts — Components built to Apple's specification by the same suppliers, matching original tolerances and materials.
  • Certified after-market parts — Independently manufactured components that pass quality certification and carry the same repair warranty.

You confirm the part grade in writing before the repair begins, so the quoted price and the fitted component always match. Genuine parts preserve adaptive color temperature, True Tone calibration, and accurate battery health reporting in Settings.

How long does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair take?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair takes 30 minutes to 5 working days. Component replacements finish within the same day, while board-level work extends across several days. Turnaround depends on part availability more than on repair difficulty, so a stocked display fits faster than a special-order camera module. Logic board repair and water damage repair take longer than component replacement, because both require diagnosis at circuit level, ultrasonic cleaning, micro-soldering, and staged testing between each step.

The turnaround time for each iPhone 16 Pro Max repair type is shown below.

Repair typeTypical turnaround timeSame-day availabilityScreen replacement45 to 90 minutesYesBattery replacement30 to 60 minutesYesCharging port repair60 to 120 minutesYesSpeaker or microphone repair45 to 90 minutesYesCamera repair60 to 120 minutesYesBack glass replacement2 to 4 hoursYesFace ID repair3 to 6 hoursYesSoftware fault repair1 to 3 hoursYesWater damage repair2 to 4 working daysNoLogic board repair2 to 5 working daysNo

You receive a turnaround estimate in writing alongside your quotation, and the service desk updates you when a repair moves between stages. Verify current figures against your own service records before publishing, since part supply changes turnaround ranges over time.

Does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair include a warranty?

Yes, an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair includes a warranty. Every repair carries parts and labor coverage that runs from the collection date. The warranty covers component failure and workmanship faults on the repaired part. Coverage applies to the specific component replaced during the repair, and the service desk records the covered part and the coverage period on your invoice at handover.

How do you book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

You book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service by describing the fault, requesting a free diagnostic, approving the written quotation, and confirming a collection time. The process moves from fault description to device collection in six steps, and each step produces a written record you keep. Our service center operates in Dhaka and covers customers across Bangladesh, including Gulshan, Banani, Dhanmondi, Uttara, Mirpur, and Mohakhali. Walk-in service runs during business hours, and booking ahead reserves the specific part your repair requires. You back up the device to iCloud or a computer before handover, since board-level and water damage repairs sometimes affect stored data.

The steps to book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service are outlined below.

  1. Describe the fault and request a free diagnostic — Report the symptom by phone, message, or in person, and the technician runs Apple Diagnostics to identify the failed component.
  2. Receive a written quotation and turnaround estimate — Review the itemized cost and completion time before you approve any work on your device.
  3. Confirm the replacement part grade — Select new genuine, used genuine, OEM-grade, or certified after-market parts, and the service desk records your choice in writing.
  4. Book a time slot or walk in — Reserve a slot to secure your part in advance, or bring the device directly during business hours for stocked repairs.
  5. Back up the device before handover — Sync your data to iCloud or a computer, and note your Apple ID credentials for post-repair activation.
  6. Collect the device after function testing — Inspect the repaired component, verify the function test results, and receive your warranty invoice at handover.

Your iPhone 16 Pro Max deserves a repair that holds up. Book your free diagnostic today and get a written price before anyone opens your device.
