data.title: Power Issue
data.description:
To maintain the sleek and uniform design, Apple provided a power button at the side of the device. This correlation between the power button and the Battery is unavoidable for the perfect operation of the iPhone. The iPhone has been designed to maintain it. However, many users have complained about issues regarding issues in their power supply and other power-related errors in their iPhones.

These power issues include:

  • The Phone does not turn on
  • The battery signal doesn’t show on the completely blacked out phone. Therefore you can not determine the problem.
  • iPhone won’t stay charged. The charge drains rapidly after disconnecting from the adapter.
  • iPhone doesn’t charge. It is stuck on the battery percentage you left it to charge on.
  • Can’t use the iPhone without keeping it on a constant power supply (eg: Connected to a wall adapter or power bank etc,)

These frustrating problems are however the most common issues found on iPhone 11. There are some widely renowned DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available on the internet which may help the issue on your device. Such as...

  • Force restarting your iPhone ( Press Volume up (+) and quickly press volume down (-) and then quickly press the power button to complete the restart process)
  • Check Your Lightning cable and adapter and see if they are functioning properly.
  • Check if there is any debris on the iPhone 11 charging porthole.
  • Limit background processes by stopping the background app refresh.
  • Try charging for 20 minutes while keeping your phone switched off.
  • Sometimes excessive battery drain can be happening due to a bug that can be resolved by a software update. So try updating your iOS to the latest version.

If none of these methods work to resolve the issues on your smartphone, you might need to get it checked by professional technicians. data.title: Audio Issue
data.description:
The iPhone 12 is one of the best phones in the market, considering its audio output quality. It has a dual stereo speaker with noise cancellation and spatial audio features. It has two speaker grills in the bottom part of the phone. It should be kept in mind that, the left speaker grill is not a speaker but instead it is there to catch audio inputs for your voice calls and Siri. The audio-only comes out of the right speaker grill and it is not a faulty feature. The two speakers of the iPhone 12 are located on the top and the bottom of the phone. The top speaker also serves its purpose as an ear speaker when in calls. However, some users have reported a lot of different audio issues.

The most common audio issues faced by iPhone 12 users are:

  • No sound in audio playback
  • No sound in voice calls
  • Distorted sound/Low sound on the speakers
  • Headphones not working
  • Audio not working or audio levels low after an update.
  • Phone stuck in Headphone mode
  • Ringer Switch not working/ Audio level increases or decreases automatically/ Physical audio level buttons not working.

These issues are the most common audio issues reported by users in the Apple support forum. There are some “Do it yourself” fixes available and advised to be attempted as a “first aid” for your audio issues by Apple professionals and users. Those are:

  • Checking the ringer switch to see if it is on the sound mode
  • Restarting Your Phone
  • Disabling your Bluetooth in the iPhone 12
  • Check if your phone is in DND (Do not disturb) mode
  • Check sound notification settings and try turning noise cancellation off.
  • Try using headphones and check if the sounds come okay in headphones.
  • Try removing any protective cases
  • Clean the speaker grills for dirt and debris

If none of the fixes works for your phone you need to get it checked by professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones. We also offer quick service for your ease of access and on top of that, a 30-days warranty on applicable services you receive from ifixit bd.

We do not compromise your phone’s well-being and use genuine Apple parts for the repair and replacement of your iPhone issues. Visit your nearest ifixit bd service point for fixing your iPhone 12’s audio or any other issues.

data.description:
The new iPhone 12 Pro offers one of the best displays consisting of a Super AMOLED retina display and a significantly high DPI. It has also ensured maximum safety for its users by putting gorilla glass in both the back and front. However, not all damage in display comes from dropping the device from the hands and shattering it. Some users of the iPhone 12 Pro have reported a sudden black screen without any prior damage history. The No light on Display issue of the iPhone 12 Pro is where the user can’t see what’s happening on the phone. The phone runs okay. The phone vibrates and the user can hear the notification sounds and other inputs. But the problem is they can not see any of it because the phone display is just plain black. But the phone will respond or might even have incoming calls.

The key symptoms of the “No light on Display” issues are:

The Phone display boots up with an Apple logo but doesn’t get past the black screen (iPhone 6 – 8Plus) 

The phone has calls, notifications but doesn’t show anything on display

iPhone can charge (you can hear the sound that the phone makes while charging) but won’t show anything on the display

data.description:
The new iPhone comes with an almost 4000 mAh battery. The battery is optimized perfectly for the phone. However, it may be for some manufacturer error or something about some faulty apps optimization, you may not get the smoothest output from your iPhone 11 pro max battery.

Most users have reported that the iPhone’s battery starts draining after the system has updated to iOS 14 Several other issues may cause battery drain issues also. These issues include:

  • The battery of the iPhone 11 pro max runs out too quickly after the update
  • The battery of the iPhone 11 pro max runs out after installing an app/ update of an app
  • The battery of the iPhone drains quickly after turning on the optimized charging mode
  • The iPhone Battery drains after the phone heats up too quickly

These are the most common problems regarding battery-draining found on the internet. Your issues may be one of them or not listed! However, we recommend trying some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes that may resolve your issue.

  • Turn off background iCloud/iTunes sync to save battery by a considerable amount
  • When not in use turn off WiFi/Cellular Data/Location/Bluetooth service in your iPhone
  • Don’t overcharge/ Frequently charge your iPhone 11 pro max. It may reduce battery health
  • Turn on optimized battery charging to save your battery life and protect it from draining
  • Adjust your brightness settings in iPhone 11 pro max to auto-brightness
  • Turn off Background app refresh
  • From here: Settings > general > Background app refresh
  • Try running it on low power mode
  • from here: Settings > Battery > Low power mode ON
  • Turn off “reduce motion” to turn off aesthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help
  • Turn it off from here: Settings > General > Accessibility > Reduce Motion

These messages with errors and numbers can be seen while booting up the phone or trying to upgrade the IPSW files from iTunes from a PC. These are Error Codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy. They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen on iPhones are as follows:

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error codes – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

To check if your iPhone is updated

If the update still fails try updating it from another pc

To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)

Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.

Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info page with possible DIY (Do it yourself) solutions. However, not all problems can be fixed only by DIY fixes. Some errors might require some handy work around the inner parts of the phone which should be done by a professional iPhone technician.

This is where ifixit bd comes in, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving errors in iPhone 13 Pro or any other iPhone device. ifixit bd is a prominent Apple gadget servicing center based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We have service points in 4 different locations. We specialize in iPhone repairs and replacements of parts.

The Taptic Engine in an iPhone 11 is responsible for providing haptic feedback, such as vibrations for notifications and the "click" sensation for the home button (on supported models). You might need to replace the Taptic Engine in your iPhone if you experience any of the following issues:

Signs You Might Need to Replace the Taptic Engine:

  • If your iPhone stops providing vibrations or feedback for notifications, calls, or system interactions.
  • The Taptic Engine works only occasionally or inconsistently.
  • The Taptic Engine produces grinding or buzzing noises that were not present before.
  • Error messages or diagnostics indicate an issue with the Taptic Engine.

Possible Causes of Failure:

  • Physical Damage: Dropping the phone or exposing it to water can damage internal components.
  • Software Bugs: Sometimes, a software issue may mimic hardware failure. Perform a factory reset or update the iPhone before deciding on hardware repair.
  • Wear and Tear: Over time, mechanical components can degrade and stop working properly.

data.description:
The new iPhone 14 Plus offers one of the best displays of high DPI. It has also ensured maximum safety for its users by putting gorilla glass in both the back and the front. However, not all damage to the display comes from dropping the device from the hands and shattering it. Some users of the iPhone 14 Plus have reported a sudden black screen with no prior damage history. The No light on Display issue of the iPhone 14 Plus is where the user can’t see what’s happening on the phone. The phone is running okay. The phone vibrates and the user can hear the notification sounds and other inputs. But the problem is they can not see any of it because the phone display is just plain black. The phone will respond or might even have incoming calls.

The key symptoms of the “No light on Display” issues are:

The phone's display boots up with an Apple logo but doesn’t get past the black screen (iPhone 6 – 8Plus) 

The phone has calls and notifications but doesn’t show anything on display

iPhone can charge (you can hear the sound that the phone makes while charging) but won’t show anything on the display

This “No light on display” is usually an internal issue with the LCD connector. However, Apple recommends some processes to practice on your phone to make sure the black screen is not a software glitch.

Force Restart your iPhone. (Press the volume up (+) and volume down (-) and then press and hold the power button until the Apple logo appears on the screen) 

Connect the lightning cable and charge it for 10 minutes. Then try force restarting the iPhone

UNCONVENTIONAL: Press the screen into the phone so it may reconnect to any dislodged LCD connector. This fix is not recommended, however, it resolved a lot of the user's Black Display issues. It might be risky for any layman. 

If none of the fixes work to resolve the issue on your iPhone, you may need to get it looked at by experienced professionals who specialize in iPhone issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in resolving no light-on-display issues on your iPhone 14 Plus. We are a service center that operates based on 4 different and convenient points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Battery capacity declining — Always-On Display drains it faster

The Always-On Display on the iPhone 14 Pro Max runs the screen at a low refresh rate continuously — a useful feature that adds constant background battery drain. Combined with natural cell degradation over two years of use, battery replacement is the most common repair we see on this model. iPhone 14 Pro Max battery replacement

Cracked ProMotion OLED with Always-On Display failure

The 6.7-inch ProMotion panel supports always-on functionality via a low-power LTPO state. A screen crack or OLED damage that disables the always-on feature in addition to normal display function is common after a significant drop. The Dynamic Island replaced the notch on the iPhone 14 Pro Max — and houses the TrueDepth sensor cluster. A drop to the front top edge of the phone can damage the sensors around the island cutout, disabling Face ID. iPhone 14 Pro Max Dynamic Island / Face ID repair

48MP main camera blur or focus issues

The 48MP wide camera introduced on the 14 Pro Max produces significantly larger files and higher detail — and is a more complex mechanical system. Drops, OIS misalignment, and flex cable damage all cause blur, autofocus hunting, and camera app instability. iPhone 14 Pro Max camera repair

Lightning port charging slowly or loosely

The iPhone 14 Pro Max uses Lightning — one of the last iPhone Pro Max models with this connector. Lint compaction and physical cable wear cause loose connections and slow or failed charging. We clean first — replacement only when cable is confirmed damaged. iPhone 14 Pro Max charging issues

data.title: Face ID Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 16e comes with a distinct feature named Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. This feature was made available from the iPhone X models and the later Apple A12x Bionic chipsets. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided with the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

The face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature.

Face not recognized

Face ID is not available at the moment

Move the camera a bit lower/higher

Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me into Passcode and not Face ID

These common issues however have some home remedies which may work for your iPhone. These fix attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode

if you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way

Make sure you face the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing between your face and camera region

Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy

Update your iOS to the latest version

If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID instead prompt with a passcode. The reasons may be:

User might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone

The user may have just restarted the device

The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours

The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days

The device has not been unlocked by face ID in the last 4 hours

The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from a safe space

If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts

If at Face ID set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all

If your iPhone 16e Face ID problems can’t be categorized and sorted by the above-mentioned issues and fixes, you may just need to take it to an extremely diligent iPhone technician to deal with Face ID issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in issues regarding your iPhone 16e. ifixit bd is located in four different locations across Dhaka, Bangladesh. We provide the best service regarding your iPhone. We offer service benefits like no one else. Like:

Free Diagnostics

Money-Back guarantee

So to avail of the specialized services that we guarantee no one can provide in context to iPhone 16e Face ID and any other iPhone issues, visit your nearest ifixit bd service point today!

iPhone 16e Repair Service in Bangladesh

An iPhone 16e repair service restores your handset to full working order through diagnostics, part replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, and motherboard repair.

Repair costs in Bangladesh sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a speaker swap cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an original display replacement cost the most.

Most repairs finish the same day. Motherboard and water damage work runs longer because it needs board-level diagnosis.

You pick your display grade before work starts. Original, OEM-grade, high-quality after-market soft, high-quality after-market hard, and copy displays each carry a different price — and a different warranty period.

Our Dhaka service center covers Dhanmondi, Gulshan, Uttara, Mirpur, Motijheel, and Panthapath, with courier pickup for Chattogram and Sylhet. Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic.

What does our iPhone 16e repair service cover?

An iPhone 16e repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16e, replaces the failed part, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults on the A18 chip platform. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired part and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16e repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16e screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.1-inch OLED display assembly and calibrates brightness, color, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16e battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16e charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16e back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked matte back glass and reseals the aluminium frame so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16e camera repair — Replaces the single rear camera module or the front camera assembly when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16e facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16e speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16e microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16e water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16e motherboard repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.

How much does an iPhone 16e repair cost?

An iPhone 16e repair costs between BDT 1,500 and BDT 32,000, depending on the failed part and the grade you select. The failed component sets the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Entry-level repairs cost between BDT 1,500 and BDT 4,500. This tier covers speaker replacement, microphone replacement, charging port cleaning, action button repair, and software fault recovery. These repairs use low-cost components and finish within a single visit.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 5,000 and BDT 14,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 15,000 and BDT 32,000. This tier covers original display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and motherboard repair. Original display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest part and labor cost on the iPhone 16e.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16e screen replacement cost in Bangladesh?

An iPhone 16e screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 26,000 in Bangladesh, depending on the display grade you select. The display assembly is the most expensive single part in the device, and the local market supplies five grades at five price points. A display assembly charge covers fitting and calibration and appears as a separate line on your quotation.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 11,000. This tier uses a copy display or a high quality after-market hard display that restores picture and touch at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 12,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier uses a high quality after-market soft display or an OEM-grade display, both of which reproduce OLED contrast and match original touch sensitivity.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 19,000 and BDT 26,000. This tier uses an original display pulled from a genuine device, which preserves factory color accuracy, brightness range, and True Tone behavior.

You keep Face ID after any of these five grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

Which display grades are available for an iPhone 16e repair?

The display grades available for an iPhone 16e repair are listed below.

  • Original display pulled from a genuine device — Factory Apple panel with original color accuracy, peak brightness, and True Tone support.
  • Original equipment manufacturer grade display — Panel built to Apple specification by the same supply chain, matching original tolerances.
  • High quality after-market display, soft variant — Flexible OLED panel with strong contrast, deep blacks, and accurate touch response.
  • High quality after-market display, hard variant — Rigid OLED panel offering durable construction and reliable daily performance at moderate cost.
  • Copy display — Budget replacement panel that restores picture output and touch function at the lowest price point.

You confirm the display grade in writing before the repair begins, so the quoted price and the fitted panel always match. A display assembly charge is added separately to the part price and covers fitting, sealing, and calibration. The warranty period differs by display grade, with original and OEM-grade panels carrying the longest coverage. Adaptive color temperature data transfers from your original display where the feature remains active after the swap.

How long does an iPhone 16e repair take in iFixit BD?

An iPhone 16e repair takes 30 minutes to 5 working days. Component replacements finish within the same day, while board-level work extends across several days. Turnaround depends on display grade availability in the local market, so a stocked after-market panel fits faster than a special-order original display. Motherboard repair and water damage repair take longer than component replacement, because both require circuit-level diagnosis, ultrasonic cleaning, micro-soldering, and staged testing between each step. Customers outside Dhaka add 1 to 3 days of courier transit time to every figure below.

The turnaround time for each iPhone 16e repair type is shown below.

Repair typeTypical turnaround timeSame-day availabilityScreen replacement45 to 90 minutesYesBattery replacement30 to 60 minutesYesCharging port repair60 to 120 minutesYesSpeaker or microphone repair45 to 90 minutesYesCamera repair60 to 120 minutesYesBack glass replacement2 to 4 hoursYesFace ID repair3 to 6 hoursYesWater damage repair2 to 4 working daysNoMotherboard repair2 to 5 working daysNo

You receive a turnaround estimate in writing alongside your quotation, and the service desk updates you when a repair moves between stages. Verify these figures against your own current service records before publishing, since display supply in Bangladesh shifts turnaround ranges over time.

Does an iPhone 16e repair include a warranty in iFixit Bangladesh?

Yes, an iPhone 16e repair includes a warranty in Bangladesh. Every repair carries parts and labor coverage that runs from the collection date. The warranty period varies by display grade, with original and OEM-grade panels carrying longer coverage than after-market and copy panels. Coverage applies to the specific part replaced, and the service desk records the covered part and the period on your invoice at handover.

How do you book an iPhone 16e repair service?

You book an iPhone 16e repair service by describing the fault, requesting a free diagnostic, approving the written quotation, and confirming a collection time. The process moves from fault description to device collection in six steps, and each step produces a written record you keep. Contact the service center by phone or message to reserve a slot, or visit during service hours for stocked repairs. Walk-in service runs 7 days a week, and booking ahead reserves the specific display grade your repair requires. You back up the device to iCloud or a computer before handover, since board-level and water damage repairs sometimes affect stored data. Customers outside Dhaka use courier pickup and delivery, with payment by mobile financial service or cash on delivery.

The steps to book an iPhone 16e repair service are outlined below.

  1. Describe the fault and request a free diagnostic — Report the symptom by phone, message, or in person, and the technician runs Apple Diagnostics to identify the failed part.

  5. Back up the device before handover — Sync your data to iCloud or a computer, and note your Apple ID credentials for post-repair activation.
  6. Collect the device after function testing — Inspect the repaired part, verify the function test results, and receive your warranty invoice at handover.

Your iPhone 16e deserves a repair that holds up. Book your free diagnostic today and get a written price before anyone opens your device.

Battery draining extremely fast — the most common complaint

The iPhone SE 2020 has a small physical battery constrained by the 4.7-inch chassis. Combined with the A13 chip's performance demands, battery life was already limited at launch. At 5+ years of daily use, batteries on these phones have degraded to the point where the phone barely lasts a few hours of active use. Cracked 4.7-inch LCD Retina display

iPhone Air repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone Air fault. Apple's ultra-thin 2025 iPhone — a 6.6-inch OLED display, A19 chip, and a chassis thinner than any previous iPhone — is both a design achievement and a specific repair challenge. What are the common iPhone Air problems we fix?

Screen cracking more easily due to the ultra-thin chassis

The iPhone Air's extreme thinness means less material between the display glass and the surface it hits on impact. Drops that would survive on a standard iPhone are more likely to crack the Air screen. We see this model frequently — OLED panel replacement and full display assembly replacement are the most common repairs. iPhone Air screen replacement

Battery draining quickly in a slim form factor

Apple fitted a smaller physical battery to achieve the iPhone Air's ultra-thin profile. Heavy users notice this — on-screen time is visibly shorter than on the standard iPhone air. When capacity drops further through normal degradation, the battery becomes noticeably insufficient for a full day. Same-day battery replacement restores performance. iPhone Air battery replacement

Frame bending from pressure or bag compression

An extremely thin aluminium-titanium chassis is more susceptible to frame flex from sitting on it, carrying it in a full bag, or dropping it on a flat surface. A bent frame creates a gap at the display seal, allows moisture ingress, and can damage internal flex cables. iFixit BD's frame repair and housing replacement service addresses this before it causes further internal damage. iPhone Air housing repair

USB-C port damage from frequent use

USB-C on the iPhone Air is the single port for both charging and data. Daily cable insertion on an ultra-thin device puts more mechanical stress on the port mounting point than on thicker iPhones. Intermittent charging and loose connectors are early signs of port wear. iPhone Air charging issues

Camera module misalignment after drop

The iPhone Air features a single large rear camera. A drop that impacts the thin rear chassis can shift the camera module or crack the lens. Blurry images, autofocus hunting, and app instability are the visible symptoms. iPhone Air camera repair

data.description:
The iPhone 11 pro max comes with upgraded network connectivity than the previous iPhone models and supports 5G network connectivity. Despite these technological advancements from the previous iPhone models, users have reported issues regarding the iPhone 11 pro max’s network connectivity. Such as loss in the network, prompt disconnections, inability to find or locate the network.

The most common issues however are often discussed upon Apple’s user forum and the most common problems found regarding network in iPhone 11 pro max are:

  • iPhone 11 pro max gets down to 0 network bars randomly
  • Network quality drops from 4G to 2G/3G
  • Cannot access metered/Cellular internet connection through Carrier or the SIM Company
  • Network never reaches the full level

These common issues however can be a network receptor hardware glitch of the iPhone 11 pro max. To resolve these Apple recommends its iPhone 11 pro max users some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes as a home remedy, such as:

data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 8 plus offers a set of microphones to ensure your iPhone makes the best out of the audio inputs it receives. The iPhone offers the users a mono speaker and microphone to ensure the best listening experience for their users. However, it is often reported by iPhone 8 plus users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones.

The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are:

  • Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/ voice memos.
  • Low or unclear voice in Facetime, skype, or video recording.
  • Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic.
  • Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands.

The iPhone 8 plus has at least 3 different microphones in different places for phones for different purposes.

  • The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls
  • One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri
  • The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

  • Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.
  • Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.
  • Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works
  • If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone 8 plus go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water. However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:

Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth

You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there.

NEVER CHARGE YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU HAVE MADE SURE IT IS COMPLETELY DRY

If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth.

If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers. data.title: Charging Issues
data.description:
The new iPhone X has a beautiful battery that is optimized for using it for a reasonable amount of time. However, most of the users have complained the iPhone X charges very slowly in comparison to other smartphones on the market with almost the same range. Apple claims this charging brick can shoot your charging time up to 50% in 30 minutes only!

However, even with an 18-W charger, some users face issues while charging their iPhone X. The most common issues are as follows...

  • An alert that shows that the accessory you are using to charge the iPhone is not certified or supported.

These are the most reported issues for an iPhone X with faulty charging. You may try some home fixes that may resolve the issues.

  • Try changing the wall adapter or cable.
  • Check if there is no debris or dirt in both the charging dock and the charging adapter.
  • Make sure the USB is connected firmly on both ends.
  • Check the charging adapter or the lightning cable for visible signs of damage. Example: Bent pin, loose cable, etc.
  • if you have iOS 14 or above make sure you uncheck the “optimized battery charging” option to make sure it charges beyond 80 %.
  • To disable it go to: Settings > Battery > Battery Health > Optimized Battery Charging
  • Make sure you have no damage in your charging dock if unsupported device warning shows.

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water. However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:

Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth

You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there

Never charge your phone until you have made sure it is completely dry

Cracked LCD screen

The 4.7-inch LCD IPS Retina display cracks on drops. LCD-specific damage — white backlight bleed, colour banding, and unresponsive touch areas — require full assembly replacement. iPhone 7 screen replacement

Solid-state home button not responding

The iPhone 7 uses a solid-state home button — no physical moving parts — that simulates clicking through the Taptic Engine. When the Taptic Engine fails or the button's touch sensor wears out, the button stops responding entirely or provides no haptic feedback. iPhone 7 home button repair

Touch IC failure causing no touch response

Like the 7 Plus, the iPhone 7 can develop a Touch IC fault where the board chip controlling screen touch fails after a drop. Screen lights up normally but no touch input is recognised. iFixit BD's micro-soldering lab addresses this at the board level. iPhone 7 touch issues

Lightning port worn or completely failed

Nine-plus years of daily cable use wears the Lightning port pins to the point of failure. Port replacement is typically required rather than just cleaning at this device age. iPhone 7 charging issues

data.title: Charge Draining Issue
data.description:
The battery is optimized perfectly for the phone. However, it may be due to some manufacturer error or something about some faulty app optimization, you may not get the smoothest output from your iPhone 13 Pro battery. Most users have reported that the iPhone’s battery starts draining after the system has updated to iOS 14 Several other issues may also cause battery drain issues. These issues include:

The battery of the iPhone 13 Pro runs out too quickly after the update

The battery of the iPhone 13 Pro battery runs out after installing app/ update of app

The battery of the iPhone drains quickly after turning on the optimized charging mode

iPhone Battery drains after phone heats up too quickly

These are the most common problems regarding battery-draining found on the internet. Your issue may be one of the ones listed! However, we recommend trying some DIY (do it yourself) fixes that may resolve your issue.

Turn off background iCloud/iTunes sync to save battery by a considerable amount

When not in use, turn off WiFi/Cellular Data/Location/Bluetooth service on your iPhone

Don’t overcharge/ Frequently charge your iPhone 13 Pro It may reduce battery health

Turn on optimized battery charging to save your battery life and protect it from draining

Adjust the brightness settings on your iPhone 13 Pro to auto-brightness

Turn off Background app refresh

From here: Settings > general > Background app refresh

Try running it on low power mode from here: Settings > Battery > Low power mode ON.

Turn off “reduce motion” to turn off esthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help.

Turn it off from here: Settings > General > Accessibility > Reduce Motion

If none of the aforementioned procedures work to resolve your battery draining issues, they may need to be looked at by a professional technician to get them resolved. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who have special expertise in repairing iPhones. Our experienced technicians are located in ifixit bd service points located at 4 different points in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We care about your phone and understand its importance. That’s why we offer quick service for your ease of access. We also offer a 30-days service warranty on applicable services provided by us.

data.title: Touch Replacement
data.description:
Now you can repair your faulty touch mechanism of the iPhone Xs without having to change the entire display! Since the launch of the new iPhone X models, Apple has introduced a technology that separates the touch mechanism and upper glasses from the entire display. Therefore, users who face problems or issues in their display panels can get it looked at separately.

The iPhone XS also has a separate touch and display panel which integrates and works as a whole unit. If your phone has a faulty, unresponsive, broken, or damaged touch, you need not replace the whole display unit. ifixit bd has a dedicated service to replace or repair your touch panel (not the entire display) in-service points located all over Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Signs that indicate a faulty touch mechanism in iPhone XS are...

  • Doesn’t work or No response / Program doesn’t open or respond after touching the icon
  • Delayed response or wrong response (Clicking on one place but the phone registers the touch elsewhere and opens an unrelated app)
  • Takes multiple touch attempts to open an app or perform an action on the phone.
  • Ghost Touch / Delayed Touch issue

If you see any of the signs on your phone you can safely assume that the touch mechanism is faulty and should be replaced. Because Apple uses Haptic touch on iPhone XS and haptic touch ensures that there’s no struggle to operate the phone by touching it.

iFixit BD replaces cracked iPhone 17 Pro Max back glass panels and restores wireless charging, magnetic accessory attachment, and water resistance. This model uses an aluminium unibody housing with a separate glass panel below the camera plateau, which differs from earlier iPhones that used a full glass back.

You need this repair when the panel cracks, wireless charging stops, magnetic accessories hold weakly, or the glass separates from the frame. The wireless charging unit mounts directly to the back glass panel, so a charging fault often traces to the panel itself.

What are the common iPhone 17 Pro Max problems we fix?

Battery draining faster than expected

The A19 Pro chip under ProMotion 120Hz and 5G connectivity draws significant power. After 12–18 months of heavy use, capacity drops and you notice the phone losing charge faster and shutting off before reaching 0%. Battery replacement restores full all-day performance and is a same-day repair. iPhone 17 Pro Max battery replacement

Cracked ProMotion OLED display

The 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR ProMotion display is the most expensive single component on this phone. Even a corner drop from moderate height can crack the glass or cause OLED bleed and dead zones. We replace the full assembly with A-grade or Original panels, verify ProMotion and TrueDepth alignment post-repair. iPhone 17 Pro Max screen replacement

Titanium frame damage creating gaps

The titanium frame is harder than steel but thin at the corners. Drops on a corner edge can bend the frame and break the IP68 dust and water seal, allowing moisture and dust to reach internal components. iFixit BD's housing repair service straightens frame deformation and replaces housing when required. iPhone 17 Pro Max housing repair

Triple camera malfunction — blur, lens switching failure, overheating

The three-lens camera system with periscope telephoto is precision hardware. Impact to the camera island, moisture in the lens module, or damaged flex cables can cause blur, failure to switch between lenses, or the camera app crashing during video. We diagnose each camera module independently and replace only what is confirmed faulty. iPhone 17 Pro Max camera repair

USB-C port failing or charging intermittently

Lint, moisture, or physical damage to the USB-C port causes intermittent power delivery, slow data transfer, or no connection. We clean the port during free diagnosis first — replacement is only recommended when the flex cable itself is confirmed damaged. iPhone 17 Pro Max charging issues

Face ID not working after drop or previous repair

The TrueDepth sensor cluster in the Dynamic Island controls Face ID. A drop to the front of the device, or a screen repair elsewhere that damaged the sensor pairing, can disable Face ID. iFixit BD protects TrueDepth function during screen replacements and can diagnose sensor damage independently. iPhone 17 Pro Max Face ID issues

data.title: Audio Issue
data.description:
The iPhone 12 mini is one of the best phones in the market, considering its audio output quality. It has a dual stereo speaker with noise cancellation and spatial audio features. It has two speaker grills in the bottom part of the phone. It should be kept in mind that, the left speaker grill is not a speaker but instead it is there to catch audio inputs for your voice calls and Siri. The audio-only comes out of the right speaker grill and it is not a faulty feature.

The two speakers of the iPhone 12 mini are located on the top and the bottom of the phone. The top speaker also serves its purpose as an ear speaker when in calls. However, some users have reported a lot of different audio issues.

The most common audio issues faced by iPhone 12 mini users are:

  • No sound in audio playback
  • No sound in voice calls
  • Distorted sound/Low sound on the speakers
  • Headphones not working
  • Audio not working or audio levels low after an update.
  • Phone stuck in Headphone mode
  • Ringer Switch not working/ Audio level increases or decreases automatically/ Physical audio level buttons not working.

These issues are the most common audio issues reported by users in the Apple support forum. There are some “Do it yourself” fixes available and advised to be attempted as a “first aid” for your audio issues by Apple professionals and users. Those are:

  • Checking the ringer switch to see if it is on the sound mode
  • Restarting Your Phone
  • Disabling your Bluetooth in the iPhone 12 mini
  • Check if your phone is in DND (Do not disturb) mode
  • Check sound notification settings and try turning noise cancellation off.
  • Try using headphones and check if the sounds come okay in headphones.
  • Try removing any protective cases
  • Clean the speaker grills for dirt and debris

if none of the fixes works for your phone you need to get it checked by professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones. Phone does not turn on

The battery signal doesn’t show on the completely blacked-out phone. Therefore you can not determine the problem

iPhone won’t stay charged. The charge drains rapidly after disconnecting from the adapter.

Force restart your iPhone ( Press Volume up (+) and quickly press volume down (-) and then quickly press the power button to complete the restart process)

Check your Lightning cable and adapter to see if they are functioning properly

Check if there is any debris on the iPhone 13 Pro charging porthole

Limit background processes by stopping background app refresh

Try charging for 20 minutes while keeping your phone switched off

Sometimes excessive battery drain can happen due to a bug that can be resolved by a software update. So try updating your iOS to the latest version

data.title: Touch Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 13 Pro offers a haptic touch system instead of a 3D touch system that was available in the previous versions of the iPhones. The new haptic touch does not require assessing the strength of users like it needed to in the 3D touch system. Instead, it measures the area of your fingertips to decide the strength and length of the touch input provided by the user. This haptic touch is also a way to ensure your touch works for a long time. However, you might just face an issue anytime soon on your iPhone 13 Pro regarding your phone’s touch.

The most common issues faced by users that are reported in the iPhone 13 Pro user community forum are as follows:

Very sensitive screen/screen response intermittently (means responses without the user having to input or auto touch)

Touch screen in your iPhone does not respond at all

Delayed Touch issue

Touch doesn’t respond after dropping from hand. (Everything else seems to be working fine)

There are some fixes you might try to see if any of them work for your phone. They are listed below:

Make sure your touch screen protector doesn’t interfere with the proper operation

Make sure there’s no internal/external damage (cracking or shattering glass)

Disconnect your USB-lightning port to check if it works

If your phone is above normal temperature, wait for it to cool down and then try again

Restart your device

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get your iPhone checked by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues regarding touch on your iPhone 13 Pro. ifixit bd is located in 4 different service points. which are in convenient locations for you around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Charging Issues
data.description:
The new iPhone 13 has a beautiful battery that is optimized for using it for a reasonable amount of time. However, most of the users have complained the iPhone 13 charges very slowly in comparison to other smartphones on the market with almost the same range. The Apple company, recommends that you use an Apple 18-W USB Type-C charging brick if you face a slow charging issue. Which is the default charger with iPhone 13. Apple claims this charging brick can shoot your charging time up to 50% in 30 minutes only!

However, even with an 18-W charger, some users face issues while charging their iPhone 13. The most common issues are as follows:

The iPhone 13 charges slowly or not at all

The iPhone is not charging beyond 80 %

An alert that shows that the accessory you are using to charge the iPhone is not certified or supported

These are the most reported issues for an iPhone 13 with faulty charging. You may try some home fixes that may resolve the issues.

Try changing the wall adapter or cable

Check if there is no debris or dirt in both the charging dock and the charging adapter

Make sure the USB is connected firmly on both ends

Check the charging adapter or the lightning cable for visible signs of damage. Example: Bent pin, loose cable, etc.

if you have iOS 14 or above make sure you uncheck the “optimized battery charging” option to make sure it charges beyond 80 %.

To disable it go to: Settings > Battery > Battery Health > Optimized Battery Charging

Make sure you have no damage in your charging dock if unsupported device warning shows.

If none of the fixes seem to work for resolving your iPhone 13 charging issues. You may need to get it looked at by professionals. An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max, replaces the failed component, and verifies device function before handover. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost.   • iPhone 16 Pro Max speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.

You are asked to enter the passcode to unlock the phone by default instead of Touch ID

Can’t Register Touch ID to set up your fingerprint

Touch ID is grayed or dimmed out

Apple recommends some fixes you may try in your home which may fix the issue if it is due to a software glitch. Those fixes are:

Make sure your hands are clean and dry. Different sorts of moisturizers may affect the workability of your iPhone. (Such as Oil, lotion, sweat, or water)

Make sure your iPhone touch ID is clean and wipe it down with a lint-free cloth.

Make sure you put your entire finger on the home button to make the sensor work.

Make sure your screen protector or case is not getting in the way of touch ID

Update your iOS

Also, make sure that Touch ID does not work if you have

Restarted your phone

You haven’t unlocked your device in 48 hours

5 failed attempts to unlock the phone through touch ID.

data.description:
The new iPhone 11 pro max comes with a distinct feature named Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. This feature was made available from the iPhone X models and the later Apple A12x Bionic chipsets. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided with the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

Face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature.

Face not recognized

Face ID is not available at the moment

Move the camera a bit lower/higher

Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me into Passcode and not Face ID

These common issues however have some home remedies which may work for your iPhone. These fix attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode

if you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way

Make sure you face the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing between your face and camera region

Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy

Update your iOS to the latest version

If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID instead prompt with a passcode. The reasons may be:

The user might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone

The user may have just restarted the device

The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours

The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days

The device has not been unlocked by face ID in the last 4 hours

The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from a safe space

If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts

If at Face ID set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all

If your iPhone 11 pro max Face ID problems can’t be categorized and sorted by the above-mentioned issues and fixes, you may just need to take it to an extremely diligent iPhone technician to deal with Face ID issues. The new iPhone 14 Plus offers a set of microphones to ensure your iPhone makes the best out of the audio inputs it receives. However, it is often reported by iPhone 14 Plus users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones. Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic.

Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands.

The iPhone 14 plus has at least 3 different microphones in different places for phones for different purposes.

The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls

The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.

Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.

Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works

If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone 14 Plus go to Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

data.title: Charge Draining Issue
data.description:
The battery is optimized perfectly for the phone. However, it may be for some manufacturer error or something about some faulty apps’ optimization, you may not get the smoothest output from your iPhone XR battery.

Most users have reported that the iPhone’s battery starts draining after the system has updated to iOS 14 Several other issues may cause battery drain issues also. These issues include:

  • The battery of the iPhone XR runs out too quickly after the update
  • The battery of the iPhone XR runs out after installing an app/ update of an app.
  • The battery of the iPhone drains quickly after turning on the optimized charging mode.
  • The iPhone Battery drains after the phone heats up too quickly.

These are the most common problems regarding battery-draining found on the internet. Your issues may be one of them or not listed! However, we recommend trying some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes that may resolve your issue.

  • Turn off background iCloud/iTunes sync to save battery by a considerable amount.
  • When not in use turn off WiFi/Cellular Data/Location/Bluetooth service in your iPhone
  • Don’t overcharge/ Frequently charge your iPhone XR. It may reduce battery health.
  • Turn on optimized battery charging to save your battery life and protect it from draining.
  • Adjust your brightness settings in iPhone XR to auto-brightness.
  • Turn off Background app refresh
  • From here: Settings > general > Background app refresh
  • Try running it on low power mode
  • from here: Settings > Battery > Low power mode ON
  • Turn off “reduce motion” to turn off aesthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help
  • Turn it off from here: Settings > General > Accessibility > Reduce Motion

If none of the aforementioned procedures work to resolve your battery draining issues, they may need to be looked at by a professional technician to get them resolved. data.title: Network Problem
data.description:
The iPhone 12 comes with upgraded network connectivity than the previous iPhone models and supports 5G network connectivity. Despite these technological advancements from the previous iPhone models, users have reported issues regarding the iPhone 12’s network connectivity. Such as loss in the network, prompt disconnections, inability to find or locate the network.

The most common issues however are often discussed upon Apple’s user forum and the most common problems found regarding network in iPhone 12 are:

iPhone 12 gets down to 0 network bars randomly

Network quality drops from 4G to 2G/3G

Cannot access metered/Cellular internet connection through Carrier or the SIM Company

Network never reaches the full level


These common issues however can be a network receptor hardware glitch of the iPhone 12. To resolve these Apple recommends its iPhone 12 users some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes as a home remedy, such as:

Toggle Airplane Mode on and off to reset the previous network settings and cache

Remove your sim card and reinstall it again. (requires a restart of the device)

Set up the internet for your phone if you’re facing internet issues through the network for the first time.

To set up go to Settings > Mobile Data > Mobile Data Network

Then:

Insert APN (Access Point Name) provided by your carrier

Insert Username (provided by your carrier)

Insert Password (provided by your carrier)

Save the settings by pressing the left arrow at the top.

Make sure your Data connection is on after setting up the network before you access the internet.

Install carrier update for your iPhone (Check-in Settings > General > About)

Restart your iPhone

Soft reset your iPhone

If none of the solutions work for your iPhone, you might need your phone to get checked by a professional technician. data.title: Charging Issues
data.description:
The new iPhone XR has a beautiful battery that is optimized for using it for a reasonable amount of time. However, most of the users have complained the iPhone XR charges very slowly in comparison to other smartphones on the market with almost the same range.

However, some users face issues while charging their iPhone XR. The most common issues are as follows...

  • The iPhone XR charges slowly or not at all.
  • The iPhone is not charging beyond 80 %.
  • An alert that shows that the accessory you are using to charge the iPhone is not certified or supported.

These are the most reported issues for an iPhone XR with faulty charging. You may try some home fixes that may resolve the issues.

  • Try changing the wall adapter or cable.
  • Check if there is no debris or dirt in both the charging dock and the charging adapter.
  • Make sure the USB is connected firmly on both ends.
  • Check the charging adapter or the Lightning cable for visible signs of damage. Example: bent pin, loose cable, etc.
  • If you have iOS 14 or above, make sure you uncheck the “optimized battery charging” option to make sure it charges beyond 80 %.
  • To disable it, go to Settings > Battery > Battery Health > Optimized Battery Charging.

Make sure you have no damage in your charging dock if an unsupported device warning shows. If none of the fixes seem to work for resolving your iPhone XR charging issues. Mechanical failure, touch sensor degradation, and broken pairing from prior repairs all cause Touch ID failure. iFixit BD restores Touch ID function where the board-level pairing is intact. iPhone 6 Plus home button / Touch ID repair

data.title: Charging Dock Replacement
data.description:
The new iPhone XS comes with a Lightning port, which is one of the most important parts of the smartphone. It can be charged with a lightning cable and charges at a whopping 18 watts (fast charging). This can charge your phone to 50 percent in 30 minutes. And it can also be used as a USB 2.0 port. However, after using the phone for a long time or by an accident, your charging dock of the phone may get faulty or damaged, and you might need to get it replaced.

  • The most common issues of the iPhone XS charging dock are
  • The battery charges very slowly.
  • iPhone XS not charging beyond 80 %.
  • Charging Not available or liquid has been detected in the charging port error.
  • The charging dock can’t be connected to a USB-supported device through the lightning cable.

If your phone has any one of these issues or something not mentioned in the list of the common issues,. You will still like to check out these DIY (do it yourself) fixes, which may solve the problem regarding the charging dock in your iPhone XS.

  • Make sure you don’t have any debris or dirt on your charging dock. This may prevent charging.
  • Make sure your power outlet isn’t faulty.
  • Make sure you do not have the “optimized battery charging” option checked on your iPhone XS. if you do have it make sure to disable it to charge your phone past 80%.
  • Disable optimized Charging in here: Settings > Battery > Battery Health.

Note: This option is only available on iOS 13 or later updates.

If your phone is wet, wait until it is dry to charge your phone. If none of the fixes cut it for you, you may need to get your phone looked at by professionals. We perform ultrasonic board cleaning using professional ultrasonic equipment and isopropyl alcohol (90%+) to remove corrosive mineral deposits before they cause permanent component failure. iPhone 6 liquid damage repair]

data.description:
The new iPhone 14 Pro Max offers its users better optimization and balance in software than the previous iPhone models. However, no matter hard they try there can always be some technical issues that can result in your iPhone malfunctioning. The Apple logo stuck issue was also found in previous iPhones and it’s a frustrating issue. Your iPhone boots up, but instead of going to the home screen, it is stuck on the boot menu. This problem happens mainly/most of the time because of a software issue that happens due to an unclean or interrupted update.

This Stuck on Apple logo issue might happen in other instances too. Possible reasons might be:

The iPhone has taken some physical damage. (Dropping from hand)

Update was disrupted due to Wi-Fi disturbance/metered connection or cellular data loss

A third-party app may have access to vital permissions that can disrupt iPhones' productivity

It is rare, however, your phone might be facing a hardware issue. Sometimes faulty hardware prevents the phone from booting up

These issues however can be resolved if it is just a bug or a glitch in the iOS software. You may try the following steps and see if it works for you.

Force Restart your iPhone 14 Pro Max

(Press volume up (+) and then quickly press the volume down (-) button and hold the iPhone 14 Pro Max power button as long as the apple logo appears again)

Update your iOS Software.

(If, while in the progress of updating your software, the progress bar under the Apple logo has not moved for an hour, You may connect your iPhone to a PC and select “Update” when prompted)

Remove all third-party apps from your phone. Install Apps only from the Apple App store

Turn off the auto-update of your iOS apps to prevent further interruptions. But be sure to update them on a regular basis manually.

If none of the fixes above work, for you. You might have an issue that needs the touch of a professional iPhone technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in fixing iPhones. ifixit bd is a prominent iPhone servicing center that is located in 4 locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 offers a set of microphones to ensure your iPhone makes the best out of the audio inputs it receives. The iPhone offers the users a dual speaker and microphone to ensure the best listening experience for their users. However, it is often reported by iPhone 11 users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones. The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are:

  • Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/ voice memos.
  • Low or unclear voice in Facetime, skype, or video recording.
  • Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic.
  • Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands.

The iPhone 11 has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes.

The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls

One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri

The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

  • Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.
  • Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.
  • Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works
  • If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone 11
  • go to Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues in your iPhone 11.

data.description:
Sometimes when you update your iPhone, or when you try to run your phone you may see some sort of black screen with some sort of Error with a number on your iPhone’s screen out of nowhere. These messages with errors and numbers can be seen while booting up the phone or trying to upgrade the IPSW files from iTunes from a PC. These are Error Codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy. They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen on iPhones are as follows:

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error codes – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

To check if your iPhone is updated

If the update still fails try updating it from another pc

To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)

Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.

Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info page with possible DIY (Do it yourself) solutions. However, not all problems can be fixed only by DIY fixes. Some errors might require some handy work around the inner parts of the phone which should be done by a professional iPhone technician.

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
The new iPhone 8 plus is not a standard IP68 rated, dust and water-resistant phone. Which means it can not resist dust and water coming in up to it. However, it can resist certain levels of water. Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water.

However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

  • If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:
  • Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth
  • You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there.
  • NEVER CHARGE YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU HAVE MADE SURE IT IS COMPLETELY DRY
  • If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth.
  • If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers.

then:

Restart your iPhone

Cracked LCD screen

Battery draining faster than expected

We replace the full assembly with A-grade or Original panels, verify ProMotion and TrueDepth alignment post-repair. iPhone 17 Pro Max screen replacement

Titanium frame damage creating gaps

The titanium frame is harder than steel but thin at the corners. Drops on a corner edge can bend the frame and break the IP68 dust and water seal, allowing moisture and dust to reach internal components. iFixit BD's housing repair service straightens frame deformation and replaces housing when required. iPhone 17 Pro Max housing repair

Triple camera malfunction — blur, lens switching failure, overheating

The three-lens camera system with periscope telephoto is precision hardware. Impact to the camera island, moisture in the lens module, or damaged flex cables can cause blur, failure to switch between lenses, or the camera app crashing during video. We diagnose each camera module independently and replace only what is confirmed faulty. iPhone 17 Pro Max camera repair

USB-C port failing or charging intermittently

Lint, moisture, or physical damage to the USB-C port causes intermittent power delivery, slow data transfer, or no connection. We clean the port during free diagnosis first — replacement is only recommended when the flex cable itself is confirmed damaged. iPhone 17 Pro Max charging issues

However, sometimes a user may face some unforeseen problems. Like the Boot loop in this instance, where the phone starts and shows the Apple logo. Then goes black and again shows only the apple logo on the screen, the phone can show nothing beyond that.

This issue happens mostly when there is a failed or interrupted software update happens on your phone. Also, other issues may cause your phone to boot loop such as:

Physical Damage (Dropping the phone from your hand, etc.)

The battery connector may have gotten loose or have gone bad.

Hardware Damage.

Improper or failed update that is missing necessary files to get the phone started.

If you think one of the above issues is causing the boot looping error on your phone, you may just try these fixes listed below and see if they work to resolve your issue.

Force Restart Your iPhone 12

(press the volume up button (+) then release the button. And then quickly press and release the volume down (-) and then hold the power button again until your screen turns black and shows the apple logo)

Check if your iPhone is fully charged or is charging properly.

Connect your iPhone to your computer and try restoring or updating the software through the iTunes application.

If your phone still doesn’t recover from boot looing after trying these fixes, something may have gone wrong which can only be fixed by a professional iPhone technician.

Apple has introduced an exclusive feature of Touch ID since the iPhone 5s. It is a fingerprint sensor that lets users of the iPhone SE- 2020 unlock their iPhone without having to put in a passcode every time they do so. Touch ID can be used as a payment method for Apple services and is a very secure way of ensuring payments too. However, like all the other technical difficulties you may face in your iPhone; your fingerprint/touch-id may cause an error in its operation. The touch ID problem is quite a common problem seen in the iPhone’s list of problems.

The most common issues faced regarding touch ID are:

You are asked to enter the passcode to unlock the phone by default instead of Touch ID

You can not avail of Apple Payment by touch-ID.

Can’t Register Touch ID to set up your fingerprint.

Touch ID is grayed or dimmed out.

Apple recommends some fixes you may try in your home which may fix the issue if it is due to a software glitch. Those fixes are:

Make sure your hands are clean and dry. Different sorts of moisturizers may affect the workability of your iPhone. (Such as Oil, lotion, sweat, or water)

Make sure your iPhone touch ID is clean and wipe it down with a lint-free cloth.

Make sure you put your entire finger on the home button to make the sensor work.

Make sure your screen protector or case is not getting in the way of touch ID

Update your iOS

Also, make sure that Touch ID does not work if you have...

Restarted your phone

You haven’t unlocked your device in 48 hours

5 failed attempts to unlock the phone through touch ID.

data.title: Error Solution
data.description:
Sometimes when you update your iPhone, or when you try to run your phone you may see some sort of black screen with some sort of Error with a number on your iPhone’s screen out of nowhere. These messages with errors and numbers can be seen while booting up the phone or trying to upgrade the IPSW files from iTunes from a PC. These are Error Codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy. They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen on iPhones are as follows:

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error codes – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

To check if your iPhone is updated

If the update still fails try updating it from another pc

To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)

Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.

Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info page with possible DIY (Do it yourself) solutions. However, not all problems can be fixed only by DIY fixes. Some errors might require some handy work around the inner parts of the phone which should be done by a professional iPhone technician.

data.title: Boot Loop
data.description:
The iPhone 13 Pro Max offers the users a new iOS version (iOS 13 upgradable to iOS 14) and updates it forward. Users need to update iOS regularly to maintain the stable and smooth operation of the iPhone. However, sometimes a user may face some unforeseen problems. Like the Boot loop in this instance, where the phone starts and shows the Apple logo. Then goes black and again shows only the apple logo on the screen, the phone can show nothing beyond that.

This issue happens mostly when there is a failed or interrupted software update happens on your phone. Also, other issues may cause your phone to boot loop such as:

Physical Damage (Dropping the phone from your hand, etc.)

The battery connector may have gotten loose or have gone bad.

Hardware Damage.

Improper or failed update that is missing necessary files to get the phone started.

If you think one of the above issues is causing the boot looping error on your phone, you may just try these fixes listed below and see if they work to resolve your issue.

Force Restart Your iPhone 13 Pro Max

(press the volume up button (+) then release the button. And then quickly press and release the volume down (-) and then hold the power button again until your screen turns black and shows the apple logo)

Check if your iPhone is fully charged or is charging properly.

Connect your iPhone to your computer and try restoring or updating the software through the iTunes application.

If your phone still doesn’t recover from boot looing after trying these fixes, something may have gone wrong which can only be fixed by a professional iPhone technician. This is where ifixit bd comes in, ifixit bd is a prominent iPhone servicing center that has 4 different service points ranging in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones.
