data.title: Button Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 15 Pro Max has 3 physical buttons and 1 switch to ensure maximum accessibility to its users. The buttons and the switches are:

Volume Up (+) button

Volume down (-) button

Ringer Switch

Power Button

Newer iPhone models have discontinued the Home button, which used to serve both the purpose of a home button and a fingerprint sensor. Apple has discontinued Home Buttons since the iPhone X models and has continued on the same policy till now. The iPhone 15 Pro Max has no home buttons. Instead, it has a Face ID or face unlock feature. Now with time, the buttons of your iPhone 15 Pro Max may face wear and tear and may cease to function properly. The most common issues faced regarding the buttons of smartphones are:

The Sound doesn’t increase/decrease when I press the volume up or down key

The buttons are stuck and can’t be pressed

The switch doesn’t work/automatically switches between ringer and silent mode

These are the most common issues regarding the physical buttons in the iPhone. However, Apple recommends restarting the device and updating the iOS in this case. If this still does not fix the issue, it needs to be getting looked at by professionals. iPhone recommends using Assistive touch for the longevity of the physical buttons of the iPhone 15 Pro Max.

Here at iFixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who are familiar with iPhone problems and excel in resolving them. iFixit BD has located service points across Dhaka, Bangladesh. We offer quick service for your ease of access.

data.title: Face ID Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 12 comes with a distinct feature named Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. This feature was made available from the iPhone X models and the later Apple A12x Bionic chipsets. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided with the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

  • The face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature.

Face not recognized

Face ID is not available at the moment

Move the camera a bit lower/higher

Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me into Passcode and not Face ID

  • These common issues however have some home remedies which may work for your iPhone. These fix attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode

if you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way

Make sure you face the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing between your face and camera region

Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy

Update your iOS to the latest version

  • If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID instead prompt with a passcode. The reasons may be:

User might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone

The user may have just restarted the device

The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours

The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days

The device has not been unlocked by face ID in the last 4 hours

The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from a safe space

If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts

If at Face ID set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all

If your iPhone 12 Face ID problems can’t be categorized and sorted by the above-mentioned issues and fixes, you may just need to take it to an extremely diligent iPhone technician to deal with Face ID issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in issues regarding your iPhone 12. ifixit bd is located in four different locations across Dhaka, Bangladesh.

  • We provide the best service regarding your iPhone. We offer service benefits like no one else. Like:

Free Diagnostics

Quick Repair Service on Applicable issues

30-days service warranty on selected services

Money-Back guarantee

So to avail of the specialized services that we guarantee no one can provide in context to iPhone 12 Face ID and any other iPhone issues, visit your nearest ifixit bd service point today!

iPhone 16e Repair Service in Bangladesh

An iPhone 16e repair service restores your handset to full working order through diagnostics, part replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, and motherboard repair.

Repair costs in Bangladesh sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a speaker swap cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an original display replacement cost the most.

Most repairs finish the same day. Motherboard and water damage work runs longer because it needs board-level diagnosis.

You pick your display grade before work starts. Original, OEM-grade, high-quality after-market soft, high-quality after-market hard, and copy displays each carry a different price — and a different warranty period.

Our Dhaka service center covers Dhanmondi, Gulshan, Uttara, Mirpur, Motijheel, and Panthapath, with courier pickup for Chattogram and Sylhet. Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic.

What does our iPhone 16e repair service cover?

An iPhone 16e repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16e, replaces the failed part, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults on the A18 chip platform. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired part and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16e repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16e screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.1-inch OLED display assembly and calibrates brightness, color, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16e battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16e charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16e back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked matte back glass and reseals the aluminium frame so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16e camera repair — Replaces the single rear camera module or the front camera assembly when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16e facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16e speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16e microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16e water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16e motherboard repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.

How much does an iPhone 16e repair cost?

An iPhone 16e repair costs between BDT 1,500 and BDT 32,000, depending on the failed part and the grade you select. The failed component sets the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Entry-level repairs cost between BDT 1,500 and BDT 4,500. This tier covers speaker replacement, microphone replacement, charging port cleaning, action button repair, and software fault recovery. These repairs use low-cost components and finish within a single visit.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 5,000 and BDT 14,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 15,000 and BDT 32,000. This tier covers original display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and motherboard repair. Original display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest part and labor cost on the iPhone 16e.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16e screen replacement cost in Bangladesh?

An iPhone 16e screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 26,000 in Bangladesh, depending on the display grade you select. The display assembly is the most expensive single part in the device, and the local market supplies five grades at five price points. A display assembly charge covers fitting and calibration and appears as a separate line on your quotation.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 11,000. This tier uses a copy display or a high quality after-market hard display that restores picture and touch at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 12,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier uses a high quality after-market soft display or an OEM-grade display, both of which reproduce OLED contrast and match original touch sensitivity.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 19,000 and BDT 26,000. This tier uses an original display pulled from a genuine device, which preserves factory color accuracy, brightness range, and True Tone behavior.

You keep Face ID after any of these five grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

Which display grades are available for an iPhone 16e repair?

The display grades available for an iPhone 16e repair are listed below.

  • Original display pulled from a genuine device — Factory Apple panel with original color accuracy, peak brightness, and True Tone support.
  • Original equipment manufacturer grade display — Panel built to Apple specification by the same supply chain, matching original tolerances.
  • High quality after-market display, soft variant — Flexible OLED panel with strong contrast, deep blacks, and accurate touch response.
  • High quality after-market display, hard variant — Rigid OLED panel offering durable construction and reliable daily performance at moderate cost.
  • Copy display — Budget replacement panel that restores picture output and touch function at the lowest price point.

You confirm the display grade in writing before the repair begins, so the quoted price and the fitted panel always match. A display assembly charge is added separately to the part price and covers fitting, sealing, and calibration. The warranty period differs by display grade, with original and OEM-grade panels carrying the longest coverage. Adaptive color temperature data transfers from your original display where the feature remains active after the swap.

How long does an iPhone 16e repair take in iFixit BD?

An iPhone 16e repair takes 30 minutes to 5 working days. Component replacements finish within the same day, while board-level work extends across several days. Turnaround depends on display grade availability in the local market, so a stocked after-market panel fits faster than a special-order original display. Motherboard repair and water damage repair take longer than component replacement, because both require circuit-level diagnosis, ultrasonic cleaning, micro-soldering, and staged testing between each step. Customers outside Dhaka add 1 to 3 days of courier transit time to every figure below.

Does an iPhone 16e repair include a warranty in iFixit Bangladesh?

Yes, an iPhone 16e repair includes a warranty in Bangladesh. Every repair carries parts and labor coverage that runs from the collection date. The warranty period varies by display grade, with original and OEM-grade panels carrying longer coverage than after-market and copy panels. Coverage applies to the specific part replaced, and the service desk records the covered part and the period on your invoice at handover.

How do you book an iPhone 16e repair service?

You book an iPhone 16e repair service by describing the fault, requesting a free diagnostic, approving the written quotation, and confirming a collection time. The process moves from fault description to device collection in six steps, and each step produces a written record you keep. Contact the service center by phone or message to reserve a slot, or visit during service hours for stocked repairs. Walk-in service runs 7 days a week, and booking ahead reserves the specific display grade your repair requires. You back up the device to iCloud or a computer before handover, since board-level and water damage repairs sometimes affect stored data. Customers outside Dhaka use courier pickup and delivery, with payment by mobile financial service or cash on delivery.

The steps to book an iPhone 16e repair service are outlined below.

  1. Describe the fault and request a free diagnostic — Report the symptom by phone, message, or in person, and the technician runs Apple Diagnostics to identify the failed part.
  2. Receive a written quotation and turnaround estimate — Review the itemized cost, the display assembly charge, and the completion time before you approve any work.
  3. Select the display grade and warranty period — Choose from original, OEM-grade, after-market soft, after-market hard, or copy displays, each with its own coverage term.

data.title: Audio Issue
data.description:
The iPhone X is one of the best phones in the market, considering its audio output quality. It has a dual stereo speaker with noise cancellation and spatial audio features. It has two speaker grills in the bottom part of the phone. It should be kept in mind that, the left speaker grill is not a speaker but instead it is there to catch audio inputs for your voice calls and Siri. The audio-only comes out of the right speaker grill and it is not a faulty feature. The two speakers of the iPhone X are located on the top and the bottom of the phone. The top speaker also serves its purpose as an ear speaker when in calls.

However, some users have reported a lot of different audio issues. The most common audio issues faced by iPhone X users are:

  • No sound in audio playback
  • No sound in voice calls
  • Distorted sound/Low sound on the speakers
  • Headphones not working
  • Audio not working or audio levels low after an update.
  • Phone stuck in Headphone mode
  • Ringer Switch not working/ Audio level increases or decreases automatically/ Physical audio level buttons not working.

These issues are the most common audio issues reported by users in the Apple support forum. There are some “Do it yourself” fixes available and advised to be attempted as a “first aid” for your audio issues by Apple professionals and users. Those are:

  • Checking the ringer switch to see if it is on the sound mode
  • Restarting Your Phone
  • Disabling your Bluetooth in the iPhone X
  • Check if your phone is in DND (Do not disturb) mode
  • Check sound notification settings and try turning noise cancellation off.
  • Try using headphones and check if the sounds come okay in headphones.
  • Try removing any protective cases
  • Clean the speaker grills for dirt and debris

if none of the fixes works for your phone you need to get it checked by professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones. In ifixit bd, we have experienced technicians who specialize in repairing iPhone X. Our service points are located at locations in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We also offer quick service for your ease of access and on top of that, a 30-days warranty on applicable services you receive from ifixit bd. We do not compromise your phone’s well-being and use genuine Apple parts for the repair and replacement of your iPhone issues. Visit your nearest ifixit bd service point for fixing your iPhone X’s audio or any other issues.

data.title: No Modem Firmware
data.description:
It is quite frustrating when you see there’s no network bar/ Wi-Fi signal strong enough near you. We use our phones mostly to stay connected with others most of the time, and problems like that keep us from staying connected. You may face a similar kind of problem with your iPhone 13. This usually happens after a faulty or incomplete update where you might see this:

  • There’s no network bar available at the top of the display. Restarting or reinstalling the SIM card doesn’t help. There is always “Searching” shown on the network bar.
  • There is no Cellular connection available for your phone. You can’t turn on, discover, or connect to available wireless Hotspot networks available near you through your iPhone 13
  • You can’t connect to your Bluetooth devices like Apple Watch, Bluetooth headphones, and stereo speakers through your phone. It appears that you cannot connect to anything wireless through your iPhone 13 

If you are facing this issue go to Settings > General > About and see if you can find information regarding IMEI, Bluetooth location, Modem Firmware, etc. If there is nothing there then you are having an issue with the modem firmware There are no DIY (Do It Yourself) fixes available for this issue. You are going to be needing to take your iPhone 13 to an expert repair technician to resolve the “No modem firmware” issue. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in resolving this issue with your iPhone 13 and other issues regarding your iPhone. ifixit bd is located at 4 different service points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Wifi Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 has a new wireless firmware that can support up to 7GHz of wireless bandwidth speed. This gives the users unmatched speed in comparison to most of the smartphones in the market. However, there have been issues regarding the Wi-Fi of the iPhone 11. And frankly, some users have taken issue with the phone saying that the phone disconnects from the wireless network frequently and without any warning.

Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most common reported iPhone 11 Wi-Fi issues are…

  • Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone 11.
  • Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver.
  • Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi.
  • High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections
  • iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi
  • iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection.

These Wi-Fi issues found on iPhone 11 are pretty common issues found on other wireless supported devices too! And does not necessarily indicate that there is something specifically wrong with your iPhone 11’s wireless hardware. There are some DIY(Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

  • Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issues have been resolved.
  • Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again.
  • Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection.
  • Restore the default network connection
  • ( Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)
  • Update your iOS to the latest version available.

If none of the solutions mentioned above works to resolve your Wi-Fi issues on your iPhone 11, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. data.description:
The new iPhone 11 pro max offers one of the best displays consisting of a Super AMOLED retina display and a significantly high DPI. It has also ensured maximum safety for its users by putting gorilla glass in both back and front. However, not all damage in display comes from dropping the device from the hands and shattering it. Some users of the iPhone 11 pro max have reported a sudden black screen without any prior damage history. The No light on Display issue of the iPhone 11 pro max is where the user can’t see what’s happening on the phone. The phone runs okay. The phone vibrates and the user can hear the notification sounds and other inputs.

But the problem is they can not see any of it because the phone display is just plain black. But the phone will respond or might even have incoming calls.

The key symptoms of the “No light on Display” issues are:

  • The Phone display boots up with an Apple logo but doesn’t get past the black screen (iPhone 6 – 8Plus) 
  • The phone has calls, notifications but doesn’t show anything on display
  • iPhone can charge (you can hear the sound that the phone makes while charging) but won’t show anything on the display
  • This “No light on display” is usually an internal issue with the LCD connector. However, Apple recommends some processes to practice on your phone to make sure the black screen is not a software glitch.
  • Force Restart your iPhone. (Press the volume up (+) and volume down (-) and then press and hold the power button until the Apple logo appears on the screen) 
  • Connect the lightning cable, charge it for 10 minutes. Then try force restarting the iPhone
  • UNCONVENTIONAL: But press the screen into the phone so it may reconnect any dislodged LCD connector. This fix is not recommended however it resolved a lot of the user's Black Display issue. It might be risky for any layman person. 

If none of the fixes work to resolve the issue on your iPhone, you may need to get it looked at by experienced professionals who specialize in iPhone issues. MacBook Air 13 inch M1 OS installation in Bangladesh

MacBook Air 13 inch M1 OS installation is the professional process of installing, reinstalling, or upgrading macOS on a MacBook Air A2337 to restore normal operation, fix software corruption, or set up the device fresh. OS installation is needed when the MacBook Air M1 will not boot, runs slowly after a failed update, has malware, or is being prepared for resale. Four installation types are available: reinstall, upgrade, erase-and-reinstall, and DFU restore. Professional OS installation service in Bangladesh costs 1,500 to 5,000 BDT depending on the type. ifixit BD and certified service centers in Dhaka handle all macOS versions, from macOS 11 Big Sur to macOS 15 Sequoia, with same-day turnaround for standard installs.

What is MacBook Air 13 inch M1 OS installation?

MacBook Air 13 inch M1 OS installation is the process of installing, reinstalling, or upgrading macOS on a MacBook Air A2337 (Late 2020) — either through macOS Recovery, Internet Recovery, or DFU mode — to restore normal system operation, fix software problems, or set up the laptop from scratch. The MacBook Air M1 uses the Apple Silicon M1 chip, a Secure Enclave, and a unified memory architecture — and this design makes its macOS installation process different from older Intel MacBooks in one important way. A standard macOS reinstall or upgrade is done through macOS Recovery or Internet Recovery, the same as on Intel Macs. However, a DFU mode restore on the MacBook Air M1 requires Apple Configurator 2 running on a second Mac connected by USB-C — this is not needed on Intel models and makes deep system restores on the A2337 significantly more complex. Because of this M1-specific requirement, professional OS installation service at a Dhaka service center is the safest and fastest route for most users.

data.title: Charging Dock Replacement
data.description:
The most common issues with the iPhone 16 Plus charging dock are:

The battery charges very slowly

iPhone 16 Plus is not charging beyond 80%

Charging Not available or Liquid has been detected in the charging port error

The charging dock can’t be connected to a USB-supported device through a lightning cable

If your phone has any one of these issues or something not mentioned in the list of common issues. You will still like to check out this DIY (Do it yourself) fixes that may solve the problem regarding the charging dock in your iPhone 16 Plus.

Make sure your power outlet isn’t faulty

If your phone is wet, wait until it is dry to charge your phone

Make sure you don’t have any debris or dirt on your charging dock. This may prevent charging

Make sure you do not have the “optimized battery charging” option checked on your iPhone 16 Plus. if you do have it, make sure to disable it to charge your phone past 80%

data.description:
The new iPhone 8 has a new wireless firmware that can support a high range of wireless bandwidth speed. This gives the users unmatched speed in comparison to most of the smartphones in the market. However, there have been issues regarding the Wi-Fi of the iPhone 8. And frankly, some users have taken issue with the phone saying that the phone disconnects from the wireless network frequently and without any warning.

Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most common reported iPhone 8 Wi-Fi issues are...

  • Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone 8.
  • Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver.
  • Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi.
  • High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections
  • iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi
  • iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection.

  • Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again.
  • Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection.
  • Restore the default network connection

( Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)

The iPhone has caused some physical damage. (Dropping from hand)

Force Restart your iPhone 13 Pro Max

Remove all third-party apps from your phone. Install Apps only from the Apple App store

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water. However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:

Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth

Never change your phone until you have made sure it is completelty dry

You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there.

If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth. If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers. data.title: Charging Issues
data.description:
The new iPhone 14 Plus has a beautiful battery that is optimized for using it for a reasonable amount of time. However, most of the users have complained the iPhone 14 Plus charges very slowly in comparison to other smartphones on the market with almost the same range. The Apple company, recommends that you use an Apple 18-W USB Type-C charging brick if you face a slow charging issue. Which is the default charger with iPhone 14 Plus. Apple claims this charging brick can shoot your charging time up to 50% in 30 minutes only!

However, even with an 18-W charger, some users face issues while charging their iPhone 14 Plus. The most common issues are as follows:

The iPhone 14 Plus charges slowly or not at all

The iPhone is not charging beyond 80 %

An alert that shows that the accessory you are using to charge the iPhone is not certified or supported

These are the most reported issues for an iPhone 14 Plus with faulty charging. You may try some home fixes that may resolve the issues.

Try changing the wall adapter or cable

Check if there is no debris or dirt in both the charging dock and the charging adapter

Make sure the USB is connected firmly on both ends

Check the charging adapter or the lightning cable for visible signs of damage. Example: Bent pin, loose cable, etc.

if you have iOS 14 Plus or above make sure you uncheck the “optimized battery charging” option to make sure it charges beyond 80 %.To disable it go to: Settings > Battery > Battery Health > Optimized Battery Charging

Make sure you have no damage in your charging dock if unsupported device warning shows.

If none of the fixes seem to work for resolving your iPhone 11 pro charging issues. You may need to get it looked at by professionals. iPhone 16e Repair Service in Bangladesh

An iPhone 16e repair service restores your handset to full working order through diagnostics, part replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, and motherboard repair.

Repair costs in Bangladesh sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a speaker swap cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an original display replacement cost the most.

Most repairs finish the same day. Motherboard and water damage work runs longer because it needs board-level diagnosis.

You pick your display grade before work starts. Original, OEM-grade, high-quality after-market soft, high-quality after-market hard, and copy displays each carry a different price — and a different warranty period.

Our Dhaka service center covers Dhanmondi, Gulshan, Uttara, Mirpur, Motijheel, and Panthapath, with courier pickup for Chattogram and Sylhet. Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic.

What does our iPhone 16e repair service cover?

An iPhone 16e repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16e, replaces the failed part, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults on the A18 chip platform. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired part and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16e repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16e screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.1-inch OLED display assembly and calibrates brightness, color, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16e battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16e charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16e back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked matte back glass and reseals the aluminium frame so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16e camera repair — Replaces the single rear camera module or the front camera assembly when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16e facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16e speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16e microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16e water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16e motherboard repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.

How much does an iPhone 16e repair cost?

An iPhone 16e repair costs between BDT 1,500 and BDT 32,000, depending on the failed part and the grade you select. The failed component sets the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Entry-level repairs cost between BDT 1,500 and BDT 4,500. This tier covers speaker replacement, microphone replacement, charging port cleaning, action button repair, and software fault recovery. These repairs use low-cost components and finish within a single visit.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 5,000 and BDT 14,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 15,000 and BDT 32,000. This tier covers original display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and motherboard repair. Original display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest part and labor cost on the iPhone 16e.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16e screen replacement cost in Bangladesh?

An iPhone 16e screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 26,000 in Bangladesh, depending on the display grade you select. The display assembly is the most expensive single part in the device, and the local market supplies five grades at five price points. A display assembly charge covers fitting and calibration and appears as a separate line on your quotation.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 11,000. This tier uses a copy display or a high quality after-market hard display that restores picture and touch at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 12,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier uses a high quality after-market soft display or an OEM-grade display, both of which reproduce OLED contrast and match original touch sensitivity.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 19,000 and BDT 26,000. This tier uses an original display pulled from a genuine device, which preserves factory color accuracy, brightness range, and True Tone behavior.

You keep Face ID after any of these five grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

  • Copy display — Budget replacement panel that restores picture output and touch function at the lowest price point.

You confirm the display grade in writing before the repair begins, so the quoted price and the fitted panel always match. data.title: Power Issue
data.description:
The iPhone 12 comes with a 3969 MAh battery, which can support 18 Watt fast charging. To maintain the sleek and uniform design, Apple provided a power button at the side of the device. This correlation between the power button and the Battery is unavoidable for the perfect operation of the iPhone. The iPhone has been designed to maintain it. However, many users have complained about issues regarding issues in their power supply and other power-related errors in their iPhones.

These power issues include:

The Phone does not turn on

The battery signal doesn’t show on the completely blacked-out phone. Therefore you can not determine the problem

iPhone won’t stay charged. The charge drains rapidly after disconnecting from the adapter.

iPhone doesn’t charge. It is stuck on the battery percentage you left it to charge on.

Can’t use the iPhone without keeping it on a constant power supply (eg: Connected to a wall adapter or power bank etc.


These frustrating problems are however the most common issues found on iPhone 12. There are some widely renowned DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available on the internet which may help the issue on your device. Such as...

Force restarting your iPhone ( Press Volume up (+) and quickly press volume down (-) and then quickly press the power button to complete the restart process)

Check Your Lightning cable and adapter and see if they are functioning properly

Check if there is any debris on the iPhone 12 charging porthole

Limit background processes by stopping the background app refresh

Try charging 20 minutes while keeping your phone switched off

Sometimes excessive battery drain can be happening due to a bug that can be resolved by a software update. So try updating your iOS to the latest version

If none of these methods work to resolve the issues on your smartphone, you might need to get it checked by professional technicians. data.title: Charge Draining Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone comes with an almost 4323 mAh battery. The battery is optimized perfectly for the phone. However, it may be for some manufacturer error or something about some faulty app optimization, you may not get the smoothest output from your iPhone 14 Plus battery. Most users have reported that the iPhone’s battery starts draining after the system has updated to iOS 14 Plus Several other issues may cause battery drain issues also. These issues include:

The battery of the iPhone 14 Plus runs out too quickly after the update

The battery of the iPhone 14 Plus runs out after installing an app/ update an app

The battery of the iPhone drains quickly after turning on the optimized charging mode

The iPhone Battery drains after the phone heats up too quickly

These are the most common problems regarding battery draining found on the internet. Your issues may be one of them or not listed! However, we recommend trying some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes that may resolve your issue.

Turn off background iCloud/iTunes sync to save battery by a considerable amount

When not in use turn off WiFi/Cellular Data/Location/Bluetooth service in your iPhone

Don’t overcharge/ Frequently charge your iPhone 14 Plus. It may reduce battery health

Turn on optimized battery charging to save your battery life and protect it from draining

Adjust your brightness settings in iPhone 14 Plus to auto-brightness

Turn off Background app refresh From here: Settings > general > Background app refresh

Try running it on low power mode from here: Settings > Battery > Low power mode ON

Turn off “reduce motion” to turn off aesthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help Turn it off from here: Settings > General > Accessibility > Reduce Motion

data.title: Power Issue
data.description:
This correlation between the power button and the Battery is unavoidable for the perfect operation of the iPhone. The iPhone has been designed to maintain it. However, many users have complained about issues regarding issues in their power supply and other power-related errors in their iPhones.

These power issues include:

  • The Phone does not turn on
  • The battery signal doesn’t show on the completely blacked out phone. Therefore you can not determine the problem
  • iPhone won’t stay charged. The charge drains rapidly after disconnecting from the adapter
  • iPhone doesn’t charge. It is stuck on the battery percentage you left it to charge on
  • Can’t use the iPhone without keeping it on a constant power supply (eg: Connected to a wall adapter or power bank etc)

These frustrating problems are however the most common issues found on iPhone 11 pro. There are some widely renowned DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available on the internet which may help the issue on your device. Such as...

  • Force restarting your iPhone ( Press Volume up (+) and quickly press volume down (-) and then quickly press the power button to complete the restart process)
  • Check Your Lightning cable and adapter and see if they are functioning properly
  • Check if there is any debris on the iPhone 11 pro charging porthole
  • Limit background processes by stopping the background app refresh
  • Try charging 20 minutes while keeping your phone switched off
  • Sometimes excessive battery drain can be happening due to a bug that can be resolved by a software update. So try updating your iOS to the latest version

data.title: Boot Loop
data.description:
Users need to update iOS regularly to maintain the stable and smooth operation of the iPhone. However, sometimes a user may face some unforeseen problems. Like the boot loop in this instance, where the phone starts and shows the Apple logo. Then it goes black and again shows only the Apple logo on the screen; the phone can show nothing beyond that.

This issue happens mostly when there is a failed or interrupted software update on your phone. Also, other issues may cause your phone to boot loop, such as

  • Physical Damage (Dropping the phone from your hand, etc.)
  • The battery connector may have gotten loose or have gone bad.
  • Hardware Damage.
  • Improper or failed update that is missing necessary files to get the phone started.

  • If you think one of the above issues is causing the boot looping error on your phone, you may just try these fixes listed below and see if they work to resolve your issue.
  • Force Restart Your iPhone XS MAX
  • (Press the volume up button, (+) then release the button. And then quickly press and release the volume down button (-) and then hold the power button again until your screen turns black and shows the Apple logo.
  • Check if your iPhone is fully charged or is charging properly.
  • Connect your iPhone to your computer and try restoring or updating the software through the iTunes application.

If your phone still doesn’t recover from boot looping after trying these fixes, something may have gone wrong that can only be fixed by a professional iPhone technician. This is where iFixit BD comes in. iFixit BD is a prominent iPhone servicing center that has 4 different service points ranging in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones.

iPhone 8 Plus repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 8 Plus fault. The 5.5-inch LCD display, A11 Bionic chip, glass back with wireless charging, IP67 water resistance, and dual camera system made the iPhone 8 Plus the last large iPhone with a Home button and Touch ID. We repair cracked screens, dead batteries, Lightning port faults, glass back damage, camera issues, and board-level problems. Screen replacement starts from ৳3,500, battery from ৳1,500, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone 8 Plus problems we fix?

Battery severely degraded — critical at 8+ years

The iPhone 8 Plus battery is now 8+ years old. Batteries at this age typically hold 55–65% of original capacity. The phone shuts down unpredictably, throttles constantly, and requires daily recharging. Battery replacement is urgent for any owner continuing to use this device. [→ iPhone 8 Plus battery replacement]

Cracked LCD screen

The 5.5-inch LCD panel shows white spots, inverted colours at the corners, and spreading dark bleed patches after a crack. Full display assembly replacement — LCD, digitiser, and frame — restores full touch and visual function. [→ iPhone 8 Plus screen replacement]

Cracked glass back disabling wireless charging

The iPhone 8 Plus was one of the first iPhones with a glass back to enable wireless charging. A drop on the rear cracks this glass and disrupts wireless charging coil alignment. iFixit BD replaces the back glass without full chassis replacement. [→ iPhone 8 Plus back glass repair]

Dual camera — telephoto blur or portrait mode failure

The iPhone 8 Plus telephoto lens powers Portrait Mode. OIS mechanical failure on the telephoto, flex cable wear, and 8 years of normal degradation all reduce portrait quality and zoom sharpness. [→ iPhone 8 Plus camera repair]

Lightning port worn after 8 years

Eight years of daily cable use wears the Lightning port. Cables become loose, connections intermittent, and charging unreliable. Port replacement is often necessary at this device age, beyond just cleaning. [→ iPhone 8 Plus charging issues]

How does our repair process work?

Step 1 — Free diagnosis. Bring your iPhone 8 Plus to any iFixit BD branch. Fault identified, written quote at no cost.

70+ expert technicians, 4 dedicated Dhaka branches, 500,000+ devices repaired.

Is the iPhone 8 Plus still worth repairing in 2026?

Yes for the most common, affordable faults.

Battery replacement is the most practical repair. At ৳1,500–2,800, it is among the most affordable iPhone battery repairs we offer and the impact is significant on a severely degraded 8-year-old battery.

iPhone 16e Repair Service in Bangladesh

An iPhone 16e repair service restores your handset to full working order through diagnostics, part replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, and motherboard repair.

Repair costs in Bangladesh sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a speaker swap cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an original display replacement cost the most.

Most repairs finish the same day. Motherboard and water damage work runs longer because it needs board-level diagnosis.

You pick your display grade before work starts. Original, OEM-grade, high-quality after-market soft, high-quality after-market hard, and copy displays each carry a different price — and a different warranty period.

Our Dhaka service center covers Dhanmondi, Gulshan, Uttara, Mirpur, Motijheel, and Panthapath, with courier pickup for Chattogram and Sylhet. Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic.

What does our iPhone 16e repair service cover?

An iPhone 16e repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16e, replaces the failed part, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults on the A18 chip platform. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired part and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16e repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16e screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.1-inch OLED display assembly and calibrates brightness, color, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16e battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16e charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16e back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked matte back glass and reseals the aluminium frame so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16e camera repair — Replaces the single rear camera module or the front camera assembly when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16e facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16e speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16e microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16e water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16e motherboard repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.

How much does an iPhone 16e repair cost?

An iPhone 16e repair costs between BDT 1,500 and BDT 32,000, depending on the failed part and the grade you select. The failed component sets the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Entry-level repairs cost between BDT 1,500 and BDT 4,500. This tier covers speaker replacement, microphone replacement, charging port cleaning, action button repair, and software fault recovery. These repairs use low-cost components and finish within a single visit.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 5,000 and BDT 14,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 15,000 and BDT 32,000. This tier covers original display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and motherboard repair. Original display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest part and labor cost on the iPhone 16e.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16e screen replacement cost in Bangladesh?

An iPhone 16e screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 26,000 in Bangladesh, depending on the display grade you select. The display assembly is the most expensive single part in the device, and the local market supplies five grades at five price points. A display assembly charge covers fitting and calibration and appears as a separate line on your quotation.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 11,000. This tier uses a copy display or a high quality after-market hard display that restores picture and touch at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 12,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier uses a high quality after-market soft display or an OEM-grade display, both of which reproduce OLED contrast and match original touch sensitivity.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 19,000 and BDT 26,000. This tier uses an original display pulled from a genuine device, which preserves factory color accuracy, brightness range, and True Tone behavior.

You keep Face ID after any of these five grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

Which display grades are available for an iPhone 16e repair?

The display grades available for an iPhone 16e repair are listed below.

  • Original display pulled from a genuine device — Factory Apple panel with original color accuracy, peak brightness, and True Tone support.
  • Original equipment manufacturer grade display — Panel built to Apple specification by the same supply chain, matching original tolerances.
  • High quality after-market display, soft variant — Flexible OLED panel with strong contrast, deep blacks, and accurate touch response.
  • High quality after-market display, hard variant — Rigid OLED panel offering durable construction and reliable daily performance at moderate cost.
  • Copy display — Budget replacement panel that restores picture output and touch function at the lowest price point.

You confirm the display grade in writing before the repair begins, so the quoted price and the fitted panel always match. A display assembly charge is added separately to the part price and covers fitting, sealing, and calibration. The warranty period differs by display grade, with original and OEM-grade panels carrying the longest coverage. Adaptive color temperature data transfers from your original display where the feature remains active after the swap.

How long does an iPhone 16e repair take in iFixit BD?

An iPhone 16e repair takes 30 minutes to 5 working days. Component replacements finish within the same day, while board-level work extends across several days. Turnaround depends on display grade availability in the local market, so a stocked after-market panel fits faster than a special-order original display. Motherboard repair and water damage repair take longer than component replacement, because both require circuit-level diagnosis, ultrasonic cleaning, micro-soldering, and staged testing between each step. Customers outside Dhaka add 1 to 3 days of courier transit time to every figure below.

The turnaround time for each iPhone 16e repair type is shown below.

Repair typeTypical turnaround timeSame-day availabilityScreen replacement45 to 90 minutesYesBattery replacement30 to 60 minutesYesCharging port repair60 to 120 minutesYesSpeaker or microphone repair45 to 90 minutesYesCamera repair60 to 120 minutesYesBack glass replacement2 to 4 hoursYesFace ID repair3 to 6 hoursYesWater damage repair2 to 4 working daysNoMotherboard repair2 to 5 working daysNo

You receive a turnaround estimate in writing alongside your quotation, and the service desk updates you when a repair moves between stages. Verify these figures against your own current service records before publishing, since display supply in Bangladesh shifts turnaround ranges over time.

Does an iPhone 16e repair include a warranty in iFixit Bangladesh?

Yes, an iPhone 16e repair includes a warranty in Bangladesh. Every repair carries parts and labor coverage that runs from the collection date. The warranty period varies by display grade, with original and OEM-grade panels carrying longer coverage than after-market and copy panels. Coverage applies to the specific part replaced, and the service desk records the covered part and the period on your invoice at handover.

How do you book an iPhone 16e repair service?

You book an iPhone 16e repair service by describing the fault, requesting a free diagnostic, approving the written quotation, and confirming a collection time. The process moves from fault description to device collection in six steps, and each step produces a written record you keep. Contact the service center by phone or message to reserve a slot, or visit during service hours for stocked repairs. Walk-in service runs 7 days a week, and booking ahead reserves the specific display grade your repair requires. You back up the device to iCloud or a computer before handover, since board-level and water damage repairs sometimes affect stored data. Customers outside Dhaka use courier pickup and delivery, with payment by mobile financial service or cash on delivery.

The steps to book an iPhone 16e repair service are outlined below.

  1. Describe the fault and request a free diagnostic — Report the symptom by phone, message, or in person, and the technician runs Apple Diagnostics to identify the failed part.

  6. Collect the device after function testing — Inspect the repaired part, verify the function test results, and receive your warranty invoice at handover.

Your iPhone 16e deserves a repair that holds up. Book your free diagnostic today and get a written price before anyone opens your device.

data.description:
The new iPhone XS MAX offers its users better optimization and balance in software than the previous iPhone models. However, no matter hard they try there can always be some technical issues that can result in your iPhone malfunctioning. The Apple logo stuck issue was also found in previous iPhones and it’s a frustrating issue. Your iPhone boots up, but instead of going to the home screen, it is stuck on the boot menu. This problem happens mainly/most of the time because of a software issue that happens due to an unclean or interrupted update.

This Stuck on Apple logo issue might happen in other instances too. Possible reasons might be:

  • The iPhone has taken in some physical damage. (Dropping from hand)
  • Update was disrupted due to Wi-Fi disturbance/metered connection or cellular data loss.
  • A third-party app may have access to vital permissions that can disrupt iPhones' productivity.
  • It is rare; however, your phone might be facing a hardware issue. Sometimes faulty hardware prevents the phone from booting up.

These issues however can be resolved if it is just a bug or a glitch in the iOS software. You may try the following steps and see if it works for you.

  • Force Restart your iPhone XS MAX

(Press volume up (+) and then quickly press volume down (-) button and hold the iPhone XS MAX power button as long as the apple logo appears again)

  • Update your iOS Software.

(If, while in the progress of updating your software, the progress bar under the Apple logo has not moved for an hour, you may connect your iPhone to a PC and select “Update” when prompted)

  • Remove all third-party apps from your phone. Install Apps only from the Apple App store

Turn off the auto-update of your iOS apps to prevent further interruptions. BUT BE SURE TO UPDATE THEM IN REGULAR BASIS MANUALLY.

If none of the fixes above work, for you. You might have an issue that needs the touch of a professional iPhone technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in fixing iPhones. ifixit bd is a prominent iPhone servicing center that is located in 4 locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

iPhone 16e Repair Service in Bangladesh

An iPhone 16e repair service restores your handset to full working order through diagnostics, part replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, and motherboard repair.

Repair costs in Bangladesh sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a speaker swap cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an original display replacement cost the most.

Most repairs finish the same day. Motherboard and water damage work runs longer because it needs board-level diagnosis.

You pick your display grade before work starts. Original, OEM-grade, high-quality after-market soft, high-quality after-market hard, and copy displays each carry a different price — and a different warranty period.

Our Dhaka service center covers Dhanmondi, Gulshan, Uttara, Mirpur, Motijheel, and Panthapath, with courier pickup for Chattogram and Sylhet. Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic.

What does our iPhone 16e repair service cover?

An iPhone 16e repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16e, replaces the failed part, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults on the A18 chip platform. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired part and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16e repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16e screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.1-inch OLED display assembly and calibrates brightness, color, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16e battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16e charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16e back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked matte back glass and reseals the aluminium frame so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16e camera repair — Replaces the single rear camera module or the front camera assembly when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16e facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16e speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16e microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16e water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16e motherboard repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.

How much does an iPhone 16e repair cost?

An iPhone 16e repair costs between BDT 1,500 and BDT 32,000, depending on the failed part and the grade you select. The failed component sets the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Entry-level repairs cost between BDT 1,500 and BDT 4,500. This tier covers speaker replacement, microphone replacement, charging port cleaning, action button repair, and software fault recovery. These repairs use low-cost components and finish within a single visit.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 5,000 and BDT 14,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 15,000 and BDT 32,000. This tier covers original display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and motherboard repair. Original display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest part and labor cost on the iPhone 16e.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16e screen replacement cost in Bangladesh?

An iPhone 16e screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 26,000 in Bangladesh, depending on the display grade you select. The display assembly is the most expensive single part in the device, and the local market supplies five grades at five price points. A display assembly charge covers fitting and calibration and appears as a separate line on your quotation.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 6,500 and BDT 11,000. This tier uses a copy display or a high quality after-market hard display that restores picture and touch at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 12,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier uses a high quality after-market soft display or an OEM-grade display, both of which reproduce OLED contrast and match original touch sensitivity.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 19,000 and BDT 26,000. This tier uses an original display pulled from a genuine device, which preserves factory color accuracy, brightness range, and True Tone behavior.

You keep Face ID after any of these five grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

Which display grades are available for an iPhone 16e repair?

The display grades available for an iPhone 16e repair are listed below.

  • Original display pulled from a genuine device — Factory Apple panel with original color accuracy, peak brightness, and True Tone support.
  • Original equipment manufacturer grade display — Panel built to Apple specification by the same supply chain, matching original tolerances.
  • High quality after-market display, soft variant — Flexible OLED panel with strong contrast, deep blacks, and accurate touch response.
  • High quality after-market display, hard variant — Rigid OLED panel offering durable construction and reliable daily performance at moderate cost.
  • Copy display — Budget replacement panel that restores picture output and touch function at the lowest price point.

You confirm the display grade in writing before the repair begins, so the quoted price and the fitted panel always match. A display assembly charge is added separately to the part price and covers fitting, sealing, and calibration. The warranty period differs by display grade, with original and OEM-grade panels carrying the longest coverage. Adaptive color temperature data transfers from your original display where the feature remains active after the swap.

data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone XR offers a set of microphones to ensure your iPhone makes the best out of the audio inputs it receives. The iPhone offers the users a dual speaker and microphone to ensure the best listening experience for their users. However, it is often reported by iPhone XR users that they are having trouble regarding the microphones in their phones. The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are

  • Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/voice memos.
  • Low or unclear voice in FaceTime, Skype, or video recording.
  • Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic.
  • Siri doesn’t work/can’t hear me/can’t pick up commands.

The iPhone XR has at least 3 different microphones in different places on the phone for different purposes.

  • At the bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls.
  • One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri
  • The one in the back of you is in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

  • Make sure you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.
  • Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.
  • Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works.
  • If the mic works in voice memo, make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone XR.
  • Go to Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues in your iPhone XR.

data.title: Error Solution
data.description:
Sometimes when you update your iPhone, or when you try to run your phone you may see some sort of black screen with some sort of Error with a number on your iPhone’s screen out of nowhere. These messages with errors and numbers can be seen while booting up the phone or trying to upgrade the ipsw files from iTunes from a pc. These are Error Codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy. They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore, saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen in the iPhones are as follows:

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error code – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

To check if your iPhone is updated

To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)

If the update still fails try updating from another pc.

Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.

Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info pages with possible DIY (Do it yourself) solutions.

data.title: Wifi Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 Pro has a new wireless firmware that can support up to 7GHz of wireless bandwidth speed. This gives the users unmatched speed in comparison to most of the smartphones in the market. However, there have been issues regarding the Wi-Fi of the iPhone 11 pro. And frankly, some users have taken issue with the phone saying that the phone disconnects from the wireless network frequently and without any warning.

Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most common reported iPhone 11 Pro Wi-Fi issues are…

  • Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone 11 pro.
  • Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver.
  • Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi.
  • High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections
  • iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi
  • iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection.

These Wi-Fi issues found on iPhone 11 pro are pretty common issues found on other wireless supported devices too! And does not necessarily indicate that there is something specifically wrong with your iPhone 11 pro’s wireless hardware. There are some DIY(Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

  • Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issues have been resolved.
  • Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again.
  • Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection.
  • Restore the default network connection
  • ( Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)
  • Update your iOS to the latest version available.

If none of the solutions mentioned above works to resolve your Wi-Fi issues on your iPhone 11 pro, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. data.title: Boot Loop
data.description:
The iPhone 14 Plus offers the users a new iOS version (iOS 13 upgradable to iOS 14) and updates it forward. Users need to update iOS regularly to maintain the stable and smooth operation of the iPhone. However, sometimes a user may face some unforeseen problems. Like the Boot loop in this instance, where the phone starts and shows the Apple logo. Then goes black and again shows only the apple logo on the screen, the phone can show nothing beyond that.

This issue happens mostly when there is a failed or interrupted software update happens on your phone. Also, other issues may cause your phone to boot loop such as:

Physical Damage (Dropping the phone from your hand, etc.)

The battery connector may have gotten loose or have gone bad.

Hardware Damage.

Improper or failed update that is missing necessary files to get the phone started.

If you think one of the above issues is causing the boot looping error on your phone, you may just try these fixes listed below and see if they work to resolve your issue.

Force Restart Your iPhone 14 Plus

(press the volume up button (+) then release the button. And then quickly press and release the volume down (-) and then hold the power button again until your screen turns black and shows the apple logo)

Check if your iPhone is fully charged or is charging properly.

Connect your iPhone to your computer and try restoring or updating the software through the iTunes application.

If your phone still doesn’t recover from boot looing after trying these fixes, something may have gone wrong which can only be fixed by a professional iPhone technician. data.title: Wifi Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 13 has a new wireless firmware that can support up to 7GHz of wireless bandwidth speed. This gives the users unmatched speed in comparison to most of the smartphones in the market. However, there have been issues regarding the Wi-Fi of the iPhone 13. And frankly, some users have taken issue with the phone saying that the phone disconnects from the wireless network frequently and without any warning.

Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most commonly reported iPhone 13 Wi-Fi issues are…

Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone 13 

Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver

Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi

High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections

iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi

iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection

These Wi-Fi issues found on iPhone 13 are pretty common issues found on other wireless supported devices too! It also does not necessarily indicate that there is anything specifically wrong with your iPhone 13 wireless hardware. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issue has been resolved

Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again

Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection

Restore the default network connection

(Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)

Update your iOS to the latest version available

If none of the solutions mentioned above work to resolve your Wi-Fi issue on your iPhone 13, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhone 13 Wi-Fi and its related issues. ifixt bd has 4 service points located in prominent locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Face ID Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 13 Mini comes with a distinct feature called Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided with the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

Face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature.

Face not recognized

Face ID is not available at the moment

Move the camera a bit lower/higher

Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me into Passcode and not Face ID

These common issues, however, have some home remedies that may work for your iPhone. These fixed attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode

if you use a screen protector, make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way.

Make sure you are facing the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing between your face and camera region

Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy

Update your iOS to the latest version

If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID, instead prompt with a passcode. The reasons may be:

The user might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone

The user may have just restarted the device

The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours

The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days

The device has not been unlocked with face ID in the last 4 hours

The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from a safe space

If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts

If at Face ID set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all

If your iPhone 13 mini Face ID problems can’t be categorized and sorted by the above-mentioned issues and fixes, you may just need to take it to an extremely diligent iPhone technician to deal with Face ID issues.

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water.

However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

  • If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:
  • Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth
  • You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there.
  • NEVER CHARGE YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU HAVE MADE SURE IT IS COMPLETELY DRY
  • If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth.

If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers.
