data.title: Rear Camera Replacement
data.description:
Even with such an amazing camera, it has been found that some users have found some issues regarding the camera. The most common issues regarding the rear camera of iPhone 16 found in the Apple support forum and the internet are:

  • Black Display when the camera turns on/ nothing shows on the camera
  • LED Flash is not working
  • Photos seem too noisy/ grainy
  • Camera or iPhone freezes while zooming in
  • Camera freezes/ shows a black screen after an iOS update
  • Blurry, unclear photos
  • Out of Sync flash. This is a problem where a user wants to take a photo with the flash, but the flash gets triggered after the photo has been taken

These are the most common issues that are often reported by users in Apple service centers and user forums. However, there are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available that work as a remedy for these issues. If you are facing any of the above-mentioned problems, try doing so. Removing any protective cases for your phone. Especially metallic or magnetic cases, which may hamper the proper functioning of your phone’s camera

  • Try Restarting your phone
  • Try cleaning your lenses with a microfiber cloth. Be careful not to scratch it
  • If your camera flash isn’t working, try turning on the flash from the control center and see if it works
  • Try disabling Voiceover settings for your iPhone. From Settings > General > Accessibility > Turn off voiceover.
  • Try Switching between camera lenses in the settings
  • You can also try resetting your previous settings

If none of the solutions work for you, you might need to get your iPhone looked at by professionals. Disable background app refresh. Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh

Toggle Airplane Mode on and off to reset the previous network settings and cache

Remove your sim card and reinstall it again. -requires a restart of the device

Set up the internet for your phone if you’re facing internet issues through the network for the first time.

To set it up, go to Settings > Mobile Data > Mobile Data Network.

then:

Insert APN (Access Point Name) provided by your carrier

Insert Username (provided by your carrier)

Insert Password (provided by your carrier)

Save the settings by pressing the left arrow at the top.

Make sure your Data connection is on after setting up the network before you access the internet.

Install carrier update for your iPhone (Check-in Settings > General > About)

Restart your iPhone

Soft reset your iPhone

Make sure your touch screen protector doesn’t interfere with the proper operation

Make sure there’s no internal/external damage (cracking or shattering glass)

Disconnecting your USB-lightning port to check if it works

If your phone is above normal temperature wait for it to cool down and then try again

Restart your device

data.title: Charge Draining Issue
data.description:
The battery is optimized perfectly for the phone. However, it may be due to some manufacturer error or something about some faulty apps’ optimization; you may not get the smoothest output from your iPhone XS battery. Most users have reported that the iPhone’s battery starts draining after the system has updated to iOS 14. Several other issues may cause battery drain issues also. These issues include:

  • The battery of the iPhone XS runs out too quickly after the update.
  • The battery of the iPhone XS runs out after installing an app/update of an app.
  • The battery of the iPhone drains quickly after turning on the optimized charging mode.
  • The iPhone battery drains after the phone heats up too quickly.

These are the most common problems regarding battery-draining found on the internet. Your issues may be one of them or not listed! However, we recommend trying some DIY (do it yourself) fixes that may resolve your issue.

  • Turn off background iCloud/iTunes sync to save battery by a considerable amount.
  • When not in use, turn off WiFi/cellular data/location/Bluetooth service in your iPhone.
  • Don’t overcharge/frequently charge your iPhone XS. It may reduce battery health.
  • Turn on optimized battery charging to save your battery life and protect it from draining.
  • Adjust your brightness settings in iPhone XS to auto-brightness.
  • Turn off background app refresh.
  • From here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh
  • Try running it on low power mode.
  • from here: Settings > Battery > Low power mode ON
  • Turning off “reduce motion” to turn off aesthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help.
  • Turn it off from here: Settings > General > Accessibility > Reduce Motion

If none of the aforementioned procedures work to resolve your battery-draining issues, it may need to be looked at by a professional technician to get them resolved. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who have special expertise in repairing iPhones. Our experienced technicians are located in iFixit BD service points located in 4 different points in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Wifi Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone XS has a new wireless firmware that can support up to GHz of wireless bandwidth speed. This gives the users unmatched speed in comparison to most of the smartphones in the market. However, there have been issues regarding the Wi-Fi of the iPhone XS. And frankly, some users have taken issue with the phone, saying that the phone disconnects from the wireless network frequently and without any warning.

Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most common reported iPhone XS Wi-Fi issues are…

  • Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone XS.
  • Wi-Fi stays connected, but there is no internet on the receiver.
  • Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/non-metered connections on Wi-Fi.
  • High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi Connections
  • iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi.
  • iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection.

These Wi-Fi issues found on the iPhone XS are pretty common issues found on other wireless-supported devices too! And does not necessarily indicate that there is something specifically wrong with your iPhone XS wireless hardware. There are some DIY (do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case. Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issues have been resolved.

  • Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again.
  • Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection.
  • Restore the default network connection.
  • (Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > *Enter Passcode * > Confirm)
  • Update your iOS to the latest version available.

If none of the solutions mentioned above works to resolve your Wi-Fi issues on your iPhone XS, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and professional technicians who specialize in repairing the iPhone XS Wi-Fi and its related issues. ifixt bd has 4 service points located in prominent locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Wifi Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 14 Pro has new wireless firmware that can support up to 7GHz of wireless bandwidth speed. This gives the users unmatched speed in comparison to most of the smartphones in the market. However, there have been issues regarding the Wi-Fi of the iPhone 14 Pro. And frankly, some users have taken issue with the phone saying that the phone disconnects from the wireless network frequently and without any warning. Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most commonly reported iPhone 14 Pro Wi-Fi issues are…

Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone 14 Pro

Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver

Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi

High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections

iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi

iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection

These Wi-Fi issues found on iPhone 14 Pro are pretty common issues found on other wireless-supported devices too! It also does not necessarily indicate that there is anything specifically wrong with your iPhone 14 Pro wireless hardware. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issue has been resolved

Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again

Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection

Restore the default network connection

(Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)

Update your iOS to the latest version available

If none of the solutions mentioned above work to resolve your Wi-Fi issue on your iPhone 14 Pro, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhone 14 Pro Wi-Fi and its related issues. iFixit bd has 4 service points located in prominent locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh

Battery draining extremely fast — the most common complaint

The iPhone SE 2020 has a small physical battery constrained by the 4.7-inch chassis. Combined with the A13 chip's performance demands, battery life was already limited at launch. At 5+ years of daily use, batteries on these phones have degraded to the point where the phone barely lasts a few hours of active use. Battery replacement is the single most common repair we perform on this model. iPhone SE 2020 battery replacement

Cracked 4.7-inch LCD Retina display

The classic 4.7-inch form factor is compact but the LCD panel is not shatterproof. Corner drops crack the glass and damage the LCD beneath, causing white areas, inverted colours, and unresponsive touch. We replace the full display assembly with the digitiser and LCD together. iPhone SE 2020 screen replacement

Now you can repair your faulty touch mechanism of the iPhone XR without having to change the entire display! Since the launch of the new iPhone X models, Apple has introduced a technology that separates the touch mechanism and upper glasses from the entire display. Therefore, users who face problems or issues in their display panels can get it looked at separately.

The iPhone XR also has a separate touch and display panel which integrates and works as a whole unit. If your phone has a faulty, unresponsive, broken, or damaged touch, you need not replace the whole display unit. iFixit bd has a dedicated service to replace or repair your touch panel (not the entire display) in-service points located all over Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Signs that indicate a faulty touch mechanism in iPhone xr are...

  • Doesn’t work or No response / Program doesn’t open or respond after touching the icon

data.title: Face ID Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 14 Pro comes with a distinct feature called Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided by the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

Face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature.

Face not recognized

Face ID is not available at the moment

Move the camera a bit lower/higher

Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me to the Passcode and not Face ID.

These common issues, however, have some home remedies which may work for your iPhone. These fixed attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode

if you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way.

Make sure you are facing the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing your face and the camera region

Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy

Update your iOS to the latest version

If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID, instead prompt with a passcode. The reasons may be:

User might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone

The user may have just restarted the device

The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours

The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days

The device has not been unlocked with face ID in the last 4 hours

The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from a safe space

If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts

If at Face ID is set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all

The top speaker also serves its purpose as an ear speaker when on calls. However, some users have reported a lot of different audio issues.

No sound on voice calls

Distorted/Low sound on the speakers

Headphones not working

Audio not working or audio levels low after an update.

Phone stuck in Headphone mode

These issues are the most common audio issues reported by users in the Apple support forum. There are some “Do it yourself” fixes available and advised to be attempted as a “first aid” for your audio issues by Apple professionals and users. They are:

Check the ringer switch to see if it is in sound mode

Restarting Your Phone

Disabling your Bluetooth on the iPhone 14

Check if your phone is in DND (Do not disturb) mode

Check the sound notification settings and try turning noise cancelation off.

Try using headphones and check if the sounds come okay in headphones.

Try removing any protective cases

Clean speaker grills for dirt and debris

data.title: Charging Issues
data.description:
The new iPhone 14 has a beautiful battery that is optimized for using it for a reasonable amount of time. However, most of the users have complained the iPhone 14 charges very slowly in comparison to other smartphones on the market with almost the same range. The Apple company, recommends that you use an Apple 18-W USB Type-C charging brick if you face a slow charging issue. Which is the default charger with iPhone 14. Apple claims this charging brick can shoot your charging time up to 50% in 30 minutes only!

However, even with an 18-W charger, some users face issues while charging their iPhone 14. The most common issues are as follows:

The iPhone 14 charges slowly or not at all

The iPhone is not charging beyond 80 %

An alert that shows that the accessory you are using to charge the iPhone is not certified or supported

These are the most reported issues for an iPhone 14 with faulty charging. You may try some home fixes that may resolve the issues.

Try changing the wall adapter or cable

Check if there is no debris or dirt in both the charging dock and the charging adapter

Make sure the USB is connected firmly on both ends

Check the charging adapter or the lightning cable for visible signs of damage. Example: Bent pin, loose cable, etc.

if you have iOS 14 or above make sure you uncheck the “optimized battery charging” option to make sure it charges beyond 80 %.To disable it go to: Settings > Battery > Battery Health > Optimized Battery Charging

Make sure you have no damage in your charging dock if unsupported device warning shows.

If none of the fixes seem to work for resolving your iPhone 11 pro charging issues. You may need to get it looked at by professionals. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who have expertise in resolving issues regarding iPhones. Our ifixit bd service points are located in four different locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh. We care about you and understand that your phone is very important. data.title: Boot Loop
data.description:
The iPhone 8 Plus offers the users a new iOS version and updates it forward. Users need to update iOS regularly to maintain the stable and smooth operation of the iPhone. However, sometimes a user may face some unforeseen problems. Like the Boot loop in this instance, where the phone starts and shows the apple logo. Then goes black and again shows only the apple logo on the screen, the phone can show nothing beyond that.

This issue happens mostly when there is a failed or interrupted software update happens on your phone. Also, other issues may cause your phone to boot loop such as:

  • Battery connector may have gotten loose or have gone bad.
  • Hardware Damage.
  • Your Phone is boot looping after a recent screen replacement.
  • Improper or failed update that is missing necessary files to get the phone started.

If you think one of the above issues is causing the boot looping error on your phone, you may just try these fixes listed below and see if they work to resolve your issue.

  • Force Restart Your iPhone 8 plus
  • Check if your iPhone is fully charged or is charging properly.
  • Connect your iPhone to your computer and try restoring or updating the software through the iTunes application.

data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone SE 2020 offers a set of microphones to ensure your iPhone makes the best out of the audio inputs it receives. The iPhone offers the users a mono speaker and microphone to ensure the best listening experience for their users. However, it is often reported by iPhone SE 2020 users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones. The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are:

  • Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/ voice memos.
  • Low or unclear voice in Facetime, skype, or video recording.
  • Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic.
  • Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands.

The iPhone SE 2020 has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes.

  • The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls
  • One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri
  • The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

  • Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.
  • Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.
  • Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works
  • If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone SE 2020 go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues in your iPhone SE 2020

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone SE 2020 fault. What are the common iPhone SE 2020 problems we fix?

Battery draining extremely fast — the most common complaint

The iPhone SE 2020 has a small physical battery constrained by the 4.7-inch chassis. Combined with the A13 chip's performance demands, battery life was already limited at launch. At 5+ years of daily use, batteries on these phones have degraded to the point where the phone barely lasts a few hours of active use. Battery replacement is the single most common repair we perform on this model. iPhone SE 2020 battery replacement

Cracked 4.7-inch LCD Retina display

The classic 4.7-inch form factor is compact but the LCD panel is not shatterproof. Corner drops crack the glass and damage the LCD beneath, causing white areas, inverted colours, and unresponsive touch. We replace the full display assembly with the digitiser and LCD together. iPhone SE 2020 screen replacement

Touch ID home button not reading fingerprints

Wear, moisture exposure, and previous non-specialist repairs can all cause Touch ID failure or home button unresponsiveness. iFixit BD replaces the button assembly and restores Touch ID function where the board-level pairing remains intact. iPhone SE 2020 Touch ID / home button repair

Lightning port not charging or loose

The Lightning port on a compact, pocket-heavy device like the SE 2020 wears quickly. Five years of daily cable use and lint compaction cause loose connections and charging failures. We clean during every free diagnosis — replacement only when damage is confirmed. iPhone SE 2020 charging issues

Rear camera blurry or not focusing

The single 12MP rear camera on the iPhone SE 2020 has no optical image stabilisation. Drops that crack the camera lens glass, shift the module, or damage the connector cause blur and autofocus failure. iPhone SE 2020 camera repair

data.title: Wifi Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 pro max has a new wireless firmware that can support up to 7GHz of wireless bandwidth speed. This gives the users unmatched speed in comparison to most of the smartphones in the market. However, there have been issues regarding the Wi-Fi of the iPhone 11 pro max. And frankly, some users have taken issue with the phone saying that the phone disconnects from the wireless network frequently and without any warning.

Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most common reported iPhone 11 pro max Wi-Fi issues are…

  • Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone 11 pro max
  • Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver
  • Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi
  • High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections
  • iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi
  • iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection

These Wi-Fi issues found on iPhone 11 pro max are pretty common issues found on other wireless supported devices too! And does not necessarily indicate that there is something specifically wrong with your iPhone 11 pro max’s wireless hardware.

There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

  • Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issues have been resolved
  • Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again
  • Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection
  • Restore the default network connection
  • ( Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)
  • Update your iOS to the latest version available

If none of the solutions mentioned above works to resolve your Wi-Fi issues on your iPhone 11 pro max, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. data.description:
The new iPhone comes with an almost 4323 mAh battery. The battery is optimized perfectly for the phone. Most users have reported that the iPhone’s battery starts draining after the system has updated to iOS 14 Pro Max Several other issues may cause battery drain issues also. These issues include:

The battery of the iPhone 14 Pro Max runs out too quickly after the update

The battery of the iPhone 14 Pro Max runs out after installing an app/ update an app

The battery of the iPhone drains quickly after turning on the optimized charging mode

The iPhone Battery drains after the phone heats up too quickly

These are the most common problems regarding battery draining found on the internet. Your issues may be one of them or not listed! However, we recommend trying some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes that may resolve your issue.

Turn off background iCloud/iTunes sync to save battery by a considerable amount

When not in use turn off WiFi/Cellular Data/Location/Bluetooth service in your iPhone

Don’t overcharge/ Frequently charge your iPhone 14 Pro Max. It may reduce battery health

Turn on optimized battery charging to save your battery life and protect it from draining

Adjust your brightness settings in iPhone 14 Pro Max to auto-brightness

Turn off Background app refresh From here: Settings > general > Background app refresh

Try running it on low power mode from here: Settings > Battery > Low power mode ON

Turn off “reduce motion” to turn off aesthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help Turn it off from here: Settings > General > Accessibility > Reduce Motion

If none of the aforementioned procedures work to resolve your battery-draining issues, it may need to be looked at by a professional technician to get them resolved. iPhone Air repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone Air fault. Apple's ultra-thin 2025 iPhone — a 6.6-inch OLED display, A19 chip, and a chassis thinner than any previous iPhone — is both a design achievement and a specific repair challenge. We repair cracked screens, batteries, USB-C charging faults, camera issues, and frame damage using both A-grade and Original parts. Screen replacement starts from ৳13,000, battery from ৳3,500, and every repair begins with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone Air problems we fix?

Screen cracking more easily due to the ultra-thin chassis

The iPhone Air's extreme thinness means less material between the display glass and the surface it hits on impact. Drops that would survive on a standard iPhone are more likely to crack the Air screen. We see this model frequently — OLED panel replacement and full display assembly replacement are the most common repairs. iPhone Air screen replacement

Battery draining quickly in a slim form factor

Apple fitted a smaller physical battery to achieve the iPhone Air's ultra-thin profile. Heavy users notice this — on-screen time is visibly shorter than on the standard iPhone air. When capacity drops further through normal degradation, the battery becomes noticeably insufficient for a full day. Same-day battery replacement restores performance. iPhone Air battery replacement

Frame bending from pressure or bag compression

An extremely thin aluminium-titanium chassis is more susceptible to frame flex from sitting on it, carrying it in a full bag, or dropping it on a flat surface. A bent frame creates a gap at the display seal, allows moisture ingress, and can damage internal flex cables. iFixit BD's frame repair and housing replacement service addresses this before it causes further internal damage. iPhone Air housing repair

USB-C port damage from frequent use

USB-C on the iPhone Air is the single port for both charging and data. Daily cable insertion on an ultra-thin device puts more mechanical stress on the port mounting point than on thicker iPhones. Intermittent charging and loose connectors are early signs of port wear. iPhone Air charging issues

Camera module misalignment after drop

The iPhone Air features a single large rear camera. A drop that impacts the thin rear chassis can shift the camera module or crack the lens. Blurry images, autofocus hunting, and app instability are the visible symptoms. iPhone Air camera repair

Try cleaning your lenses with a microfiber cloth. Be careful not to scratch it

If your camera flash isn’t working, try turning on the flash from the control center and see if it works

Try disabling Voiceover settings for your iPhone. From Settings > General > Accessibility > Turn off voiceover.

Try Switching between camera lenses in the settings

You can also try resetting your previous settings

iPhone 13 repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 13 fault. The iPhone 13 brought a smaller notch, improved dual-camera system, A15 Bionic chip, and MagSafe to the standard lineup — a well-balanced phone that runs iOS 18. We repair cracked OLED screens, degraded batteries, Lightning port damage, camera faults, and board-level issues using A-grade and Original parts. Screen replacement starts from ৳6,500, battery from ৳2,200, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone 13 problems we fix?

Battery capacity below 80% after daily use

At 4+ years old, most iPhone 13 batteries have dropped below 80% capacity — the threshold Apple defines as degraded. Below this level, iOS may throttle performance and charge times extend. Battery replacement at this stage gives the phone another 2+ years of reliable performance. iPhone 13 battery replacement

Cracked OLED screen

The 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display upgraded the iPhone 13 from LCD — but OLED is less forgiving on impact. Cracks produce green lines, dead zones, and touch failure that make the phone difficult to use. We replace the full assembly and confirm full-surface touch response. iPhone 13 screen replacement

Lightning port clogged with lint

Bangladesh's dusty environment and daily pocket use pack lint into Lightning ports quickly. Most iPhone 13 charging faults resolve with port cleaning during free diagnosis. We only recommend flex cable replacement when cleaning confirms the cable is physically damaged. iPhone 13 charging issues

Rear camera blur — main wide lens OIS failure

The 12MP main camera with sensor-shift OIS is the iPhone 13's standout camera feature. Drops that damage the camera bump, mechanical OIS failure, and flex cable issues cause blur on the primary lens. We test OIS function during every camera diagnosis. iPhone 13 camera repair

Face ID disabled after drop or non-specialist repair

TrueDepth sensors powering Face ID sit above the smaller notch on the iPhone 13. Impact damage or screen replacement without proper pairing disables Face ID entirely. iFixit BD protects Face ID pairing during every screen repair. iPhone 13 Face ID repair

How does our repair process work?

Step 1 — Free diagnosis. Bring your iPhone 13 to any iFixit BD branch. Fault identified, written quote at no cost.

Step 2 — Report and fixed price. Written fault report, fixed price, A-grade and Original side by side.

Step 3 — Confirm and repair. Most repairs same day. Board-level repairs 1–2 days.

Step 4 — Test together and collect with warranty. Full test with you present. Warranty begins from this moment.

Free written diagnosis and fixed quote. No cost to inspect, written estimate before work starts.

Board-level micro-soldering lab. A15 component-level repair, ultrasonic cleaning, 18 years experience.

Dual-tier pricing. A-grade and Original prices disclosed before work starts.

Repair warranty. All parts and labour covered at /warranty-policy.

70+ expert technicians, 4 dedicated Dhaka branches, 500,000+ devices repaired.

Is the iPhone 13 still worth repairing in 2026?

Yes — iOS 18, A15 performance, and OLED display make the iPhone 13 well worth maintaining.

Battery is the priority repair at this age. A fresh battery at ৳2,200–4,200 restores full daily performance for a phone that is otherwise in good shape.

Full iOS 18 support. iPhone 13 continues to receive iOS updates.

data.title: Touch Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 Pro Max offers a haptic touch system instead of a 3D touch system that was available in the previous versions of the iPhones. The new haptic touch does not require assessing the strength of users like it is needed in the 3D touch system. Instead, it measures the area of your fingertips to decide the strength and length of the touch input provided by the user.

This haptic touch is also a way to ensure your touch works for a long time. However, you just might face an issue anytime soon on your iPhone 11 Pro Max regarding your phone’s touch.

  • The most common issues faced by the users that are reported in the iPhone 11 Pro Max users community forum are as follows:
  • Too sensitive screen/screen response intermittently (means responses without the user having to input or auto-touch)
  • The touchscreen in your iPhone does not respond at all.
  • Delayed Touch issue
  • Touch doesn’t respond after dropping from hand. (Everything else seems to work fine.)

There are some fixes you might try to see if any of them work for your phone. Those are the following listed below:

  • Make sure your touchscreen protector doesn’t interfere with the proper operation.
  • Make sure there’s no internal/external damage (cracking or shattering glass).
  • Disconnecting your USB-lightning port to check if it works
  • If your phone is above normal temperature, wait for it to cool down and then try again.
  • Restart your device.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get your iPhone checked by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues regarding touch on your iPhone 11 Pro Max. ifixit bd is located in 4 different service points. Which are in convenient locations for you around Dhaka, Bangladesh? We understand and realize how important your iPhone is for your daily life. So we offer quick service for your ease of access. We also offer a 30-day service warranty on selected and applicable services you acquire from us.

data.description:
The new iPhone 16 Pro Max is a smartphone that has a lot of ambient sensors such as an accelerometer, a gyroscopic sensor, and a proximity sensor. The proximity sensor is probably the most used on your iPhone. This sensor is used for turning your phone’s screen off when it is placed near your face during a phone call. So that it may conserve battery or avoid unnecessary touch inputs by your face when talking. It may also be used for features like “Raise and Wake” and other minimal yet handy features.

However, you may face problems with the proximity sensor of your iPhone 16 Pro Max over time. Some issues with the iPhone 14 proximity sensor reported by users of the iPhone 16 Pro Max in the users' community are:

The proximity sensor is not working/ too sensitive. And turning the phone screen on and off during calls

The phone display doesn’t turn off during a phone call 

The phone display doesn’t turn on automatically as it should after the phone call ends

These are the most common issues found in the iPhone 16 Pro Max proximity sensor. There are some DIY (do it yourself) fixes you may try which may solve issues regarding your proximity sensor if they are very minor. Apple recommends:

Try removing your screen protector, which may block the proximity sensors' proper working 

Restart your iPhone 

Update your iOS

If you have already tried the above-mentioned fixes and none of the fixes work for you, you might need to get your phone checked by a professional technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones. We have service centers situated in locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh. We offer quick service to replace and repair your iPhone for ease of access.

model_data.allservice_page_description:
An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service restores your damaged handset to full working order through diagnostics, component replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, logic board repair, and software fault repair.

Repair costs sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a charging port cleanup cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an OLED display swap cost the most. Screen replacement pricing follows the same three tiers.

Turnaround times vary by repair type. A battery swap wraps up same day, while logic board and water damage work takes longer because part availability drives the schedule.

You pick the replacement part grade before work starts. New genuine parts, used genuine parts, OEM-grade parts, and certified after-market parts each carry a different price and a different effect on parts and service history reporting. Every repair ships with a parts and labor warranty.

Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic and ending when you collect a function-tested device. Walk in or reserve your slot ahead — booking ahead locks in the part you need.

What is an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max, replaces the failed component, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired component and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16 Pro Max repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16 Pro Max screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.9-inch LTPO OLED display assembly and calibrates True Tone, brightness, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked rear glass panel and reseals the housing so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max camera repair — Replaces the rear camera module, front camera assembly, LiDAR sensor, or camera lens when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max logic board repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max software fault repair — Recovers iOS when the device sticks on the Apple logo, restarts repeatedly, or fails a firmware update.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair costs between BDT 2,500 and BDT 55,000, depending on the failed component and the replacement part grade you select. The component determines the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Entry-level repairs cost between BDT 2,500 and BDT 6,000. This tier covers charging port cleaning, speaker replacement, microphone replacement, button repair, and software fault recovery. These repairs use inexpensive components and finish quickly.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 7,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 20,000 and BDT 55,000. This tier covers OLED display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and logic board repair. Display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest component and labor cost on the iPhone 16 Pro Max.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 52,000, depending on the display grade you select. The 6.9-inch LTPO OLED panel is the most expensive single component in the device, which places every screen replacement in the upper cost range.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 24,000. This tier uses a certified after-market OLED assembly that restores display output and touch response at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 26,000 and BDT 38,000. This tier uses an OEM-grade or used genuine display that matches original color accuracy and supports the ProMotion refresh rate.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 40,000 and BDT 52,000. This tier uses a new genuine Apple display that preserves True Tone, adaptive color temperature, Always-On display behavior, and clean parts and service history reporting.

You keep Face ID after any of these three grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

Which replacement parts are used for an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair?

The replacement part grades used for an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair are listed below.

  • New genuine manufacturer parts — Factory-new Apple components that deliver original performance and clean parts and service history reporting.
  • Used genuine manufacturer parts — Tested Apple components harvested from donor devices, offering genuine performance at reduced cost.
  • Original equipment manufacturer grade parts — Components built to Apple's specification by the same suppliers, matching original tolerances and materials.
  • Certified after-market parts — Independently manufactured components that pass quality certification and carry the same repair warranty.

You confirm the part grade in writing before the repair begins, so the quoted price and the fitted component always match. Genuine parts preserve adaptive color temperature, True Tone calibration, and accurate battery health reporting in Settings.

How long does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair take?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair takes 30 minutes to 5 working days. Component replacements finish within the same day, while board-level work extends across several days. Turnaround depends on part availability more than on repair difficulty, so a stocked display fits faster than a special-order camera module. Logic board repair and water damage repair take longer than component replacement, because both require diagnosis at circuit level, ultrasonic cleaning, micro-soldering, and staged testing between each step.

The turnaround time for each iPhone 16 Pro Max repair type is shown below.

Repair typeTypical turnaround timeSame-day availabilityScreen replacement45 to 90 minutesYesBattery replacement30 to 60 minutesYesCharging port repair60 to 120 minutesYesSpeaker or microphone repair45 to 90 minutesYesCamera repair60 to 120 minutesYesBack glass replacement2 to 4 hoursYesFace ID repair3 to 6 hoursYesSoftware fault repair1 to 3 hoursYesWater damage repair2 to 4 working daysNoLogic board repair2 to 5 working daysNo

You receive a turnaround estimate in writing alongside your quotation, and the service desk updates you when a repair moves between stages. Verify current figures against your own service records before publishing, since part supply changes turnaround ranges over time.

Does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair include a warranty?

Yes, an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair includes a warranty. Every repair carries parts and labor coverage that runs from the collection date. The warranty covers component failure and workmanship faults on the repaired part. Coverage applies to the specific component replaced during the repair, and the service desk records the covered part and the coverage period on your invoice at handover.

How do you book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

You book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service by describing the fault, requesting a free diagnostic, approving the written quotation, and confirming a collection time. The process moves from fault description to device collection in six steps, and each step produces a written record you keep. Our service center operates in Dhaka and covers customers across Bangladesh, including Gulshan, Banani, Dhanmondi, Uttara, Mirpur, and Mohakhali. Walk-in service runs during business hours, and booking ahead reserves the specific part your repair requires. You back up the device to iCloud or a computer before handover, since board-level and water damage repairs sometimes affect stored data.

The steps to book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service are outlined below.

  1. Describe the fault and request a free diagnostic — Report the symptom by phone, message, or in person, and the technician runs Apple Diagnostics to identify the failed component.
  2. Receive a written quotation and turnaround estimate — Review the itemized cost and completion time before you approve any work on your device.
  3. Confirm the replacement part grade — Select new genuine, used genuine, OEM-grade, or certified after-market parts, and the service desk records your choice in writing.
  4. Book a time slot or walk in — Reserve a slot to secure your part in advance, or bring the device directly during business hours for stocked repairs.
  5. Back up the device before handover — Sync your data to iCloud or a computer, and note your Apple ID credentials for post-repair activation.
  6. Collect the device after function testing — Inspect the repaired component, verify the function test results, and receive your warranty invoice at handover.

Your iPhone 16 Pro Max deserves a repair that holds up. Book your free diagnostic today and get a written price before anyone opens your device.

iPhone 6 Plus repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 6 Plus fault. Apple's first large-screen iPhone — the 5.5-inch Retina HD display, A8 chip, optical image stabilisation, and Touch ID — launched in 2014. We repair cracked screens, dead batteries, Lightning port damage, Touch ID failure, the known Touch Disease board fault, and logic board issues. Screen replacement starts from ৳2,000, battery from ৳900, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone 6 Plus problems we fix?

Battery completely depleted — replacement is essential

A 10–12 year old lithium-ion cell holds almost no practical charge. iPhone 6 Plus batteries in service today require immediate replacement for any continued use — this is not a question of "when" but "now." iPhone 6 Plus battery replacement

Cracked 5.5-inch LCD screen

The 5.5-inch Retina HD LCD display shows standard LCD damage after cracks — white backlight spots, touch dead zones, and dark bleed patches. Full display assembly replacement restores complete function. iPhone 6 Plus screen replacement

Touch Disease — flickering grey bar and unresponsive touch

data.title: Charge Draining Issue
data.description:
These are the most common problems regarding battery-draining found on the internet. Your issues may be one of them or not listed! However, we recommend trying some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes that may resolve your issue.

  • Turn off background iCloud/iTunes sync to save battery by a considerable amount.
  • When not in use turn off WiFi/Cellular Data/Location/Bluetooth service in your iPhone
  • Don’t overcharge/ Frequently charge your iPhone 6s Plus. It may reduce battery health.
  • Turn off Background app refresh - From here: Settings > general > Background app refresh
  • Try running it on low power mode - from here: Settings > Battery > Low power mode ON
  • Turn off “reduce motion” to turn off aesthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help - Turn it off from here: Settings > General > Accessibility > Reduce Motion

Disable background app refresh.

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the SIM tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the SIM tray by putting the ejector pin into the SIM tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the SIM tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the SIM tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver, then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water. However, if your LCI turns red, you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

If you have dropped your phone in the water, here are some basic things you should do:

  • Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth.
  • You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there.
  • Never charge your phone until you have made sure it is completely dry

If anything other than water spills on your phone (like oil, etc.), just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth. If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your battery or charging port or give you muffled speakers. An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service restores your damaged handset to full working order through diagnostics, component replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, logic board repair, and software fault repair.

What is an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max, replaces the failed component, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired component and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16 Pro Max repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16 Pro Max screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.9-inch LTPO OLED display assembly and calibrates True Tone, brightness, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked rear glass panel and reseals the housing so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max camera repair — Replaces the rear camera module, front camera assembly, LiDAR sensor, or camera lens when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max logic board repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max software fault repair — Recovers iOS when the device sticks on the Apple logo, restarts repeatedly, or fails a firmware update.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair cost?

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 7,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 20,000 and BDT 55,000. This tier covers OLED display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and logic board repair. Display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest component and labor cost on the iPhone 16 Pro Max.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 24,000. This tier uses a certified after-market OLED assembly that restores display output and touch response at the lowest cost.

How long does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair take?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair takes 30 minutes to 5 working days. Component replacements finish within the same day, while board-level work extends across several days. Turnaround depends on part availability more than on repair difficulty, so a stocked display fits faster than a special-order camera module. Logic board repair and water damage repair take longer than component replacement, because both require diagnosis at circuit level, ultrasonic cleaning, micro-soldering, and staged testing between each step.

repair_info.name: No Light On Display Issue
repair_info.image_alt_text: iPhone X No Light On Display Issue

data.description:
The new iPhone X offers one of the best displays consisting of a Liquid Retina IPS LCD display and a significantly high DPI. It has also ensured maximum safety for its users by putting gorilla glass in both back and front. However, not all damage in display comes from dropping the device from the hands and shattering it. Some users of the iPhone X have reported a sudden black screen without any prior damage history. The No light on Display issue of the iPhone X is where the user can’t see what’s happening on the phone. The phone runs okay. The phone vibrates and the user can hear the notification sounds and other inputs. But the problem is they can not see any of it because the phone display is just plain black. But the phone will respond or might even have incoming calls.

The key symptoms of the “No light on Display” issues are:

  • The Phone display boots up with an Apple logo but doesn’t get past the black screen (iPhone 6 – 8Plus)
  • The phone has calls, notifications but doesn’t show anything on display
  • iPhone can charge (you can hear the sound that the phone makes while charging) but won’t show anything on the display.

This “No light on display” is usually an internal issue with the LCD connector. However, Apple recommends some processes to practice on your phone to make sure the black screen is not a software glitch.

Force Restart your iPhone.

(Press the volume up (+) and volume down (-) and then press and hold the power button until the Apple logo appears on the screen)

Connect the lightning cable, charge it for 10 minutes. Then try force restarting the iPhone.

UNCONVENTIONAL: But press the screen into the phone so it may reconnect any dislodged LCD connector. This fix is not recommended however it resolved a lot of the user's Black Display issue. It might be risky for any layman person.

If none of the fixes work to resolve the issue on your iPhone, you may need to get it looked at by experienced professionals who specialize in iPhone issues. We are a service center that operates based on 4 different and convenient points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

We offer the best service options you can avail of anywhere regarding your iPhone in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We provide:

  • Free problem Diagnostics

So visit your nearest ifixit bd service point to resolve the “no light on display” issue on iPhone X. Or any other issues on any other models at ifixit bd today and avail the best iPhone servicing you can have.

iPhone X repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone X fault. The original iPhone X — the first iPhone without a Home button, the first with Face ID, and the first with an OLED Super Retina display — changed how iPhones work. We repair cracked OLED screens, critically degraded batteries, Lightning port faults, camera damage, Face ID failure, and board-level issues. Screen replacement starts from ৳5,000, battery from ৳2,000, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone X problems we fix?

Battery at critical degradation after 8+ years

The iPhone X launched in 2017 — any battery still in that device has been through 8+ years of charge cycles. Most units have dropped to 60% or below, causing severe throttling, constant shutdowns, and extremely short on-time. Battery replacement is the first and most urgent repair on this model. [→ iPhone X battery replacement]

Cracked Super Retina OLED screen

The iPhone X OLED display was Apple's finest display at the time of launch and still produces good colours and contrast. Cracks cause permanent OLED damage — green or pink lines, dead touch zones — that require full assembly replacement. [→ iPhone X screen replacement]

Face ID failure — TrueDepth sensor degradation

The original TrueDepth sensor array in the iPhone X notch has had 8 years to degrade, absorb moisture through small seal gaps, and suffer impact damage. Face ID failure is extremely common on iPhone X units at this age. iFixit BD diagnoses TrueDepth sensor faults independently. [→ iPhone X Face ID repair]

Dual camera — blur on main or portrait mode failure

The iPhone X dual camera system introduced Portrait Mode to the main iPhone line. OIS mechanical failure, telephoto flex damage, and 8 years of normal wear all contribute to camera quality degradation. [→ iPhone X camera repair]

Lightning port pins worn after 8 years

Eight years of daily cable connections wear the Lightning port pins down completely. Cables become loose and fall out. Port replacement at this device age is often necessary rather than just cleaning. [→ iPhone X charging issues]

data.title: Audio Issue
data.description:
The iPhone 13 mini is one of the best phones on the market, considering its audio output quality. It has a dual stereo speaker with noise cancelation and spatial audio features. It has two speaker grills in the bottom part of the phone. Should keep in mind that, the left speaker grill is not a speaker but instead it is there to catch audio inputs for your voice calls and Siri. The audio-only comes out of the right speaker grill and is not a faulty feature. The two speakers of the iPhone 13 mini are located on the top and the bottom of the phone. The top speaker also serves its purpose as an ear speaker when in calls.

However, some users have reported a lot of different audio issues. The most common audio issues faced by iPhone 13 mini users are:

No sound on audio playback

No sound on voice calls

Distorted/Low sound on the speakers

Headphones not working

Audio not working or audio levels low after an update.

Phone stuck in Headphone mode

Ringer Switch not working/ Audio level increases or decreases automatically/ Physical audio level buttons not working.

These issues are the most common audio issues reported by users in the Apple support forum. There are some “Do it yourself” fixes available and advised to be attempted as a “first aid” for your audio issues by Apple professionals and users. They are:

Check the ringer switch to see if it is on sound mode

Restarting Your Phone

Disabling your Bluetooth on the iPhone 13 mini

Check if your phone is in DND (Do not disturb) mode

Check the sound notification settings and try turning noise cancelation off.

Try using headphones and check if the sounds come okay in headphones.

Try removing any protective cases

Clean speaker grills for dirt and debris

If none of the fixes work for your phone, you need to get it checked by professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones. In ifixit bd, we have experienced technicians who specialize in repairing iPhone 13 mini. Our service points are located at locations in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Try disabling Voiceover settings for your iPhone. From Settings > General > Accessibility > Turn off voiceover.

You can also try resetting your previous settings

What are the common iPhone 13 Pro Max problems we fix?

Battery capacity dropping after years of daily use

The iPhone 13 Pro Max battery was one of the largest ever fitted to an iPhone at launch — but after 4+ years of charge cycles, capacity has degraded significantly for most users. Unexpected shutdowns, short on-time, and slow performance throttling are all signs of a battery that needs replacing. This is the single most common repair we perform on this model. iPhone 13 Pro Max battery replacement

Cracked ProMotion OLED display

We replace the full assembly and verify ProMotion refresh rate and Face ID sensor alignment after every repair. iPhone 13 Pro Max screen replacement

Triple camera malfunction — blur, LiDAR failure, or lens switching

The three-lens system — wide, ultrawide, telephoto — plus LiDAR scanner is a complex optical and electronic assembly. Drops that impact the raised camera island, OIS mechanical damage, and flex cable wear all cause blur, autofocus failure, and LiDAR-dependent AR errors. We diagnose each module independently. iPhone 13 Pro Max camera repair

Lightning port charging intermittently

Four years of daily cable use packs lint into the Lightning port. Intermittent charging, cables that only work at certain angles, and complete charging failure are all common. We clean during every free diagnosis — flex cable replacement only when the cable is confirmed physically damaged. iPhone 13 Pro Max charging issues

Face ID not working after drop or repair elsewhere

  • If your camera flash isn’t working, try turning on flash from the control center and see if it works.
  • Try disabling Voiceover settings for your iPhone. From Settings > General > Accessibility > Turn off voiceover
  • Try Switching between camera lenses in settings.

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error codes – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

To check if your iPhone is updated

If the update still fails try updating from another pc

To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)

Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.

Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
The new iPhone 12 Pro is a standard IP68 rated, dust and water-resistant phone. This means it can resist dust and water coming in up to a certain level. However, it is not completely immune to water getting inside the iPhone and damaging it. Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole.

Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water. However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:

Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth

You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there

NEVER CHARGE YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU HAVE MADE SURE IT IS COMPLETELY DRY

If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth

If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers. With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 14 Pro Max fault. Apple's 2022 Pro flagship introduced Dynamic Island for the first time, alongside a 6.7-inch ProMotion OLED display, A16 Bionic chip, 48MP main camera, and Always-On Display. Screen replacement starts from ৳10,000, battery from ৳2,500, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone 14 Pro Max problems we fix?

Battery capacity declining — Always-On Display drains it faster

The Always-On Display on the iPhone 14 Pro Max runs the screen at a low refresh rate continuously — a useful feature that adds constant background battery drain. Combined with natural cell degradation over two years of use, battery replacement is the most common repair we see on this model. iPhone 14 Pro Max battery replacement

Cracked ProMotion OLED with Always-On Display failure

The 6.7-inch ProMotion panel supports always-on functionality via a low-power LTPO state. A screen crack or OLED damage that disables the always-on feature in addition to normal display function is common after a significant drop. We replace the full assembly and verify ProMotion and always-on operation after every repair. iPhone 14 Pro Max screen replacement

Dynamic Island area damage causing Face ID failure

The Dynamic Island replaced the notch on the iPhone 14 Pro Max — and houses the TrueDepth sensor cluster. A drop to the front top edge of the phone can damage the sensors around the island cutout, disabling Face ID. iPhone 14 Pro Max Dynamic Island / Face ID repair

48MP main camera blur or focus issues

The 48MP wide camera introduced on the 14 Pro Max produces significantly larger files and higher detail — and is a more complex mechanical system. Drops, OIS misalignment, and flex cable damage all cause blur, autofocus hunting, and camera app instability. iPhone 14 Pro Max camera repair

Lightning port charging slowly or loosely

The iPhone 14 Pro Max uses Lightning — one of the last iPhone Pro Max models with this connector. Lint compaction and physical cable wear cause loose connections and slow or failed charging. We clean first — replacement only when cable is confirmed damaged. iPhone 14 Pro Max charging issues

data.title: Temperature High Issue
data.description:
However, users have said that the phone tends to get hotter than the previous iPhones Apple has released. The new iPhone Se 2022 comes with a special thermal compound in the back area of the phone which helps to omit heat faster and more efficiently than previous iPhones. It may make your iPhone seem a lot hotter than the previous iPhones.

However, that doesn’t make the iPhone Se 2022 so warm that the users find it difficult to hold it down with their hands. This is a clear indication of overheating in the iPhone Se 2022. Some similar cases of overheating include:

Phone gets way too hot while charging and takes a long time to be fully charged

The phone gets hot and the battery drains drastically

You might see a notification that will say “Temperature high”

The iPhone gets warm in standby mode for no apparent reason whatsoever

(Note: if your phone gets too hot while transferring data for the first time from a previous iPhone, chances are it’s a one-time issue and will not happen again.)

These are some of the most discussed problems in Apple’s user threads and community. However, there are some DIY (Do it Yourself) fixes that you may try which may help you to resolve your overheating issues.

Disable background app refresh.

Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh

Turn off Bluetooth / Location services to reduce processes running in the background

Most of the users have reported that they are getting the heating issue in the latest iOS version, In that case

Try updating your iOS to later versions to check if it works for your phone.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone Se 2022 heating issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving your iPhone Se 2022 issues on your phone. ifixit bd is located in four different service points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Apple's third-generation SE packs an A15 Bionic chip and 5G connectivity into the classic 4.7-inch design with Touch ID — the most powerful small iPhone Apple has ever made. What are the common iPhone SE 2022 problems we fix?

Battery draining quickly on a small capacity cell

The 4.7-inch iPhone SE 2022 has a physically small battery — smaller than any other current iPhone. Combined with 5G connectivity and A15 performance demands, battery life was already limited from day one. After regular use, capacity drops further and the phone needs charging multiple times daily. Battery replacement is an especially impactful repair on this model. iPhone SE 2022 battery replacement

Cracked small 4.7-inch LCD screen

The compact 4.7-inch form factor makes the iPhone SE 2022 popular for one-handed use — but smaller screens are not necessarily more protected. A corner drop on the small body transfers more energy to the glass. Cracked screens and unresponsive touch are common results. iPhone SE 2022 screen replacement

Touch ID home button failing or not reading fingerprints

The Touch ID home button on the SE 2022 is both the phone's only biometric and a mechanical button. Normal mechanical wear, accidental liquid exposure, and prior repairs at non-specialist shops can all cause Touch ID to fail or the button to stop clicking. iFixit BD replaces the button assembly and restores Touch ID where the board-level pairing is intact. iPhone SE 2022 Touch ID / home button repair

Lightning port charging intermittently

The Lightning port on a small, pocketable phone like the SE 2022 collects lint quickly. Intermittent charging, the cable only working in one position, and no charging response are all common. We clean during every free diagnosis. iPhone SE 2022 charging issues

5G connectivity dropping or no signal

5G on the iPhone SE 2022 is built on an antenna design in a small chassis with limited internal space. Drops can shift the antenna flex cables and cause dropped connections, no service, or persistent 4G fallback even in 5G coverage areas. iPhone SE 2022 signal issues

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone 6s plus heating issues. data.title: Face ID Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone X comes with a distinct feature named Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. This feature was made available from the iPhone X models and the later Apple A12x Bionic chipsets. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided with the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

Face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature...

  • Face not recognized
  • Face ID is not available at the moment
  • Move the camera a bit lower/higher
  • Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me into Passcode and not Face ID.

These common issues however have some home remedies which may work for your iPhone. These fix attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

  • Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode
  • if you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way.
  • Make sure you face the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing between your face and camera region.
  • Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy.
  • Update your iOS to the latest version.

If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID instead prompt with a passcode. The reasons may be:

  • User might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone.
  • The user may have just restarted the device.
  • The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours.
  • The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days.
  • The device has not been unlocked by face ID in the last 4 hours.
  • The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from safe space.
  • If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts.
  • If at Face ID set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all.

If your iPhone X Face ID problems can’t be categorized and sorted by the above-mentioned issues and fixes, you may just need to take it to an extremely diligent iPhone technician to deal with Face ID issues. data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 13 Pro offers a set of microphones to ensure your iPhone makes the best out of the audio inputs it receives. The iPhone offers the users a dual speaker and microphone to ensure the best listening experience for their users. However, it is often reported by iPhone 13 pro users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones. The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are:

Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/ voice memos

Low or unclear voice in Facetime, skype, or video recording

Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic

Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands

The iPhone 13 pro has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes.

The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls

One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri

The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY(Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes

data.description:
The most common issues however are often discussed upon Apple’s user forum and the most common problems found regarding networks in iPhone 7 plus are:

  • iPhone 7 plus gets down to 0 network bars randomly
  • Network quality drops from 4G to 2G/3G.
  • Cannot access metered/Cellular internet connection through Carrier or the SIM Company.
  • Network never reaches the full level.

These common issues however can be a network receptor hardware glitch of the iPhone 7 plus. To resolve these Apple recommends its iPhone 7 plus users some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes as a home remedy, such as:

  • Toggle Airplane Mode on and off to reset the previous network settings and cache.
  • Remove your sim card and reinstall it again. (requires a restart of the device)
  • Set up the internet for your phone if you’re facing internet issues through the network for the first time.
  • To set up go to- Settings > Mobile Data > Mobile Data Network

then:

  • Insert APN (Access Point Name) provided by your carrier 
  • Insert Username (provided by your carrier)
  • Insert Password (provided by your carrier)
  • Save the settings by pressing the left arrow at the top.
  • Make sure your Data connection is on after setting up the network before you access the internet.
  • Install carrier update for your iPhone (Check-in Settings > General > About)
  • Restart your iPhone
  • Soft reset your iPhone

If none of the solutions work for your iPhone, you might need your phone to get checked by a professional technician. data.description:
Users need to update iOS regularly to maintain the stable and smooth operation of the iPhone. However, sometimes a user may face some unforeseen problems. Like the Boot loop in this instance, where the phone starts and shows the Apple logo. Then goes black and again shows only the apple logo on the screen, the phone can show nothing beyond that.

This issue happens mostly when there is a failed or interrupted software update happens on your phone. Also, other issues may cause your phone to boot loop such as:

Hardware Damage

Physical Damage (Dropping the phone from your hand, etc.)

Battery connector may have gotten loose or have gone bad.

Improper or failed update that is missing necessary files to get the phone started.

If you think one of the above issues is causing the boot looping error on your phone, you may just try these fixes listed below and see if they work to resolve your issue.

Force Restart Your iPhone 16

(press the volume up button (+) then release the button. And then quickly press and release the volume down (-) and then hold the power button again until your screen turns black and shows the apple logo)

Check if your iPhone is fully charged or is charging properly.

Connect your iPhone to your computer and try restoring or updating the software through the iTunes application.

If your phone still doesn’t recover from boot looing after trying these fixes, something may have gone wrong which can only be fixed by a professional iPhone technician.

This is where ifixit bd comes in, ifixit bd is a prominent iPhone servicing center that has 4 different service points ranging in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
