data.title: Audio Issue
data.description:
It has a speaker grill in the bottom part of the phone. It should be kept in mind that, the speaker grill is there to catch audio inputs for your voice calls and Siri. The two speakers of the iPhone 8 are located on the bottom of the phone. The top speaker also serves its purpose as an ear speaker when in calls. 

However, some users have reported a lot of different audio issues. The most common audio issues faced by iPhone 8 users are:

  • No sound in audio playback
  • No sound in voice calls
  • Distorted sound/Low sound on the speakers
  • Headphones not working
  • Audio not working or audio levels low after an update.
  • Phone stuck in Headphone mode
  • Ringer Switch not working/ Audio level increases or decreases automatically/ Physical audio level buttons not working.

These issues are the most common audio issues reported by users in the Apple support forum. There are some “Do it yourself” fixes available and advised to be attempted as a “first aid” for your audio issues by Apple professionals and users. Those are:

  • Checking the ringer switch to see if it is on the sound mode
  • Restarting Your Phone
  • Disabling your Bluetooth in the iPhone 8
  • Check if your phone is in DND (Do not disturb) mode
  • Check sound notification settings and try turning noise cancellation off.
  • Try using headphones and check if the sounds come okay in headphones.
  • Try removing any protective cases
  • Clean the speaker grills for dirt and debris

if none of the fixes works for your phone you need to get it checked by professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones. data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The iPhone 6s has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes

  • The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls
  • One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri
  • The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.

Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.

Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

data.title: Error Solution
data.description:
Sometimes when you update your iPhone, or when you try to run your phone you may see some sort of black screen with some sort of Error with a number on your iPhone’s screen out of nowhere. These messages with errors and numbers can be seen while booting up the phone or trying to upgrade the IPSW files from iTunes from a PC. These are Error Codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy. They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen in the iPhones are as follows:

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error code – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

  • To check if your iPhone is updated
  • If the update still fails try updating from another pc
  • To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)
  • Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.
  • Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info pages with possible DIY (Do it yourself) solutions.

The whole error code list: Error code list

However, not all problems can be fixed only by DIY fixes. Some errors might require some handy work around the inner parts of the phone which should be done by a professional iPhone technician. That is where ifixit bd comes in, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving errors in iPhone 11 pro max or any other iPhone devices. ifixit bd is a prominent Apple gadget servicing center based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We have service points in 4 different locations. We specialize in iPhone repairs and replacements of parts.

We offer service benefits like no one else does in Bangladesh, we ensure the best for our customers. We provide:

  • Free Error Diagnostics
  • Quick Servicing in possible situations
  • 30-days service warranty on applicable services
  • Money-back guarantee on applicable circumstances

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 11 Pro Max fault. The 6.5-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display, A13 Bionic chip, triple-camera system, and IP68 water resistance made the 11 Pro Max Apple's most capable iPhone of 2019. What are the common iPhone 11 Pro Max problems we fix?

Battery severely degraded after 6+ years

Six years of daily charging is severe degradation for any lithium-ion cell. iPhone 11 Pro Max batteries in use today show significant capacity loss — the phone barely lasts half a day, throttles under performance load, and shuts down unexpectedly. Battery replacement is the most urgent and impactful repair on this model at this age. iPhone 11 Pro Max battery replacement

Cracked Super Retina XDR OLED screen

The 6.5-inch OLED display cracks on impact and produces the permanent symptoms of OLED damage — green lines, dead touch areas, and black bleed patches. Screen replacement restores the full Super Retina XDR quality that made this phone worth buying. iPhone 11 Pro Max screen replacement

Triple camera failure — ultrawide or telephoto not engaging

The 11 Pro Max introduced the triple-camera layout that became the iPhone Pro standard. Drops to the large camera bump, OIS mechanical wear, and flex cable damage after previous repairs cause individual camera failures while other lenses continue working. We diagnose each module independently. iPhone 11 Pro Max camera repair

Lightning port not charging reliably

Six years of daily Lightning cable connections, lint compaction, and connector wear mean most 11 Pro Max Lightning ports are either fully blocked with lint or showing cable pin wear. We clean during every free diagnosis — flex cable replacement only when damage is confirmed. iPhone 11 Pro Max charging issues

Face ID stopped working

TrueDepth sensor failure after a drop to the front edge, or Face ID pairing broken by a previous non-specialist screen repair, are the two causes we see most. iFixit BD preserves Face ID during every screen replacement. [→ iPhone 11 Pro Max Face ID repair]

Now, as your go-to phone, the iPhone 14 may be exposed to the hazards of the outside world, such as dropping from your hand, water, and other forms of damage, which may lead to issues like unresponsive touch or a technical issues with the display, which may require getting your phone looked at by professionals to fix them.

Issues you might see that give you a hint it’s time to repair your display can be:

Cracked Screen (Usually requires just an upper glass replacement. Only if there’s no internal damage)

Color Line (Might be a display issue that requires the entire display unit to be changed.)

No Light on Display (A replacement of the display unit may be needed)

Touch Issues (Can be fixed by replacing the touch mechanism only)

Dead Pixel (Dark Spots on your screen; requires the display unit to be changed)

All of the issues are fixed on the services listed below which are available at ifixit bd.

Broken Upper Glass: if your iPhone 14 accidentally falls from your hand and you get a crack in the upper glass. You don’t need to change the entire display unit. In that case, make sure your screen is still responsive to your touch commands; only then can you change the phone’s upper glass. ifixit bd offers Broken Upper glass replacement for your iPhone 14 display at a very reasonable cost! Sometimes, the glass and the display seem to work, but they are unresponsive to your touch commands.

Touch Replacement: if your iPhone display isn’t visibly cracked, and the display is still working but unresponsive to your touch commands, you may need to replace the touch of iPhone 14 only. The latest iPhone (iPhone X and above) models have separate display and touch mechanisms. Therefore you won’t need to change your entire display unit in this case either. ifixit bd offers a Touch replacement for your iPhone 14 at a very reasonable cost! If none of the issues listed above apply to your iPhone 14 display and still have it not working properly, then you might have to replace the entire display unit.

Display Replacement: If your iPhone's screen doesn’t respond to any touch and doesn’t light up in the first place (also if the iPhone is visibly cracked), you may need to replace the display unit entirely. ifixit bd offers 3 types of display replacement services for your iPhone 14 if you want. You may replace the faulty display unit with the original display or other alternatives.

Here at ifixit bd, we have professional technicians who will take care of any problems regarding your iPhone 14 display at dedicated service points all over Dhaka, Bangladesh. We provide quick repair services and provide 24 months warranty on our services. We will ensure the best possible output regarding your iPhone 14 display issue at ifixit bd.

Apple's ultra-thin 2025 iPhone — a 6.6-inch OLED display, A19 chip, and a chassis thinner than any previous iPhone — is both a design achievement and a specific repair challenge. What are the common iPhone Air problems we fix?

The iPhone Air's extreme thinness means less material between the display glass and the surface it hits on impact. data.title: Error Solution
data.description:
Sometimes when you update your iPhone, or when you try to run your phone you may see some sort of black screen with some sort of Error with a number on your iPhone’s screen out of nowhere. These messages with errors and numbers can be seen while booting up the phone or trying to upgrade the IPSW files from iTunes from a PC. These are Error Codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy. They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen on iPhones are as follows:

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error codes – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

To check if your iPhone is updated

If the update still fails try updating it from another pc

To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)

Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.

Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info page with possible DIY (Do it yourself) solutions. However, not all problems can be fixed only by DIY fixes. Some errors might require some handy work around the inner parts of the phone which should be done by a professional iPhone technician. This is where ifixit bd comes in, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving errors in iPhone 14 or any other iPhone device. ifixit bd is a prominent Apple gadget servicing center based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We have service points in 4 different locations. We specialize in iPhone repairs and replacements of parts.

The Taptic Engine in an iPhone 11 Pro Max is responsible for providing haptic feedback, such as vibrations for notifications and the "click" sensation for the home button (on supported models). You might need to replace the Taptic Engine in your iPhone if you experience any of the following issues:

Signs You Might Need to Replace the Taptic Engine:

  • If your iPhone stops providing vibrations or feedback for notifications, calls, or system interactions.
  • The Taptic Engine works only occasionally or inconsistently.
  • The Taptic Engine produces grinding or buzzing noises that were not present before.
  • Error messages or diagnostics indicate an issue with the Taptic Engine.

Possible Causes of Failure:

  • Physical Damage: Dropping the phone or exposing it to water can damage internal components.
  • Software Bugs: Sometimes, a software issue may mimic hardware failure. Perform a factory reset or update the iPhone before deciding on hardware repair.
  • Wear and Tear: Over time, mechanical components can degrade and stop working properly.

iPhone 11 Pro Max repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 11 Pro Max fault. The 6.5-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display, A13 Bionic chip, triple-camera system, and IP68 water resistance made the 11 Pro Max Apple's most capable iPhone of 2019. We repair cracked OLED screens, failing batteries, Lightning port faults, triple-camera damage, and board-level issues using A-grade and Original parts. Screen replacement starts from ৳7,000, battery from ৳1,800, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone 11 Pro Max problems we fix?

Battery severely degraded after 6+ years

Six years of daily charging is severe degradation for any lithium-ion cell. iPhone 11 Pro Max batteries in use today show significant capacity loss — the phone barely lasts half a day, throttles under performance load, and shuts down unexpectedly. Battery replacement is the most urgent and impactful repair on this model at this age. iPhone 11 Pro Max battery replacement

Cracked Super Retina XDR OLED screen

The 6.5-inch OLED display cracks on impact and produces the permanent symptoms of OLED damage — green lines, dead touch areas, and black bleed patches. Screen replacement restores the full Super Retina XDR quality that made this phone worth buying. iPhone 11 Pro Max screen replacement

Triple camera failure — ultrawide or telephoto not engaging

The 11 Pro Max introduced the triple-camera layout that became the iPhone Pro standard. Drops to the large camera bump, OIS mechanical wear, and flex cable damage after previous repairs cause individual camera failures while other lenses continue working. We diagnose each module independently. iPhone 11 Pro Max camera repair

Lightning port not charging reliably

Six years of daily Lightning cable connections, lint compaction, and connector wear mean most 11 Pro Max Lightning ports are either fully blocked with lint or showing cable pin wear. We clean during every free diagnosis — flex cable replacement only when damage is confirmed. iPhone 11 Pro Max charging issues

Face ID stopped working

TrueDepth sensor failure after a drop to the front edge, or Face ID pairing broken by a previous non-specialist screen repair, are the two causes we see most. iFixit BD preserves Face ID during every screen replacement. [→ iPhone 11 Pro Max Face ID repair]

How does our repair process work?

Step 1 — Free diagnosis. Bring your iPhone 11 Pro Max to any iFixit BD branch. Fault identified, written quote at no cost.

Step 2 — Report and fixed price. Written fault report, fixed price, A-grade and Original side by side.

Step 3 — Confirm and repair. Most repairs same day. Board-level repairs 1–2 days.

Step 4 — Test together and collect with warranty. Full test with you present. Warranty begins from this moment.

Why repair your iPhone 11 Pro Max at iFixit BD?

Board-level micro-soldering lab. A13 component-level repair, ultrasonic cleaning, 18 years experience.

Dual-tier pricing. A-grade and Original prices disclosed before work starts.

Repair warranty. All parts and labour covered at /warranty-policy.

70+ expert technicians, 4 dedicated Dhaka branches, 500,000+ devices repaired.

Is the iPhone 11 Pro Max still worth repairing in 2026?

Yes for common faults, with an honest note on iOS.

Battery replacement is urgent. At ৳1,800–3,200 after 6 years, a new battery is the most cost-effective intervention available and completely transforms the daily experience.

iOS ceiling to consider. The iPhone 11 Pro Max is capped at iOS 17. New security updates have stopped. For users who need the latest apps, this matters — for reliable daily use, iOS 17 is still functional for most tasks.

iPhone SE 2022 repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone SE 2022 fault. Apple's third-generation SE packs an A15 Bionic chip and 5G connectivity into the classic 4.7-inch design with Touch ID — the most powerful small iPhone Apple has ever made. We repair cracked LCD screens, failing batteries, Lightning port damage, Touch ID button faults, and board-level issues using A-grade and Original parts. Screen replacement starts from ৳3,000, battery from ৳1,200, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone SE 2022 problems we fix?

Battery draining quickly on a small capacity cell

The 4.7-inch iPhone SE 2022 has a physically small battery — smaller than any other current iPhone. Combined with 5G connectivity and A15 performance demands, battery life was already limited from day one. After regular use, capacity drops further and the phone needs charging multiple times daily. Battery replacement is an especially impactful repair on this model. iPhone SE 2022 battery replacement

Cracked small 4.7-inch LCD screen

The compact 4.7-inch form factor makes the iPhone SE 2022 popular for one-handed use — but smaller screens are not necessarily more protected. A corner drop on the small body transfers more energy to the glass. Cracked screens and unresponsive touch are common results. iPhone SE 2022 screen replacement

Touch ID home button failing or not reading fingerprints

The Touch ID home button on the SE 2022 is both the phone's only biometric and a mechanical button. Normal mechanical wear, accidental liquid exposure, and prior repairs at non-specialist shops can all cause Touch ID to fail or the button to stop clicking. iFixit BD replaces the button assembly and restores Touch ID where the board-level pairing is intact. iPhone SE 2022 Touch ID / home button repair

Lightning port charging intermittently

The Lightning port on a small, pocketable phone like the SE 2022 collects lint quickly. Intermittent charging, the cable only working in one position, and no charging response are all common. We clean during every free diagnosis. iPhone SE 2022 charging issues

5G connectivity dropping or no signal

5G on the iPhone SE 2022 is built on an antenna design in a small chassis with limited internal space. Drops can shift the antenna flex cables and cause dropped connections, no service, or persistent 4G fallback even in 5G coverage areas. iPhone SE 2022 signal issues

The new iPhone comes with a powerful battery. The battery is optimized perfectly for the phone. However, it may be for some manufacturer error or something about some faulty apps optimization, you may not get the smoothest output from your iPhone 8 plus battery.

  • The battery of the iPhone 8 plus runs out after installing an app/ update of an app.

  • When not in use turn off WiFi/Cellular Data/Location/Bluetooth service in your iPhone
  • Don’t overcharge/ Frequently charge your iPhone 8 plus. It may reduce battery health.
  • Adjust your brightness settings in iPhone 8 plus to auto-brightness.
  • Turn off Background app refresh
  • From here: Settings > general > Background app refresh
  • Try running it on low power mode
  • from here: Settings > Battery > Low power mode ON
  • Turn off “reduce motion” to turn off aesthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help
  • Turn it off from here: Settings > General > Accessibility > Reduce Motion

If none of the aforementioned procedures work to resolve your battery draining issues, it may need to be looked at by a professional technician to get them resolved. data.description:
The new iPhone 13 Pro Max is an IP68 rated dust and water-resistant phone. However, once you have opened your iPhone once for repairing or any replacement of parts. The rating becomes null and void and your phone loses its IP68 rating. If your iPhone doesn’t have that IP68 rating, it means it can easily catch dirt or any form of debris from outside. Because it does not have that dust resistant substance and machine formed compact bonding like when it came from the company.

If you have dirt, dust, or debris on your iPhone, it may get in the way of your phone's functionality, for example:

  • Dirt can damage your speakers, therefore you might get very low audio output.
  • Dirt can get into your charging dock and can cause interruptions in charging

data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The iPhone 6 has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes

  • The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls
  • One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri
  • The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.

Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.

Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works

If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone 6 go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues in your iPhone 6.

Home button not working or Touch ID failing

Turnaround times vary by repair type. A battery swap wraps up same day, while logic board and water damage work takes longer because part availability drives the schedule.

What is an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max, replaces the failed component, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired component and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16 Pro Max repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16 Pro Max screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.9-inch LTPO OLED display assembly and calibrates True Tone, brightness, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked rear glass panel and reseals the housing so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max camera repair — Replaces the rear camera module, front camera assembly, LiDAR sensor, or camera lens when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max logic board repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max software fault repair — Recovers iOS when the device sticks on the Apple logo, restarts repeatedly, or fails a firmware update.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 7,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 20,000 and BDT 55,000. This tier covers OLED display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and logic board repair. Display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest component and labor cost on the iPhone 16 Pro Max.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 24,000. This tier uses a certified after-market OLED assembly that restores display output and touch response at the lowest cost.

How long does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair take?

USB-C on the iPhone Air is the single port for both charging and data. Daily cable insertion on an ultra-thin device puts more mechanical stress on the port mounting point than on thicker iPhones. Intermittent charging and loose connectors are early signs of port wear. iPhone Air charging issues

Now you can repair your faulty touch mechanism of the iPhone 11 Pro without having to change the entire display! Since the launch of the new iPhone X models, Apple has introduced a technology that separates the touch mechanism and upper glasses from the entire display. Therefore, users who face problems or issues in their display panels can get it looked at separately.

The iPhone 11 Pro also has a separate touch and display panel which integrates and works as a whole unit. If your phone has a faulty, unresponsive, broken or damaged touch, you need not replace the whole display unit. ifixit bd has a dedicated service to replace or repair your touch panel (not the entire display) in-service points located all over Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Signs that indicate a faulty touch mechanism in iPhone 11 Pro are...

  • Doesn’t work or No response / Program doesn’t open or respond after touching the icon
  • Delayed response or wrong response (Clicking on one place but the phone registers the touch elsewhere and opens an unrelated app)
  • Takes multiple touch attempts to open an app or perform an action on the phone.
  • Ghost Touch / Delayed Touch issue

If you see any of the signs on your phone you can safely assume that the touch mechanism is faulty and should be replaced. Because Apple uses Haptic touch on iPhone 11 pro and haptic touch ensures that there’s no struggle to operate the phone by touching it.

So, if you are facing any of the issues listed above, visit your nearest ifixit bd service point. We have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in iPhone 11 pro services. We also provide quick service for your ease of access and offer a 30 days warranty on our services. ifixit bd ensures your iPhone 11 pro issues will be sorted with original Apple components and accessories.

data.title: Rear Camera Replacement
data.description:
Even with such an amazing camera, it has been found that some users have found some issues regarding the camera. The most common issues regarding the rear camera of iPhone 16 Plus found in the Apple support forum and the internet are:

  • Black Display when the camera turns on/ nothing shows on the camera
  • LED Flash is not working
  • Photos seem too noisy/ grainy
  • Camera or iPhone freezes while zooming in
  • Camera freezes/ shows a black screen after an iOS update
  • Blurry, unclear photos
  • Out of Sync flash. This is a problem where a user wants to take a photo with the flash, but the flash gets triggered after the photo has been taken

These are the most common issues that are often reported by users in Apple service centers and user forums. However, there are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available that work as a remedy for these issues. If you are facing any of the above-mentioned problems, try doing so.

  • Removing any protective cases for your phone. Especially metallic or magnetic cases, which may hamper the proper functioning of your phone’s camera
  • Try Restarting your phone
  • Try cleaning your lenses with a microfiber cloth. Be careful not to scratch it
  • If your camera flash isn’t working, try turning on the flash from the control center and see if it works
  • Try disabling Voiceover settings for your iPhone. From Settings > General > Accessibility > Turn off voiceover.
  • Try Switching between camera lenses in the settings
  • You can also try resetting your previous settings

If none of the solutions work for you, you might need to get your iPhone looked at by professionals. Here at iFixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in servicing iPhone 16 Plus. We have service points located in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We have the best repair technicians for iPhones in Bangladesh, and they offer you quick service for ease of access.

data.title: Temperature High Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone SE 2020 comes with a generally better and more efficient better processor and battery than the previous iPhone series. Although, the users have said that the phone tends to get hotter than the previous iPhones Apple has released. Sometimes the iPhone SE 2020 is so warm that the users find it difficult to hold it down with their hands. This is a clear indication of overheating in the iPhone SE 2020. Some similar cases of overheating include

  • Phone gets way too hot while charging.
  • Phone gets hot and the battery drains drastically.
  • The iPhone can perform simple tasks e.g., Making a phone call, watching a YouTube video, taking a photo without getting hot.
  • The iPhone gets warm on standby mode for no apparent reasons whatsoever.

(Note: if your phone gets too hot while transferring data for the first time from a previous iPhone, chances are it is a one-time issue and will not happen again.)

These are some of the most discussed problems in Apple’s user threads and community. However, there are some DIY (Do it Yourself) fixes that you may try which may help you to resolve your overheating issues.

Disable background app refresh.

Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh

Turn off Bluetooth / Location services to reduce processes running in the background

Most of the users have reported they only get heating in older iOS, try updating your iOS to later versions to check if it works for your phone.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone SE(2) heating issues. data.description:
It is quite frustrating when you see there’s no network bar/ Wi-Fi signal strong enough near you. We use our phones mostly to stay connected with others most of the time, and problems like that keep us from staying connected. You may face a similar kind of problem with your iPhone XS MAX. It usually happens after a faulty or uncompleted update where you might see that:

  • There’s no network bar available at the top of the display. Restarting or reinstalling the SIM card doesn’t help. There is always “Searching” shown on the network bar.
  • There are no Cellular connections available for your phone. You can’t turn on, discover, or connect to available wireless Hotspot networks available near you through your iPhone XS MAX.
  • If you are facing this issue go to Settings > General > About and see if you find information regarding IMEI, Bluetooth location, Modem Firmware, etc. If there is nothing there then you have an issue with the modem firmware.

There are no DIY fixes available for this issue. You are going to be needed to take your iPhone XS MAX to an expert repair technician to resolve the “No modem firmware” issue. With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone Xs Max fault. Apple's 2018 flagship — a 6.5-inch Super Retina OLED, A12 Bionic chip, dual camera with Portrait Mode, and IP68 — remains a capable phone. What are the common iPhone Xs Max problems we fix?

Battery in critical condition after 7+ years

iPhone Xs Max batteries at this age typically hold 60–70% of their original capacity. The phone throttles heavily, shuts off unexpectedly at 20–30% remaining, and requires charging multiple times a day. Battery replacement is essential for any owner continuing to use this phone. [→ iPhone Xs Max battery replacement]

Cracked Super Retina OLED screen

The 6.5-inch OLED panel cracks and develops the permanent symptoms of OLED damage — green or pink lines, dead pixel columns, and complete touch failure in damaged zones. Full assembly replacement is the only solution. [→ iPhone Xs Max screen replacement]

The iPhone Xs Max's dual camera system powers Portrait Mode. Telephoto lens failure from a drop, OIS wear, and flex cable damage degrade Portrait Mode and zoom quality. [→ iPhone Xs Max camera repair]

Seven years of daily cable connections wear the Lightning port pins down to the point where cables fall out or charging fails entirely. Port cleaning and flex cable replacement are both services we offer. [→ iPhone Xs Max charging issues]

If you have bought a new iPhone 14 Pro, chances are that you bought it for the outstanding camera Apple promised in its launch. They have reported that they are facing some problems with the camera on their iPhone 14 Pro. There have been different kinds of problems reported by users with both the front and the back camera of the iPhone 14 Pro.

However, most users have faced similar problems that are listed down below...

Foggy lens

Grainy/ Out of-focus image

Black screen when the camera opens

Camera/ The iPhone freezes while zooming or switching lenses

Camera fails to open/shows a black screen/quality degrades after an iOS update

Camera Shaking

Issues regarding Face ID

Clean your lenses with a microfiber cloth.

Try removing metallic or magnetic protective cases if you use one

Restart your Phone.

data.title: Proximity Sensor Replacement
data.description:
The new iPhone 15 is a smartphone that has a lot of ambient sensors such as an accelerometer, a gyroscopic sensor, and a proximity sensor. The proximity sensor is probably the most used on your iPhone. This sensor is used for turning your phone’s screen off when it is placed near your face during a phone call. So that it may conserve battery or avoid unnecessary touch inputs by your face when talking. It may also be used for features like “Raise and Wake” and other minimal yet handy features.

However, you may face problems with the proximity sensor of your iPhone 15 over time. Some issues with the iPhone 15 proximity sensor reported by users of the iPhone 15 in the users' community are:

The proximity sensor is not working/ too sensitive. And turning the phone screen on and off during calls

The phone display doesn’t turn off during a phone call

The phone display doesn’t turn on automatically as it should after the phone call ends

These are the most common issues found in the iPhone 15 proximity sensor. There are some DIY (do it yourself) fixes you may try which may solve issues regarding your proximity sensor if they are very minor.

Apple recommends:

Try removing your screen protector, which may block the proximity sensors' proper working

Restart your iPhone

Update your iOS

If you have already tried the above-mentioned fixes and none of the fixes work for you, you might need to get your phone checked by a professional technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones. We have service centers situated in locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh. data.title: Cleaning Service
data.description:
The new iPhone 15 is an IP68-rated dust and water-resistant phone. However, once you have opened your iPhone once for repair or any replacement of parts. The rating becomes null and void and your phone loses its IP68 rating. If your iPhone doesn’t have that IP68 rating, it means it can easily catch dirt or any form of debris from outside. Because it does not have that dust-resistant substance and machine-formed compact bonding like when it came from the company.

If you have dirt, dust, or debris on your iPhone, it may get in the way of your phone's functionality, for example:

Dirt can damage your speakers, therefore you might get very low audio output.

Dirt can get into your charging dock and can cause interruptions in charging

Dirt can cause your iPhone camera lens to become damaged or foggy.

Dust may get in your iPhone which can sit and slow down other components, take up space in free areas, and cause heating issues on your phone. This may result in poor performance and slows your phone down.

So, you must get your iPhone cleaned once in a while after getting repair service, or if you think you need to get your iPhone cleaned. iFixit bd offers an iPhone cleaning service for a very reasonable cost. iFixit bd is a prominent Apple servicing center that specializes in iPhone fixes and replacements. iFixit bd is located on 4 different service points ranging from Dhaka, Bangladesh.

The Taptic Engine in an iPhone Xr is responsible for providing haptic feedback, such as vibrations for notifications and the "click" sensation for the home button (on supported models). You might need to replace the Taptic Engine in your iPhone if you experience any of the following issues:

Signs You Might Need to Replace the Taptic Engine:

  • If your iPhone stops providing vibrations or feedback for notifications, calls, or system interactions.
  • The Taptic Engine works only occasionally or inconsistently.
  • The Taptic Engine produces grinding or buzzing noises that were not present before.
  • Error messages or diagnostics indicate an issue with the Taptic Engine.

Possible Causes of Failure:

  • Physical Damage: Dropping the phone or exposing it to water can damage internal components.
  • Software Bugs: Sometimes, a software issue may mimic hardware failure. Perform a factory reset or update the iPhone before deciding on hardware repair.
  • Wear and Tear: Over time, mechanical components can degrade and stop working properly.

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 pro max is a standard IP68 rated, dust and water-resistant phone. This means it can resist dust and water coming in up to a certain level. However, it is not completely immune to water getting inside the iPhone and damaging it. Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water.

However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:

  • Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth
  • You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there
  • NEVER CHARGE YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU HAVE MADE SURE IT IS COMPLETELY DRY
  • If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth
  • If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers.

data.title: Boot Loop
data.description:
Users need to update iOS regularly to maintain the stable and smooth operation of the iPhone. However, sometimes a user may face some unforeseen problems. Like the boot loop in this instance, where the phone starts and shows the Apple logo. Then it goes black and again shows only the Apple logo on the screen; the phone can show nothing beyond that.

This issue happens mostly when there is a failed or interrupted software update on your phone. Also, other issues may cause your phone to boot loop, such as

  • Physical Damage (Dropping the phone from your hand, etc.)
  • The battery connector may have gotten loose or have gone bad.
  • Hardware Damage.
  • Improper or failed update that is missing necessary files to get the phone started.

If you think one of the above issues is causing the boot looping error on your phone, you may just try these fixes listed below and see if they work to resolve your issue.

  • Force Restart Your iPhone XR
  • (Press the volume up button, (+) then release the button. And then quickly press and release the volume down button (-) and then hold the power button again until your screen turns black and shows the Apple logo.
  • Check if your iPhone is fully charged or is charging properly.
  • Connect your iPhone to your computer and try restoring or updating the software through the iTunes application.

If your phone still doesn’t recover from boot looping after trying these fixes, something may have gone wrong that can only be fixed by a professional iPhone technician. This is where iFixit BD comes in. iFixit BD is a prominent iPhone servicing center that has 4 different service points ranging in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing iPhones.

We offer service benefits as no one else can; we provide our customers with...

We understand how important your iPhone is to you, so try to use genuine Apple parts for all your iPhone repair and restore services. We do not compromise on our quality.

data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The iPhone 6s Plus has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes

  • The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls
  • One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri
  • The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision

Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes. Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there

Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water. However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:

Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth

You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there.

NEVER CHARGE YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU HAVE MADE SURE IT IS COMPLETELY DRY

If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth.

If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers. iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi

Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issue has been resolved

Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again

Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection

Restore the default network connection

Update your iOS to the latest version available

data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 7 offers a set of microphones to ensure your iPhone makes the best out of the audio inputs it receives. The iPhone offers the users a mono speaker and microphone to ensure the best listening experience for their users. However, it is often reported by iPhone 7 users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones. The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are:

  • Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/ voice memos.
  •  Low or unclear voice in Facetime, skype, or video recording.
  • Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic.
  • Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands.

The iPhone 7 has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes

  • The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls
  • One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri
  • The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

  • Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.
  • Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.
  • Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works
  • If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone 7. go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues in your iPhone 7. ifixit bd has multiple service points located in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We offer quick service for your ease of access. On top of that, we provide a 30-days service warranty for applicable services provided by us.

iPhone 16e Original Battery

This is a genuine Apple battery for the iPhone 16e — the original 4,005 mAh lithium-ion cell with Apple's factory battery management system, not an aftermarket copy. The 16e carries one of the largest cells Apple has fitted in a 6.1-inch iPhone, and paired with the efficient A18 chip and Apple's C1 modem, it is rated for up to 26 hours of video playback. A genuine replacement restores that full endurance. Every unit is capacity-tested before sale.

Battery Technology and Specifications

Capacity: 4,005 mAh — a standout figure for this size class, and the reason the 16e is known for excellent battery life. Copy cells routinely overstate printed capacity while delivering measurably less; a genuine cell delivers its rated capacity.

Power management: Apple's factory battery management circuitry governs charging curves, thermal limits, and the accuracy of Battery Health reporting in iOS — the component copy batteries cut corners on, and the difference between predictable degradation and a cell that fails or swells.

Charging behavior: Restores the 16e's factory charging profile — up to 50% in around 30 minutes with a 20W or higher USB-C adapter, plus Qi wireless charging at up to 7.5W. Note the iPhone 16e does not support MagSafe; that is the phone's design, not a limitation of this battery.

Safety: Genuine Apple cells meet Apple's thermal and overcharge protection standards. Swollen and overheating batteries in the repair market are overwhelmingly low-grade copy cells.

Why a Genuine Battery Matters

A degraded battery shows up as faster percentage drain, slowdowns under peak load, and eventually a battery service message. A genuine replacement resolves all three as Apple designed. Since iOS 18.1, iOS can report Battery Health for replacement batteries after Apple's Repair Assistant is run following installation.

Compatibility

Fits the iPhone 16e only. Battery dimensions, connectors, and management firmware differ between models — batteries are never cross-compatible.

iPhone 16e Original Battery Price in Bangladesh

The original iPhone 16e battery costs Tk 5500 at iFixit BD, including capacity testing before sale and an 18-month warranty. Copy cells sell for less but routinely deliver below their printed capacity and carry real swelling and overheating risks — a genuine 4,005 mAh cell is the only grade that restores the 16e's rated 26-hour endurance safely.

Condition, Warranty, and Ordering

Capacity-tested before sale, backed by an 18-month warranty and a 30-day money-back guarantee. Order on WhatsApp, call 01613338800, or visit any iFixit BD branch in Dhaka.

data.description:
The new iPhone 13 mini offers one of the best displays of high DPI. It has also ensured maximum safety for its users by putting gorilla glass in both back and the front. However, not all damage to the display comes from dropping the device from the hands and shattering it. Some users of the iPhone 13 mini have reported a sudden black screen with no prior damage history. The No light on Display issue of the iPhone 13 mini is where the user can’t see what’s happening on the phone. The phone is running okay. The phone vibrates and the user can hear the notification sounds and other inputs. But the problem is they can not see any of it because the phone display is just plain black. The phone will respond or might even have incoming calls.

The key symptoms of the “No light on Display” issues are:

The phone's display boots up with an Apple logo but doesn’t get past the black screen (iPhone 6 – 8Plus) 

The phone has calls and notifications but doesn’t show anything on display

iPhone can charge (you can hear the sound that the phone makes while charging) but won’t show anything on the display

This “No light on display” is usually an internal issue with the LCD connector. However, Apple recommends some processes to practice on your phone to make sure the black screen is not a software glitch.

Force Restart your iPhone. (Press the volume up (+) and volume down (-) and then press and hold the power button until the Apple logo appears on the screen) 

Connect the lightning cable and charge it for 10 minutes. Then try force restarting the iPhone

UNCONVENTIONAL: But press the screen into the phone so it may reconnect to any dislodged LCD connector. This fix is not recommended, however it resolved a lot of the user's Black Display issues. It might be risky for any layman. 

If none of the fixes work to resolve the issue on your iPhone, you may need to get it looked at by experienced professionals who specialize in iPhone issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in resolving No light on display issues on your iPhone 13 mini. We are a service center that operates based on 4 different and convenient points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service restores your damaged handset to full working order through diagnostics, component replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, logic board repair, and software fault repair.

Repair costs sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a charging port cleanup cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an OLED display swap cost the most. Screen replacement pricing follows the same three tiers.

Turnaround times vary by repair type. A battery swap wraps up same day, while logic board and water damage work takes longer because part availability drives the schedule.

You pick the replacement part grade before work starts. New genuine parts, used genuine parts, OEM-grade parts, and certified after-market parts each carry a different price and a different effect on parts and service history reporting. Every repair ships with a parts and labor warranty.

Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic and ending when you collect a function-tested device. Walk in or reserve your slot ahead — booking ahead locks in the part you need.

What is an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max, replaces the failed component, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired component and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16 Pro Max repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16 Pro Max screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.9-inch LTPO OLED display assembly and calibrates True Tone, brightness, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked rear glass panel and reseals the housing so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max camera repair — Replaces the rear camera module, front camera assembly, LiDAR sensor, or camera lens when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max logic board repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max software fault repair — Recovers iOS when the device sticks on the Apple logo, restarts repeatedly, or fails a firmware update.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair costs between BDT 2,500 and BDT 55,000, depending on the failed component and the replacement part grade you select. The component determines the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Entry-level repairs cost between BDT 2,500 and BDT 6,000. This tier covers charging port cleaning, speaker replacement, microphone replacement, button repair, and software fault recovery. These repairs use inexpensive components and finish quickly.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 7,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 20,000 and BDT 55,000. This tier covers OLED display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and logic board repair. Display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest component and labor cost on the iPhone 16 Pro Max.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 52,000, depending on the display grade you select. The 6.9-inch LTPO OLED panel is the most expensive single component in the device, which places every screen replacement in the upper cost range.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 24,000. This tier uses a certified after-market OLED assembly that restores display output and touch response at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 26,000 and BDT 38,000. This tier uses an OEM-grade or used genuine display that matches original color accuracy and supports the ProMotion refresh rate.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 40,000 and BDT 52,000. This tier uses a new genuine Apple display that preserves True Tone, adaptive color temperature, Always-On display behavior, and clean parts and service history reporting.

You keep Face ID after any of these three grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

Which replacement parts are used for an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair?

The replacement part grades used for an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair are listed below.

  • New genuine manufacturer parts — Factory-new Apple components that deliver original performance and clean parts and service history reporting.
  • Used genuine manufacturer parts — Tested Apple components harvested from donor devices, offering genuine performance at reduced cost.
  • Original equipment manufacturer grade parts — Components built to Apple's specification by the same suppliers, matching original tolerances and materials.
  • Certified after-market parts — Independently manufactured components that pass quality certification and carry the same repair warranty.

You confirm the part grade in writing before the repair begins, so the quoted price and the fitted component always match. Genuine parts preserve adaptive color temperature, True Tone calibration, and accurate battery health reporting in Settings.

How long does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair take?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair takes 30 minutes to 5 working days. Component replacements finish within the same day, while board-level work extends across several days. Turnaround depends on part availability more than on repair difficulty, so a stocked display fits faster than a special-order camera module. Logic board repair and water damage repair take longer than component replacement, because both require diagnosis at circuit level, ultrasonic cleaning, micro-soldering, and staged testing between each step.

Does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair include a warranty?

Yes, an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair includes a warranty. Every repair carries parts and labor coverage that runs from the collection date. iPhone 6 repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD is one of Bangladesh's most established iPhone repair centres. We repair every iPhone 6 fault — cracked Retina HD screens, dead batteries, charging port failures, liquid damage, and board-level logic board issues — using both A-grade and Original parts with full pricing transparency. Screen replacement starts from ৳1,800, battery replacement from ৳900, and every repair begins with a free written diagnosis. Most common repairs are completed same-day.

What are the common iPhone 6 problems we fix?

Battery draining fast or shutting down suddenly

Every iPhone 6 in use in 2026 is running a battery that is at minimum 10–12 years old. At that age, lithium-ion cells hold a fraction of their original capacity — you may see 15% drop to 0% with no warning, or the phone shut off at 30%. Battery replacement takes 30 minutes and is the single best-value repair for this device. We replace approximately iPhone 6 batteries every month across our Dhaka branches. [ iPhone 6 battery replacement]

Cracked or unresponsive screen

The iPhone 6's 4.7-inch Retina HD IPS LCD display is still a sharp, usable panel — worth replacing rather than tolerating cracks or dead touch zones. We fit a full display assembly (digitizer, LCD, and frame together) and run a post-repair touch calibration and colour check before handing the phone back. [ iPhone 6 screen replacement]

Not charging or charging only at an angle

The Lightning port on the iPhone 6 collects dust and pocket lint over years of use — often what feels like a charging fault is simply a blocked port. During every free diagnosis, our technicians clean the port first before recommending a flex cable replacement. If cleaning resolves it, you pay nothing. [→ iPhone 6 charging issues]

Home button not working or Touch ID failing

The physical home button on the iPhone 6 is a mechanical component that wears down over time — it can become stiff, stop clicking, or stop registering presses entirely. Touch ID fingerprint recognition can also stop working after the button degrades or following an unofficial repair elsewhere that broke the pairing between the button and the logic board. iFixit BD replaces the home button assembly and restores Touch ID function where the pairing is intact. [ iPhone 6 home button repair]

Liquid damage

The iPhone 6 has zero water resistance — there is no IP rating on this model. Liquid that enters the chassis reaches the A8 logic board within seconds and begins corroding metal traces immediately. If your iPhone 6 got wet, power it off and bring it to iFixit BD the same day. We perform ultrasonic board cleaning using professional ultrasonic equipment and isopropyl alcohol (90%+) to remove corrosive mineral deposits before they cause permanent component failure. iPhone 6 liquid damage repair]

Won't turn on / boot loop / no service

If the iPhone 6 shows no response to the power button, restarts in a continuous loop, or shows no cellular service signal, the problem is at the board level. iFixit BD's micro-soldering lab diagnoses and repairs logic board faults — power management ICs, baseband chip failures, and boot-loop causes — that swap-only repair shops in Bangladesh cannot address. [ iPhone 6 software and boot issues]

How does our repair process work?

Step 1 — Free diagnosis. Bring your iPhone 6 to any iFixit BD branch. Our technician inspects the hardware and software, identifies the fault, and gives you a written quote at no cost.

Step 2 — Provide a report and a fixed price. You receive a clear fault report and a fixed price broken into parts and labour — A-grade and Original options shown side by side.

Step 3 — Confirm and repair. Once you approve, we begin. Most repairs are completed same day. Board-level repairs take 1–2 days.

Step 4 — Test together and collect with warranty. We test the repaired device with you present — screen response, battery charging, cellular signal, cameras — before you leave. Your [X]-month warranty starts from this moment.

A-grade parts are quality aftermarket components that fully restore function at a lower cost. Original parts are genuine Apple or OEM-equivalent components with better longevity, colour accuracy, and full iOS compatibility. All prices below include parts and labour. Diagnosis is always free — you pay nothing until you approve the written quote.

Software issues (OS reinstall) — from ৳500 | Turnaround: 1–2 hr

Each item links to a dedicated issue page with full repair details. A service/assembly charge applies where indicated — nothing is added at the counter beyond the quoted price.

Why repair your iPhone 6 at iFixit BD?

Free written diagnosis and fixed quote. We inspect your iPhone 6 at no charge and give you a written repair estimate before any work starts. You decide — no pressure, no surprise charges after the fact. Board-level micro-soldering lab. Most Dhaka repair shops replace parts. iFixit BD's technicians repair at the component level — micro-soldering faulty chips on the A8 logic board, performing ultrasonic liquid damage cleaning, and fixing power and baseband faults. This is what 18 years of repair experience builds.

Dual-tier pricing, fully disclosed. Every repair is quoted at both A-grade and Original part price. The price list above shows all costs including the assembly charge — nothing is added at the counter. Repair warranty. All parts and labour are covered. Warranty terms are published at /warranty-policy.
70+ expert technicians, 4 dedicated Dhaka branches, 500,000+ devices repaired. iFixit BD has been repairing iPhones in Bangladesh since [2008]. These are real operational numbers, not marketing copy.


Is the iPhone 6 still worth repairing in 2026?

It depends on what the issue is, and iFixit BD will tell you honestly before you spend anything.

Yes, repair is worth it for the most common issues. A battery replacement at ৳900–1,800 costs a fraction of any replacement phone available in Bangladesh today and adds 1–2 years of reliable daily use. A screen replacement at ৳1,800–3,500 is a strong value for a phone that otherwise functions well. These two repairs alone account for the majority of iPhone 6 jobs at our branches.

The iOS ceiling is a real factor. The iPhone 6 is capped at iOS 12 — Apple no longer issues security updates for this version, and an increasing number of apps have dropped iOS 12 support. For users who rely on banking apps or newer social media features, this is worth knowing before investing in a repair. For users who want a reliable everyday phone for calls, messages, and basic apps, iOS 12 is still functional.

Board-level damage needs an honest conversation. If the A8 logic board has severe liquid corrosion or multiple chip failures, repair costs can approach the resale value of the device. At iFixit BD, we give you a clear cost-vs-value assessment at the diagnosis stage — if repair is not the right answer for your specific situation, we say so.

For most iPhone 6 owners bringing in a failed battery, cracked screen, or charging fault, repair in 2026 remains a sensible, cost-effective decision.

What are the common iPhone 6 problems we fix?

Battery draining fast or shutting down suddenly

Every iPhone 6 in use in 2026 is running a battery that is at minimum 10–12 years old. At that age, lithium-ion cells hold a fraction of their original capacity — you may see 15% drop to 0% with no warning, or the phone shut off at 30%. Battery replacement takes 30 minutes and is the single best-value repair for this device. We replace approximately iPhone 6 batteries every month across our Dhaka branches. [ iPhone 6 battery replacement]

Cracked or unresponsive screen

The iPhone 6's 4.7-inch Retina HD IPS LCD display is still a sharp, usable panel — worth replacing rather than tolerating cracks or dead touch zones. We fit a full display assembly (digitizer, LCD, and frame together) and run a post-repair touch calibration and colour check before handing the phone back. [ iPhone 6 screen replacement]

Not charging or charging only at an angle

The Lightning port on the iPhone 6 collects dust and pocket lint over years of use — often what feels like a charging fault is simply a blocked port. During every free diagnosis, our technicians clean the port first before recommending a flex cable replacement. If cleaning resolves it, you pay nothing. [→ iPhone 6 charging issues]

Home button not working or Touch ID failing

The physical home button on the iPhone 6 is a mechanical component that wears down over time — it can become stiff, stop clicking, or stop registering presses entirely. Touch ID fingerprint recognition can also stop working after the button degrades or following an unofficial repair elsewhere that broke the pairing between the button and the logic board. iFixit BD replaces the home button assembly and restores Touch ID function where the pairing is intact. [ iPhone 6 home button repair]

Liquid damage

The iPhone 6 has zero water resistance — there is no IP rating on this model. Liquid that enters the chassis reaches the A8 logic board within seconds and begins corroding metal traces immediately. If your iPhone 6 got wet, power it off and bring it to iFixit BD the same day. We perform ultrasonic board cleaning using professional ultrasonic equipment and isopropyl alcohol (90%+) to remove corrosive mineral deposits before they cause permanent component failure. iPhone 6 liquid damage repair]

Won't turn on / boot loop / no service

product_data.description:
Phone 16e Original Display

This is a genuine Apple Super Retina XDR OLED display assembly for the iPhone 16e, pulled from an original device — not an aftermarket or copy screen. The assembly includes the complete factory display stack: the OLED panel, the integrated touch layer, and the front glass with Ceramic Shield protection. Every unit is function-tested before sale and comes with an 18-month warranty against display defects.

Display Technology and Specifications

The iPhone 16e uses a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR OLED panel with a resolution of 2532×1170 pixels at 460 pixels per inch. Because this unit is pulled from a genuine device, every specification is the factory specification.

Panel: Self-emissive OLED with true blacks and deep contrast, since individual pixels switch off completely — a fundamental advantage over the Incell LCD panels used in most copy screens for this model.

Brightness: 800 nits typical and up to 1,200 nits peak for HDR content, with HDR10 and Dolby Vision support. Budget panels wash out in Dhaka sunlight; the factory panel stays readable.

Color and calibration: Full P3 wide color gamut with Apple's factory calibration and True Tone ambient color adjustment.

Design: The 16e uses the notch design rather than the Dynamic Island, with the cutout machined to factory tolerances so the Face ID TrueDepth system aligns correctly after replacement.

Refresh rate: 60Hz, exactly as Apple ships this model — the factory specification, not a limitation of the replacement part.

What "Pulled From a Genuine iPhone" Means

This display is disassembled from a genuine iPhone 16e — the panel was manufactured by Apple's display supplier and passed Apple's quality control before it reached us. The same OLED substrate, color calibration profile, and touch layer the phone shipped with. Every unit is inspected and function-tested at our branch before sale.

How It Compares With Copy Panels

Copy screens for the 16e are typically Incell LCDs: greyish blacks instead of OLED's true blacks, lower brightness, washed-out colors without P3 coverage, lost True Tone, and inconsistent touch layers. The pulled original panel is the only replacement grade that preserves the complete factory specification.

Compatibility

Fits the iPhone 16e only. Not compatible with the iPhone 16, 16 Plus, or the Pro models — the 16e uses the notch design and a different panel and connector. Check Settings → General → About if unsure.

iPhone 16e Original Display Price in Bangladesh

The original iPhone 16e display costs Tk 22000 at iFixit BD, including an 18-month warranty and per-unit testing before sale. This is the price of the genuine pulled OLED panel; copy screens sell for less in the Dhaka market but give up the OLED contrast, True Tone, and brightness this panel preserves.

Condition, Warranty, and Ordering

Every unit is a tested, fully functional pull in excellent condition, backed by an 18-month warranty against display defects plus a 30-day money-back guarantee. Order on WhatsApp, call 01613338800, or visit any iFixit BD branch in Dhaka.

  • iPhone 16e back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked matte back glass and reseals the aluminium frame so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16e camera repair — Replaces the single rear camera module or the front camera assembly when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16e facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16e speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16e microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16e water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16e motherboard repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.

data.title: Loud Speaker Replacement
data.description:
The New iPhone 16e offers Dual Speakers (One on the top and one at the bottom with receiver mic) and provides users with excellent sound quality. The iPhone 16e has two speaker grills at the bottom of the phone. Keep in mind that one speaker grill is for the mic to catch your voice inputs to your calls and Siri. This should not be confused with a broken or damaged speaker with no audio output.

If the top or the bottom speaker of your iPhone 16e is not working, you should check something before reaching any conclusions. Check if:

Make sure the ringer switch is on in the sound mode

Check for dirt or debris in the speaker grill at the bottom and the speaker hole at the top

Check your volume settings in Settings > Sound and Haptics > Ringer and Alerts > Volume Slider and make sure it’s on the optimum level

If there’s still an issue of not hearing anything through the speakers of iPhone 16e or the volume levels seem too low for it may need to be repaired or replaced. On ifixit bd, we have specialist technicians who specialize in repairing your iPhone 16e. We have service points where you may have your phone get looked at by our expert repairmen. We are located in service points over Dhaka, Bangladesh.

These are the most common issues found in the iPhone X proximity sensor. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes you may try which may solve issues regarding your proximity sensor if they are very minor. Apple recommends:

data.description:
The new iPhone comes with an almost 4000 mAh battery. The battery is optimized perfectly for the phone. However, it may be for some manufacturer error or something about some faulty apps optimization, you may not get the smoothest output from your iPhone 12 Pro battery.

Most users have reported that the iPhone’s battery starts draining after the system has updated to iOS 14 Several other issues may cause battery drain issues also. These issues include:

The battery of the iPhone 12 Pro runs out too quickly after the update

The battery of the iPhone 12 Pro runs out after installing an app/ update of an app

The battery of the iPhone drains quickly after turning on the optimized charging mode

The iPhone Battery drains after the phone heats up too quickly

These are the most common problems regarding battery-draining found on the internet. Your issues may be one of them or not listed! However, we recommend trying some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes that may resolve your issue.

Turn off background iCloud/iTunes sync to save battery by a considerable amount

When not in use turn off WiFi/Cellular Data/Location/Bluetooth service in your iPhone

Don’t overcharge/ Frequently charge your iPhone 12 Pro. It may reduce battery health

Turn on optimized battery charging to save your battery life and protect it from draining

Adjust your brightness settings in iPhone 12 Pro to auto-brightness

Turn off Background app refresh

From here: Settings > general > Background app refresh

Try running it on low power mode

from here: Settings > Battery > Low power mode ON

Turn off “reduce motion” to turn off aesthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help

Turn it off from here: Settings > General > Accessibility > Reduce Motion
