data.description:
The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided by the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.  Face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature.

  • Face not recognized 
  • Face ID is not available at the moment 
  • Move the camera a bit lower/higher 
  • Upon Unlocking the iPhone directly takes me to the Passcode and not Face ID


These common issues, however, have some home remedies that may work for your iPhone. These fixed attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

  • Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode 
  • if you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way. 
  • Make sure you are facing the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing your face and the camera region
  • Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy 
  • Update your iOS to the latest version 


If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID, instead prompt with a passcode. The reasons may be:

  • User might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone
  • The user may have just restarted the device
  • The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours
  • The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days 
  • The device has not been unlocked with face ID in the last 4 hours 
  • The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from a safe space 
  • If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts 
  • If at Face ID is set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all 

If your iPhone 16 Pro Max Face ID problems can’t be categorized and sorted by the above-mentioned issues and fixes, you may just need to take it to an extremely diligent iPhone technician to deal with Face ID issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in issues regarding your iPhone 16 Pro Max. ifixit bd is located in four different locations across Dhaka, Bangladesh.

What is an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max, replaces the failed component, and verifies device function before handover. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired component and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

  • iPhone 16 Pro Max charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked rear glass panel and reseals the housing so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max camera repair — Replaces the rear camera module, front camera assembly, LiDAR sensor, or camera lens when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.

  • iPhone 16 Pro Max speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.

data.title: Rear Camera Replacement
data.description:
Apple revolutionized the entire line of iPhones with the iPhone XR series. The iPhone XR offers a triple camera setup of 3 different lenses with LED flash. Which easily makes the iPhone XR the best in its business. Even with such an amazing camera, it has been found that some users have found some issues regarding the camera. The most common issues regarding the rear camera of the iPhone XR found in the Apple support forum and internet are

  • Black display when the camera turns on/nothing shows in the camera
  • The LED flash is not working.
  • Photos seem too noisy/grainy.
  • The camera or the iPhone freezes while zooming in.
  • The camera freezes/shows a black screen after an iOS update.
  • Blurry, unclear photos
  • Out-of-sync flash. This is a problem where a user wants to take a photo with the flash, but the flash gets triggered after the photo has been taken.

These are the most common issues that are often reported by users in Apple service centers and user forums. However, there are some DIY (do it yourself) fixes available that work as a remedy for these issues.

  • If you are facing any of the above-mentioned problems, try doing.
  • Remove any protective cases for your phone. Especially metallic or magnetic cases, which may hamper the proper functioning of your phone’s camera.
  • Try restarting your phone.
  • Try cleaning your lenses with a microfiber cloth. Be careful not to scratch it.
  • If your camera flash isn’t working, try turning on flash from the control center and see if it works.
  • Try disabling VoiceOver settings for your iPhone. From Settings > General > Accessibility > Turn off VoiceOver.
  • Try switching between camera lenses in settings.
  • You can also try resetting previous settings.

If none of the solutions work for you, you might need to get your iPhone looked at by professionals. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in servicing the iPhone XR. We have service points located in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We have the best repair technicians for iPhones in Bangladesh, and they offer you quick service for your ease of access.

data.title: Charging Issues
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 has a beautiful battery that is optimized for using it for a reasonable amount of time. However, most of the users have complained the iPhone 11 charges very slowly in comparison to other smartphones on the market with almost the same range. However, even with an 18-W charger, some users face issues while charging their iPhone 11. The most common issues are as follows.

  • The iPhone 11 charges slowly or not at all.
  • The iPhone is not charging beyond 80 %.
  • An alert that shows that the accessory you are using to charge the iPhone is not certified or supported

These are the most reported issues for an iPhone 11 with faulty charging. You may try some home fixes that may resolve the issues.

  • Try changing the wall adapter or cable.
  • Check if there is no debris or dirt in both the charging dock and the charging adapter.
  • Make sure the USB is connected firmly on both ends.
  • Check the charging adapter or the lightning cable for visible signs of damage. Example: Bent pin, loose cable, etc.
  • if you have iOS 14 or above make sure you uncheck the “optimized battery charging” option to make sure it charges beyond 80 %.
  • To disable it go to: Settings > Battery > Battery Health > Optimized Battery Charging
  • Make sure you have no damage in your charging dock if unsupported device warning shows.

If none of the fixes seem to work for resolving your iPhone 11 charging issues. You may need to get it looked at by professionals. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who have expertise in resolving issues regarding iPhones. Our ifixit bd service points are located in four different locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh. We care about you and understand that your phone is very important. That is why we offer quick service for your ease of access. We also offer a 30-days service warranty for applicable services.

data.title: Touch Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 13 mini offers a haptic touch system instead of a 3D touch system that was available in the previous versions of the iPhones. The new haptic touch does not require assessing the strength of users like it needed to in the 3D touch system. Instead, it measures the area of your fingertips to decide the strength and length of the touch input provided by the user. This haptic touch is also a way to ensure your touch works for a long time. However, you might just face an issue anytime soon on your iPhone 13 mini regarding your phone’s touch.

The most common issues faced by the users that are reported in the iPhone 13 mini user community forum are as follows:

Very sensitive screen/screen response intermittently (means responses without the user having to input or auto touch)

Touchscreen in your iPhone does not respond at all

Delayed Touch issue

Touch doesn’t respond after dropping from hand. (Everything else seems to be working fine)

There are some fixes you might try to see if any of them work for your phone. They are listed below:

Make sure your touch screen protector doesn’t interfere with the proper operation

Make sure there’s no internal/external damage (cracking or shattering glass)

Disconnect your USB-lightning port to check if it works

If your phone is above normal temperature, wait for it to cool down and then try again

Restart your device

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get your iPhone checked by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues regarding touch on your iPhone 13 mini. ifixit bd is located in 4 different service points. which are in convenient locations for you around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.description:
MacBook Air 13 inch M1 liquid clean in Bangladesh

MacBook Air 13 inch M1 liquid clean is a professional service that removes corrosive liquid residues from the inside of a MacBook Air A2337 — especially from the logic board — before they cause permanent damage. After a spill, the single most important action is to power off the MacBook Air M1 immediately and bring it to a service center as fast as possible — every hour of delay accelerates corrosion and increases repair cost. In Bangladesh, a standard liquid clean service costs 6,000 to 12,000 BDT, with additional charges if component repairs are needed after cleaning. ifixit BD Dhaka provide emergency intake, ultrasonic cleaning, and a post-clean diagnosis for every M1 air liquid damage repair Bangladesh case.

What is MacBook Air 13 inch M1 liquid clean?

MacBook Air 13 inch M1 liquid clean is a professional repair service in which a liquid-damaged MacBook Air A2337 is fully disassembled and its internal components — especially the logic board — are cleaned using ultrasonic cleaning equipment and isopropyl alcohol (90% or higher concentration) to remove corrosive mineral deposits, salts, sugars, and conductive residues left behind by liquid exposure.

There is an important difference between liquid clean and liquid damage repair. Liquid clean is the first intervention performed as quickly as possible after a spill — its purpose is to halt corrosion before it reaches and destroys individual chips and circuits on the logic board. Liquid damage repair is the follow-up service performed if corrosion has already destroyed specific components — it involves replacing chips, connectors, or other parts that can no longer function after the corrosion damage. Getting a liquid clean MacBook Air M1 service done fast gives the MacBook the best chance of full recovery — often making component replacement unnecessary.

data.description:
The new iPhone 14 Pro Max offers a set of microphones to ensure your iPhone makes the best out of the audio inputs it receives. The iPhone offers the users a dual speaker and microphone to ensure the best listening experience for their users. However, it is often reported by iPhone 14 Pro Max users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones. The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are:

Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/ voice memos.

Low or unclear voice in Facetime, skype, or video recording.

Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic.

Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands.

The iPhone 14 Pro Max has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes

The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls

One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri

The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.

Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.

Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works

If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone 14 Pro Max go to Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues in your iPhone 14 Pro Max. ifixit bd has multiple service points located in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We offer quick service for your ease of access. On top of that, we provide a 30-days service warranty for applicable services provided by us.

data.description:
Sometimes when you update your iPhone, or when you try to run your phone you may see some sort of black screen with some sort of Error with a number on your iPhone’s screen out of nowhere. These messages with errors and numbers can be seen while booting up the phone or trying to upgrade the ipsw files from iTunes from a pc. These are Error Codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy. They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore, saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen in the iPhones are as follows:

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error codes – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

To check if your iPhone is updated

To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)

If the update still fails try updating from another pc.

Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.

Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info pages with possible DIY (Do it yourself) solutions.

data.title: Temperature High Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 comes with a generally better and more efficient better processor and battery than the iPhone X series. Although, the users have said that the phone tends to get hotter than the previous iPhones Apple has released. The new iPhone 11 comes with a special thermal compound in the back area of the phone which helps to omit heat faster and more efficiently than the previous iPhones. It may make your iPhone seem a lot hotter than the previous iPhones.

However, that doesn’t make the iPhone 11 so warm that the users find it difficult to hold it down with their hands. This is a clear indication of overheating in the iPhone 11. Some similar cases of overheating include.

  • Phone gets way too hot while charging and takes a long time to be fully charged
  • Phone gets hot and the battery drains drastically.
  • You might see a notification that will say “Temperature high”
  • The iPhone gets warm on standby mode for no apparent reasons whatsoever.

(Note: if your phone gets too hot while transferring data for the first time from a previous iPhone, chances are it’s a one-time issue and will not happen again.)

These are some of the most discussed problems in Apple’s user threads and community. However, there are some DIY (Do it Yourself) fixes that you may try which may help you to resolve your overheating issues.

  • Disable background app refresh.
  • Disable background app refresh from here: Settings > General > Background App Refresh
  • Turn off Bluetooth / Location services to reduce processes running in the background
  • Most of the users have reported they get the heating issue in the latest iOS version, In that case,
  • try updating your iOS to later versions to check if it works for your phone.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get it looked at by professional technicians who specialize in resolving iPhone 11 heating issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving your iPhone 11 issues on your phone. ifixit bd is located in four different service points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Possible Causes of Failure:

  • Physical Damage: Dropping the phone or exposing it to water can damage internal components.
  • Software Bugs: Sometimes, a software issue may mimic hardware failure. Perform a factory reset or update the iPhone before deciding on hardware repair.
  • Wear and Tear: Over time, mechanical components can degrade and stop working properly.

Cracked LCD screen

data.title: Error Solution
data.description:
Sometimes when you update your iPhone, or when you try to run your phone you may see some sort of black screen with some sort of Error with a number on your iPhone’s screen out of nowhere. These messages with errors and numbers can be seen while booting up the phone or trying to upgrade the IPSW files from iTunes from a PC. These are Error Codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy. They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen on iPhones are as follows:

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error codes – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

To check if your iPhone is updated

If the update still fails try updating it from another pc

To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)

Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.

Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info page with possible DIY (Do it yourself) solutions. However, not all problems can be fixed only by DIY fixes. Some errors might require some handy work around the inner parts of the phone which should be done by a professional iPhone technician. This is where ifixit bd comes in, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving errors in iPhone 13 or any other iPhone device. ifixit bd is a prominent Apple gadget servicing center based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We have service points in 4 different locations. We specialize in iPhone repairs and replacements of parts.

Battery at critical degradation after 8+ years

Most units have dropped to 60% or below, causing severe throttling, constant shutdowns, and extremely short on-time. Battery replacement is the first and most urgent repair on this model. The iPhone X dual camera system introduced Portrait Mode to the main iPhone line. OIS mechanical failure, telephoto flex damage, and 8 years of normal wear all contribute to camera quality degradation. [→ iPhone X camera repair]

Eight years of daily cable connections wear the Lightning port pins down completely. Cables become loose and fall out. Port replacement at this device age is often necessary rather than just cleaning. [→ iPhone X charging issues]

Introduction

Rear camera failure on iPhone 17e directly affects photo clarity, autofocus stability, and video recording performance. The rear camera module on Apple devices controls image processing, low-light capture, and optical stabilization, and any internal fault reduces output quality immediately. The iPhone 17e rear camera system depends on precise alignment between the camera module, iOS image processing, and sensor calibration. When the camera module gets damaged, the device shows blurred images, black screen in camera app, or unstable focus during capture.

At iFixit BD in Dhaka, Bangladesh, every iPhone repair starts with structured diagnostics. The repair process checks camera module integrity, motherboard connectivity, and image signal flow before replacement. We use original and high quality parts to restore stable performance and long-term reliability. A faulty rear camera also affects app-level performance in Apple applications like FaceTime, Instagram, and scanning tools. Proper replacement ensures full restoration of image quality, autofocus accuracy, and color balance across all use cases.

Common Signs You Need iPhone 17e Rear Camera Replacement

Rear camera replacement becomes necessary when the camera module fails to produce stable image output or stops responding inside the iOS camera interface.

Common symptoms include:

  • Camera app shows black screen or freezes on launch
  • Images appear blurry even after focus adjustment
  • Rear camera fails to switch between lenses
  • Optical stabilization stops working during video recording
  • Flash synchronization becomes unstable
  • Camera shakes or produces distorted frames

These symptoms indicate internal camera module failure or sensor-level damage.

data.title: Taptic Engine Replace
data.description:
The Taptic Engine in an iPhone Xs is responsible for providing haptic feedback, such as vibrations for notifications and the "click" sensation for the home button (on supported models). You might need to replace the Taptic Engine in your iPhone if you experience any of the following issues:


Signs You Might Need to Replace the Taptic Engine:

  • If your iPhone stops providing vibrations or feedback for notifications, calls, or system interactions.
  • The Taptic Engine works only occasionally or inconsistently.
  • The Taptic Engine produces grinding or buzzing noises that were not present before.
  • Error messages or diagnostics indicate an issue with the Taptic Engine.

Possible Causes of Failure:

  • Physical Damage: Dropping the phone or exposing it to water can damage internal components.
  • Software Bugs: Sometimes, a software issue may mimic hardware failure. Perform a factory reset or update the iPhone before deciding on hardware repair.
  • Wear and Tear: Over time, mechanical components can degrade and stop working properly.

product_data.description:
iPhone 17 Original Battery

This is a genuine Apple battery for the iPhone 17 — the original 3,692 mAh lithium-ion cell with Apple's factory battery management system, not an aftermarket copy. A genuine battery restores the phone's rated endurance of up to 30 hours of video playback, its factory fast-charging behavior, and Apple's safety standards. Every unit is capacity-tested before sale.

Battery technology and specifications

Capacity: 3,692 mAh in the physical-SIM variant sold in Bangladesh [VERIFY: stocked variant; eSIM-only variants carry a slightly larger cell]. Interestingly, the iPhone 17's efficiency — particularly its LTPO ProMotion display — lets it outlast some larger-capacity phones; that efficiency equation only works with a genuine cell delivering true rated capacity.

Power management: Apple's factory battery management circuitry governs charging curves, thermal limits, and Battery Health reporting accuracy — the component copy batteries compromise on, and the difference between predictable degradation and a cell that overheats or swells.

Charging behavior: Restores the factory charging profile — fast charging up to 50% in around 20 minutes with Apple's 40W adapter, and MagSafe wireless charging up to 25W with a 30W or higher adapter.

Safety: Genuine Apple cells meet Apple's thermal and overcharge protection standards — the most important safety factor in any battery replacement.

Why a genuine iPhone battery matters?

A degraded battery shows up as faster percentage drain, slowdowns under peak load, and eventually a battery service message in iOS. A genuine replacement resolves all three as Apple designed: full rated capacity, restored peak performance capability, and correct Battery Health reporting.

What is the price of iPhone 17 original battery in Bangladesh

The original iPhone 17 battery costs Tk 12,000 at iFixit BD, including capacity testing before sale and an 18-month warranty. The iPhone 17's all-day endurance comes from pairing a 3,692 mAh cell with highly efficient hardware — an equation that only holds when the cell delivers its true rated capacity, which copy cells sold cheaper in the market consistently fail to do.

data.title: Mic Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone X offers a set of microphones to ensure your iPhone makes the best out of the audio inputs it receives. The iPhone offers the users a dual speaker and microphone to ensure the best listening experience for their users. However, it is often reported by iPhone X users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones. The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are:

  • Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/ voice memos.
  • Low or unclear voice in Facetime, skype, or video recording.
  • Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic.
  • Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands.

The iPhone X has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes

  • The bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls
  • One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri
  • The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video.

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

  • Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes.
  • Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there.
  • Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works
  • If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone X
  • Go to Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues in your iPhone X. ifixit bd has multiple service points located in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We offer quick service for your ease of access. On top of that, we provide a 30-days service warranty for applicable services provided by us.

  • Turn on optimized battery charging to save your battery life and protect it from draining.
  • Adjust your brightness settings in iPhone X to auto-brightness.

  • Turn off “reduce motion” to turn off aesthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help

There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

  • Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issues have been resolved.
  • Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again.
  • Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection.
  • Restore the default network connection
  • ( Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)
  • Update your iOS to the latest version available.

If none of the solutions mentioned above works to resolve your Wi-Fi issues on your iPhone 6s plus, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. data.title: Boot Loop
data.description:
Users need to update iOS regularly to maintain the stable and smooth operation of the iPhone. However, sometimes a user may face some unforeseen problems. Like the boot loop in this instance, where the phone starts and shows the Apple logo. Then it goes black and again shows only the Apple logo on the screen; the phone can show nothing beyond that. This issue happens mostly when there is a failed or interrupted software update on your phone. Also, other issues may cause your phone to boot loop, such as:

  • Physical Damage (Dropping the phone from your hand, etc.)
  • The battery connector may have gotten loose or have gone bad.
  • Hardware Damage.
  • Improper or failed update that is missing necessary files to get the phone started.

If you think one of the above issues is causing the boot looping error on your phone, you may just try these fixes listed below and see if they work to resolve your issue.

  • Force Restart Your iPhone XS
  • (Press the volume up button, (+) then release the button. And then quickly press and release the volume down button (-) and then hold the power button again until your screen turns black and shows the Apple logo.
  • Check if your iPhone is fully charged or is charging properly.
  • Connect your iPhone to your computer and try restoring or updating the software through the iTunes application.

If your phone still doesn’t recover from boot looping after trying these fixes, something may have gone wrong that can only be fixed by a professional iPhone technician. data.title: Network Problem
data.description:
The iPhone 8 comes with upgraded network connectivity than the previous iPhone models and supports 4G network connectivity. Despite these technological advancements from the previous iPhone models, users have reported issues regarding the iPhone 8’s network connectivity. Such as loss in the network, prompt disconnections, inability to find or locate the network.

The most common issues however are often discussed upon Apple’s user forum and the most common problems found regarding network in iPhone 8 are:

  • iPhone 8 gets down to 0 network bars randomly
  • Network quality drops from 4G to 2G/3G.
  • Cannot access metered/Cellular internet connection through Carrier or the SIM Company.
  • The network never reaches the full level.

These common issues however can be a network receptor hardware glitch of the iPhone 8. To resolve these Apple recommends its iPhone 8 users some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes as a home remedy, such as:

  • Toggle Airplane Mode on and off to reset the previous network settings and cache.
  • Remove your sim card and reinstall it again. (requires a restart of the device)
  • Set up the internet for your phone if you’re facing internet issues through the network for the first time.
  • To set up go to Settings > Mobile Data > Mobile Data Network

then:

  • Insert APN (Access Point Name) provided by your carrier 
  • Insert Username (provided by your carrier)
  • Insert Password (provided by your carrier)
  • Save the settings by pressing the left arrow at the top.
  • Make sure your Data connection is on after setting up the network before you access the internet.
  • Install carrier update for your iPhone (Check-in Settings > General > About)
  • Restart your iPhone
  • Soft reset your iPhone

If none of the solutions work for your iPhone, you might need your phone to get checked by a professional technician. Rear camera blurry or not focusing

Battery completely depleted after years of use

Cracked LCD screen

The 4.7-inch LCD IPS Retina display cracks on drops. LCD-specific damage — white backlight bleed, colour banding, and unresponsive touch areas — require full assembly replacement. iPhone 7 screen replacement

iPhone 7 repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 7 fault. The iPhone 7 was the first iPhone without a headphone jack — it brought A10 Fusion performance, a solid-state home button that simulates clicking through haptic feedback, and IP67 water resistance in 2016. We repair cracked LCD screens, dead batteries, Lightning port faults, camera damage, and board-level issues. Screen replacement starts from ৳2,500, battery from ৳1,200, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone 7 problems we fix?

Battery completely depleted after years of use

A 9–10 year old iPhone 7 battery holds very little charge. Constant shutdowns, extreme performance throttling, and needing to charge multiple times daily are the visible signs. Battery replacement at this age is essential for any continued use. iPhone 7 battery replacement

Cracked LCD screen

The 4.7-inch LCD IPS Retina display cracks on drops. LCD-specific damage — white backlight bleed, colour banding, and unresponsive touch areas — require full assembly replacement. iPhone 7 screen replacement

Solid-state home button not responding

The iPhone 7 uses a solid-state home button — no physical moving parts — that simulates clicking through the Taptic Engine. When the Taptic Engine fails or the button's touch sensor wears out, the button stops responding entirely or provides no haptic feedback. iPhone 7 home button repair

Touch IC failure causing no touch response

Like the 7 Plus, the iPhone 7 can develop a Touch IC fault where the board chip controlling screen touch fails after a drop. Screen lights up normally but no touch input is recognised. iFixit BD's micro-soldering lab addresses this at the board level. iPhone 7 touch issues

Lightning port worn or completely failed

Nine-plus years of daily cable use wears the Lightning port pins to the point of failure. Port replacement is typically required rather than just cleaning at this device age. iPhone 7 charging issues

How does our repair process work?

Step 1 — Free diagnosis. Bring your iPhone 7 to any iFixit BD branch. Fault identified, written quote at no cost.

Step 2 — Report and fixed price. Written fault report, fixed price, A-grade and Original side by side.

Is the iPhone 7 still worth repairing in 2026?

Only for the most affordable, straightforward faults — with a clear iOS caveat.

Battery replacement is the only strongly recommended repair. At ৳1,200–2,200, a fresh battery is practical. But the iOS 15 ceiling is a serious constraint.

data.title: Face ID Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 Pro comes with a distinct feature named Face ID. Where it uses the iPhone user's face to unlock the phone. This feature was made available from the iPhone X models and the later Apple A12x Bionic chipsets. The Face ID feature uses the true depth, dual front cameras provided with the iPhone as the basic instrument for this feature. It also emits an infrared laser to convert your distinct and unique facial features into geometrical and mathematical data for the iPhone.

Face ID is a very complex technology, and users might often misinterpret one of its features as an error in the technology. Here are some common issues regarding the iPhone’s Face ID feature...

Face not recognized

Face ID is not available at the moment

Move the camera a bit lower/higher

Upon Unlocking iPhone directly takes me into Passcode and not Face ID

These common issues however have some home remedies which may work for your iPhone. These fix attempts are risk-free and do not risk damaging your phone.

Check if your face ID is on for iPhone Unlock. Go to: Settings > Face ID and Passcode

If you use a screen protector make sure it doesn’t obstruct the front camera in any way

Make sure you face the camera and nothing is covering or obstructing between your face and camera region

Restart your phone. Make sure there is no dirt or your front camera lens is not foggy

Update your iOS to the latest version

If your phone doesn’t unlock with Face ID instead prompts with a passcode. The reasons may be:

User might be wearing a face mask while opening the iPhone

The user may have just restarted the device

The phone has not been unlocked in more than 48 hours

The passcode has not been used to unlock the phone in the last 7 days

The device has not been unlocked by face ID in the last 4 hours

The iPhone has a remote lock on and is away from safe space

If a user fails to unlock the device after five unsuccessful face ID unlock attempts.

If at Face ID set up, your iPhone shows or tells you to move the device lower or higher. Chances are that the Device does not support face ID at all If your iPhone 11 pro Face ID problems can’t be categorized and sorted by the above-mentioned issues and fixes, you may just need to take it to an extremely diligent iPhone technician to deal with Face ID issues.

Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in issues regarding your iPhone 11 pro. ifixit bd is located in four different locations across Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.title: Wifi Issue
data.description:
Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most common reported iPhone 6 Plus Wi-Fi issues are...

  • Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone 6 Plus
  • Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver
  • Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi
  • High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections
  • iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi
  • iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection

These Wi-Fi issues found on iPhone 6 Plus are pretty common issues found on other wireless supported devices too! And does not necessarily indicate that there is something specifically wrong with your iPhone 6 Plus wireless hardware. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

  • Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issues have been resolved.
  • Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again.
  • Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection.
  • Restore the default network connection ( Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)
  • Update your iOS to the latest version available.

If none of the solutions mentioned above works to resolve your Wi-Fi issues on your iPhone 6 Plus, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhone 6 Plus Wi-Fi and its related issues. ifixt bd has 4 service points located in prominent locations around
Dhaka, Bangladesh.

iPhone 6 Plus repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 6 Plus fault. Apple's first large-screen iPhone — the 5.5-inch Retina HD display, A8 chip, optical image stabilisation, and Touch ID — launched in 2014. We repair cracked screens, dead batteries, Lightning port damage, Touch ID failure, the known Touch Disease board fault, and logic board issues. Screen replacement starts from ৳2,000, battery from ৳900, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone 6 Plus problems we fix?

Battery completely depleted — replacement is essential

A 10–12 year old lithium-ion cell holds almost no practical charge. iPhone 6 Plus batteries in service today require immediate replacement for any continued use — this is not a question of "when" but "now." iPhone 6 Plus battery replacement

Cracked 5.5-inch LCD screen

The 5.5-inch Retina HD LCD display shows standard LCD damage after cracks — white backlight spots, touch dead zones, and dark bleed patches. Full display assembly replacement restores complete function. iPhone 6 Plus screen replacement

Touch Disease — flickering grey bar and unresponsive touch

The iPhone 6 Plus has a known board-level fault called Touch Disease. A design weakness in the touch IC solder joints on the logic board causes a flickering grey bar to appear at the top of the screen, followed by complete touch failure. This is not a screen fault — it is a logic board fault requiring micro-soldering re-work to fix. iFixit BD's board-level lab addresses Touch Disease directly. iPhone 6 Plus Touch Disease repair

Touch ID home button not working

The physical home button and Touch ID sensor wear after 10+ years of use. Mechanical failure, touch sensor degradation, and broken pairing from prior repairs all cause Touch ID failure. iFixit BD restores Touch ID function where the board-level pairing is intact. iPhone 6 Plus home button / Touch ID repair

Lightning port completely worn after 10 years

A decade of daily cable connections has worn the Lightning port pins past usability. Port cleaning alone cannot restore function at this age — flex cable replacement is required. iPhone 6 Plus charging issues

iPhone 16 Pro Original Display

This is a genuine Apple Super Retina XDR OLED display assembly for the iPhone 16 Pro, pulled from an original device — not an aftermarket or copy screen. Display technology and specifications

The iPhone 16 Pro uses a 6.3-inch Super Retina XDR OLED panel with LTPO technology and a resolution of 2622×1206 pixels at 460 pixels per inch. Every specification below is the factory specification.

ProMotion adaptive refresh: The LTPO panel dynamically scales from 1Hz to 120Hz — full 120Hz smoothness for scrolling and gaming, dropping to 1Hz for the Always-On display. Aftermarket panels fixed at 60Hz cannot provide either; this one behaves exactly like the factory screen because it is one.

Brightness: 1,000 nits typical, 1,600 nits HDR peak, and 2,000 nits peak outdoor brightness with a 1-nit minimum — fully readable in direct Dhaka sunlight.

Integrated components: Factory touch digitizer with 120Hz touch sampling, Haptic Touch, ambient light sensing, and the Dynamic Island cutout at correct tolerances for the TrueDepth system.

How it compares with aftermarket and copy panels?

Compatibility

Fits the iPhone 16 Pro only. Not compatible with the 16 Pro Max (6.9-inch), iPhone 16, 16 Plus, or 16e.

data.title: Stuck On Logo
data.description:
The new iPhone XR offers its users better optimization and balance in software than the previous iPhone models. However, no matter how hard they try, there can always be some technical issues that can result in your iPhone malfunctioning. The Apple logo stuck issue was also found in previous iPhones, and it’s a frustrating issue. Your iPhone boots up, but instead of going to the home screen, it is stuck on the boot menu. This problem happens mainly/most of the time because of a software issue that happens due to an unclean or interrupted update.

  • This stuck-on-Apple-logo issue might happen in other instances too. Possible reasons might be
  • The iPhone has taken on some physical damage. (Dropping from hand)
  • The update was disrupted due to Wi-Fi disturbance/metered connection or cellular data loss.
  • A third-party app may have access to vital permissions, which can disrupt iPhones' productivity.

It is rare; however, your phone might be facing a hardware issue. Sometimes faulty hardware prevents the phone from booting up. These issues, however, can be resolved if it is just a bug or a glitch in the iOS software. You may try the following steps and see if they work for you.

  • Force Restart your iPhone XR.

(Press volume up (+) and then quickly press the volume down (-) button and hold the iPhone XR power button as long as the Apple logo appears again.)

  • Update your iOS software.

(If, while in the process of updating your software, the progress bar under the Apple logo has not moved for an hour, you may connect your iPhone to a PC and select “Update” when prompted.)

  • Remove all third-party apps from your phone. Install apps only from the Apple App Store.

Turn off the auto-update of your iOS apps to prevent further interruptions. BUT BE SURE TO UPDATE THEM ON A REGULAR BASIS MANUALLY.

If none of the fixes above work for you. You might have an issue that needs the touch of a professional iPhone technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in fixing iPhones. ifixit bd is a prominent iPhone servicing center that is located in 4 locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

The new iPhone 13 Pro comes with a generally better and more efficient better processor and battery than the iPhone X series. Force Restart Your iPhone 14 pro

Check if your iPhone is fully charged or is charging properly.

Connect your iPhone to your computer and try restoring or updating the software through the iTunes application.

data.description:
The iPhone 14 Pro Max comes with upgraded network connectivity compared to previous iPhone models and supports 5G network connectivity. Despite technological advancements from previous iPhone models, users have reported issues regarding the iPhone 14 Pro Max network's connectivity, such as loss of the network, quick disconnections, and inability to find or locate the network. The most common issues, however, are often discussed on Apple’s user forum and the most common problems found regarding networks in iPhone 14 Pro Max are:

iPhone 14 Pro Max gets down to 0 network bars randomly

Network quality drops from 4G to 2G/3G

Cannot access metered/Cellular internet connection through Carrier or the SIM Company

Network never reaches the full level

These common issues, however, can be a network receptor hardware glitch of the iPhone 14 Pro Max. To resolve this, Apple recommends its iPhone 14 Pro Max users some DIY (do it yourself) fixes as a home remedy, such as:

Toggle Airplane Mode on and off to reset the previous network settings and cache

Remove your sim card and reinstall it again. -requires a restart of the device

Set up the internet for your phone if you’re facing internet issues through the network for the first time.

To set it up, go to Settings > Mobile Data > Mobile Data Network.

then:

Insert APN (Access Point Name) provided by your carrier

Insert Username (provided by your carrier)

Insert Password (provided by your carrier)

Save the settings by pressing the left arrow at the top.

Make sure your Data connection is on after setting up the network before you access the internet.

Install carrier update for your iPhone (Check-in Settings > General > About)

Restart your iPhone

Soft reset your iPhone

If none of the solutions work for your iPhone, you might need your phone to be checked by a professional technician. data.description:
The iPhone 7 comes with a nonremovable battery. It also has apower button on top of the phone. This correlation between the power button and the Battery is unavoidable for the perfect operation of the iPhone. The iPhone has been designed to maintain it. However, many users have complained about issues regarding issues in their power supply and other power-related errors in their iPhone.

These power issues include:

  • The Phone does not turn on
  • The battery signal doesn’t show on the completely blacked out phone. Therefore you can not determine the problem.
  • iPhone won’t stay charged. The charge drains rapidly after disconnecting from the adapter.
  • iPhone doesn’t charge. It is stuck on the battery percentage you left it to charge on.
  • Can’t use the iPhone without keeping it on a constant power supply (eg: Connected to a wall adapter or power bank etc,)

These frustrating problems are however the most common issues found on iPhone 7. There are some widely renowned DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available on the internet which may help the issue on your device. Such as

  • Force restarting your iPhone
  • Check Your Lightning cable and adapter and see if they are functioning properly.
  • Check if there is any debris on the iPhone 7 charging porthole.
  • Limit background processes by stopping the background app refresh.
  • Try charging while keeping your phone switched off.
  • Sometimes excessive battery drain can be happening due to a bug that can be resolved by a software update. So try updating your iOS to the latest version.

If none of these methods work to resolve the issues on your smartphone, you might need to get it checked by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing your iPhone 7 power issues. ifixit bd is an iPhone servicing center located around 4 different service points around Dhaka, Bangladesh. data.description:
The new iPhone 11 Pro Max comes with a Lightning port, which is one of the most important parts of the smartphone. It can be charged with a Lightning cable and charges at a whopping 18 watts (fast charging). This can charge your phone to 50 percent in 30 minutes. And it can also be used as a USB 2.0 port.

However, after using the phone for a long time or by an accident, your charging dock of the phone may get faulty or damaged, and you might need to get it replaced. The most common issues of the iPhone 11 Pro Max charging dock are

  • The battery charges very slowly.
  • iPhone 11 Pro Max not charging beyond 80%
  • Charging Not available or liquid has been detected in the charging port error.
  • The charging dock can’t be connected to a USB-supported device through the Lightning cable.

If your phone has any one of these issues or something not mentioned in the list of the common issues,. You will still like to check out these DIY (do it yourself) fixes, which may solve the problem regarding the charging dock in your iPhone 11 Pro Max.

  • Make sure you don’t have any debris or dirt on your charging dock. This may prevent charging.
  • Make sure your power outlet isn’t faulty.
  • If your phone is wet, wait until it is dry to charge your phone.
  • Make sure you do not have the “optimized battery charging” option checked on your iPhone 11 Pro Max. If you do have it, make sure to disable it to charge your phone past 80%.
  • Disable optimized Charging in here: Settings > Battery > Battery Health.

Note: This option is only available on iOS 13 or later updates.

If none of the fixes cut it for you, you may need to get your phone looked at by professionals. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing this type of issue on iPhones. ifixit bd is located in service points around Dhaka, Bangladesh. We also offer quick service for your ease of access and a 30-day service warranty on applicable services.

data.title: Network Problem
data.description:
The iPhone XS MAX comes with upgraded network connectivity than the previous iPhone models and supports 5G network connectivity. Despite these technological advancements from the previous iPhone models, users have reported issues regarding the iPhone XS MAX’s network connectivity. Such as loss in the network, prompt disconnections, inability to find or locate the network.

The most common issues however are often discussed upon Apple’s user forum and the most common problems found regarding network in iPhone XS MAX are:

  • iPhone XS MAX gets down to 0 network bars randomly
  • Network quality drops from 4G to 2G/3G.
  • Cannot access metered/Cellular internet connection through Carrier or the SIM Company.
  • Network never reaches the full level.

These common issues however can be a network receptor hardware glitch of the iPhone XS MAX. To resolve these Apple recommends its iPhone XS MAX users some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes as a home remedy, such as:

Toggle Airplane Mode on and off to reset the previous network settings and cache.

Remove your sim card and reinstall it again. (requires a restart of the device)

Set up the internet for your phone if you’re facing internet issues through the network for the first time.

To set up go to Settings > Mobile Data > Mobile Data Network

then:

Insert APN (Access Point Name) provided by your carrier

Insert Username (provided by your carrier)

Insert Password (provided by your carrier)

Save the settings by pressing the left arrow at the top.

Make sure your Data connection is on after setting up the network before you access the internet.

Install carrier update for your iPhone (Check-in Settings > General > About)

Restart your iPhone

Soft reset your iPhone

If none of the solutions work for your iPhone, you might need your phone to get checked by a professional technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in resolving your network issues in your iPhone XS MAX. ifixit bd has 4 service points which are located in points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.description:
However, not all damage in display comes from dropping the device from the hands and shattering it. Some users of the iPhone XR have reported a sudden black screen without any prior damage history. The no light on display issue of the iPhone XR is where the user can’t see what’s happening on the phone. The phone runs okay. The phone vibrates, and the user can hear the notification sounds and other inputs. But the problem is they cannot see any of it because the phone display is just plain black. But the phone will respond or might even have incoming calls.

The key symptoms of the “no light on display” issues are

  • The phone display boots up with an Apple logo but doesn’t get past the black screen (iPhone 6–8 Plus).
  • The phone has calls and notifications but doesn’t show anything on display.
  • The iPhone can charge (you can hear the sound that the phone makes while charging) but won’t show anything on the display.

This “no light on display” is usually an internal issue with the LCD connector. However, Apple recommends some processes to practice on your phone to make sure the black screen is not a software glitch.

  • Force Restart your iPhone.

(Press the volume up (+) and volume down, (-) and then press and hold the power button until the Apple logo appears on the screen.)

  • Connect the lightning cable and charge it for 10 minutes. Then try force restarting the iPhone.
  • UNCONVENTIONAL: But press the screen into the phone so it may reconnect any dislodged LCD connector. This fix is not recommended; however, it resolved a lot of the user's black display issues. It might be risky for any layman person.

If none of the fixes work to resolve the issue on your iPhone, you may need to get it looked at by experienced professionals who specialize in iPhone issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in resolving no light on display issues on your iPhone XR. We are a service center that operates based on 4 different and convenient points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

We offer the best service options you can avail of anywhere regarding your iPhone in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We provide:

data.description:
The new iPhone comes with an almost 3200 mAh battery. The battery is optimized perfectly for the phone. However, it may be for some manufacturer error or something about some faulty app optimization, you may not get the smoothest output from your iPhone 14 Pro battery. Most users have reported that the iPhone’s battery starts draining after the system has updated to iOS 14 Pro Several other issues may cause battery drain issues also. These issues include:

  • The battery of the iPhone 14 Pro runs out too quickly after the update
  • The battery of the iPhone 14 Pro runs out after installing an app/ update an app
  • The battery of the iPhone drains quickly after turning on the optimized charging mode
  • The iPhone Battery drains after the phone heats up too quickly

These are the most common problems regarding battery draining found on the internet. Your issues may be one of them or not listed! However, we recommend trying some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes that may resolve your issue.

  • Turn off background iCloud/iTunes sync to save battery by a considerable amount
  • When not in use turn off WiFi/Cellular Data/Location/Bluetooth service in your iPhone
  • Don’t overcharge/ Frequently charge your iPhone 14 Pro. It may reduce battery health
  • Turn on optimized battery charging to save your battery life and protect it from draining
  • Adjust your brightness settings in iPhone 14 Pro to auto-brightness
  • Turn off Background app refresh From here: Settings > general > Background app refresh
  • Try running it on low power mode from here: Settings > Battery > Low power mode ON
  • Turn off “reduce motion” to turn off aesthetic animations in your phone to save battery life might help Turn it off from here: Settings > General > Accessibility > Reduce Motion

If none of the aforementioned procedures work to resolve your battery-draining issues, it may need to be looked at by a professional technician to get them resolved. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who have special expertise in repairing iPhones. Our experienced technicians are located in ifixit bd service points located in 4 different points in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We care about your phone and understand its importance. That’s why we offer quick service for your ease of access. We also offer a 30-days service warranty on applicable services provided by us.

What are the common iPhone Air problems we fix?

Screen cracking more easily due to the ultra-thin chassis

The iPhone Air's extreme thinness means less material between the display glass and the surface it hits on impact. Drops that would survive on a standard iPhone are more likely to crack the Air screen. We see this model frequently — OLED panel replacement and full display assembly replacement are the most common repairs. iPhone Air screen replacement

Battery draining quickly in a slim form factor

Apple fitted a smaller physical battery to achieve the iPhone Air's ultra-thin profile. Heavy users notice this — on-screen time is visibly shorter than on the standard iPhone air. When capacity drops further through normal degradation, the battery becomes noticeably insufficient for a full day. Same-day battery replacement restores performance. iPhone Air battery replacement

Frame bending from pressure or bag compression

An extremely thin aluminium-titanium chassis is more susceptible to frame flex from sitting on it, carrying it in a full bag, or dropping it on a flat surface. A bent frame creates a gap at the display seal, allows moisture ingress, and can damage internal flex cables. iFixit BD's frame repair and housing replacement service addresses this before it causes further internal damage. iPhone Air housing repair

USB-C port damage from frequent use

USB-C on the iPhone Air is the single port for both charging and data. Daily cable insertion on an ultra-thin device puts more mechanical stress on the port mounting point than on thicker iPhones. Intermittent charging and loose connectors are early signs of port wear. iPhone Air charging issues

Camera module misalignment after drop

The iPhone Air features a single large rear camera. A drop that impacts the thin rear chassis can shift the camera module or crack the lens. Blurry images, autofocus hunting, and app instability are the visible symptoms. iPhone Air camera repair

data.title: Wifi Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 13 mini has a new wireless firmware that can support up to 7GHz of wireless bandwidth speed. This gives the users unmatched speed in comparison to most of the smartphones in the market. However, there have been issues regarding the Wi-Fi of the iPhone 13 mini. And frankly, some users have taken issue with the phone saying that the phone disconnects from the wireless network frequently and without any warning.

Other issues like high ping or latency have often been reported by the users of the phone. The most commonly reported iPhone 13 mini Wi-Fi issues are…

Wi-Fi gets disconnected on iPhone 13 mini

Wi-Fi stays connected but there is no internet on the receiver

Slow Wi-Fi speeds on metered/ non-metered connections on Wi-Fi

High Latency/Ping on Wi-Fi connections

iPhone fails to connect to Wi-Fi

iPhone can’t discover your Wi-Fi connection

These Wi-Fi issues found on iPhone 13 mini are pretty common issues found on other wireless supported devices too! And it does not necessarily indicate that there is something specifically wrong with your iPhone 13 mini’s wireless hardware. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes available for your smartphone in this case.

Check your wireless router. Unplug it from the power source for 10 minutes and try again and see if the issue has been resolved

Turn your Wi-Fi off for five minutes and try again

Forget and reconnect your Wi-Fi connection

Restore the default network connection

(Reset from here: Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Connections > * Enter Passcode * > Confirm)

Update your iOS to the latest version available

If none of the solutions mentioned above work to resolve your Wi-Fi issue on your iPhone 13 mini, you may need to get it checked by a professional technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and professional technicians who specialize in repairing iPhone 13 mini Wi-Fi and its related issues. ifixt bd has 4 service points located in prominent locations around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

iPhone 13 Mini repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 13 Mini fault. The iPhone 13 Mini is the last truly compact iPhone — a 5.4-inch OLED display, A15 Bionic chip, and dual-camera system in the smallest iPhone form factor since the SE. We repair cracked small OLED screens, degraded batteries, Lightning port faults, camera damage, and board-level issues. Screen replacement starts from ৳6,000, battery from ৳2,200, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone 13 Mini problems we fix?

Battery draining very quickly — the Mini's biggest pain point

The iPhone 13 Mini has a significantly smaller battery than any other iPhone 13 model. Even at full health, battery life was the most-cited complaint from owners. After 4+ years of use and degradation, the battery situation is critical for most Mini users. Battery replacement is the single most impactful repair you can do for this device. iPhone 13 Mini battery replacement

Cracked small OLED screen

The 5.4-inch Super Retina XDR display is compact but fragile. Small phones are often used without cases due to their size appeal — this increases drop exposure. Cracks, OLED lines, and dead touch zones require full display assembly replacement. iPhone 13 Mini screen replacement

Lightning port not charging reliably

The compact body means the Lightning port is close to the bottom edge with limited cable strain relief. Lint compaction and cable wear are accelerated. Port cleaning resolves most charging faults at no parts cost. iPhone 13 Mini charging issues

Main camera blur or autofocus hunting

The 12MP main camera with sensor-shift OIS in the Mini's small chassis is susceptible to damage from drops — the camera bump protrudes significantly relative to the device thickness. Blur and OIS failure are common after drops on the rear. iPhone 13 Mini camera repair

Face ID stopped working

TrueDepth sensor damage from a drop or a prior non-specialist screen repair can disable Face ID on the 13 Mini. iFixit BD preserves sensor pairing during every screen replacement. iPhone 13 Mini Face ID repair

iPhone 16 Original Display

This is a genuine Apple Super Retina XDR OLED display assembly for the iPhone 16, pulled from an original device — not an aftermarket or copy screen. The assembly includes the complete factory display stack: the OLED panel, the integrated touch layer, and the Ceramic Shield front glass. Every unit is function-tested before sale and comes with an 18-month warranty against display defects.

Display Technology and Specifications

The iPhone 16 uses a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR OLED panel with a resolution of 2556×1179 pixels at 460 pixels per inch. Every specification below is the factory specification, because this is the factory panel.

Panel: Self-emissive OLED with a 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio and true blacks — individual pixels switch off completely, which no Incell LCD copy screen can replicate.

Brightness: 1,000 nits typical maximum, 1,600 nits peak for HDR, and 2,000 nits peak outdoor brightness, with a 1-nit minimum for comfortable night use. Fully readable in direct Dhaka sunlight, where lower-grade panels wash out.

Color and calibration: Full P3 wide color gamut with Apple's factory calibration, True Tone, and HDR support including Dolby Vision.

Front glass: Latest-generation Ceramic Shield — tougher than any smartphone glass before it, and well above the standard glass on copy screens.

Design: Dynamic Island cutout at factory tolerances, keeping the TrueDepth Face ID system correctly aligned. Factory touch digitizer with Haptic Touch.

Refresh rate: 60Hz, matching the iPhone 16's factory specification.

How It Compares With Aftermarket and Copy Panels

Aftermarket panels for the iPhone 16 vary widely: the better ones use lower-grade OLED with reduced brightness and imperfect color; copy panels are Incell LCDs with greyish blacks, weak outdoor visibility, and inconsistent touch. Both typically lose True Tone. The pulled original is the only grade with the complete factory specification.

Compatibility

Fits the iPhone 16 only. Not compatible with the 16 Plus (6.7-inch), 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max, or 16e. Check Settings → General → About if unsure.

iPhone 16 Original Display Price in Bangladesh

The original iPhone 16 display costs Tk 26000 at iFixit BD, including an 18-month warranty and per-unit testing before sale. The price reflects a genuine pulled Apple panel with full factory brightness, True Tone, and Ceramic Shield protection. For a lower price point, the High Quality aftermarket option is available and honestly labeled. The price covers the without installation.

Condition, Warranty, and Ordering

Tested, fully functional pull in excellent condition, backed by an 18-month warranty plus a 30-day money-back guarantee. Order on WhatsApp, call 01613338800, or visit any iFixit BD branch.

Battery completely depleted — replacement is essential

Mechanical failure, touch sensor degradation, and broken pairing from prior repairs all cause Touch ID failure. iFixit BD restores Touch ID function where the board-level pairing is intact. iPhone 6 Plus home button / Touch ID repair

A decade of daily cable connections has worn the Lightning port pins past usability. Port cleaning alone cannot restore function at this age — flex cable replacement is required. iPhone 6 Plus charging issues

data.description:
The new iPhone XS offers its users better optimization and balance in software than the previous iPhone models. However, no matter how hard they try, there can always be some technical issues that can result in your iPhone malfunctioning. The Apple logo stuck issue was also found in previous iPhones, and it’s a frustrating issue. Your iPhone boots up, but instead of going to the home screen, it is stuck on the boot menu. This problem happens mainly/most of the time because of a software issue that happens due to an unclean or interrupted update.

This stuck-on-Apple-logo issue might happen in other instances too. Possible reasons might be

  • The iPhone has taken on some physical damage. (Dropping from hand)
  • The update was disrupted due to Wi-Fi disturbance/metered connection or cellular data loss.
  • A third-party app may have access to vital permissions, which can disrupt iPhones' productivity.
  • It is rare; however, your phone might be facing a hardware issue. Sometimes faulty hardware prevents the phone from booting up.

These issues, however, can be resolved if it is just a bug or a glitch in the iOS software. You may try the following steps and see if they work for you...

Force restart your iPhone XS.

(Press volume up (+) and then quickly press the volume down (-) button and hold the iPhone XS power button as long as the Apple logo appears again.)

Update your iOS software.

(If, while in the process of updating your software, the progress bar under the Apple logo has not moved for an hour, you may connect your iPhone to a PC and select “Update” when prompted.)

Remove all third-party apps from your phone. Install apps only from the Apple App Store.

Turn off the auto-update of your iOS apps to prevent further interruptions. BUT BE SURE TO UPDATE THEM ON A REGULAR BASIS MANUALLY.

If none of the fixes above work for you. You might have an issue that needs the touch of a professional iPhone technician. However, it is often reported by iPhone 12 users that, they are getting trouble regarding the microphones in their phones. The most common issues reported in Apple’s user community forum and other blogs are:

Low or unclear voice sound in voice calls/ voice memos

Low or unclear voice in Facetime, skype, or video recording

Muffled or cracked sound while recording/calling using the mic

Siri doesn’t work/ can’t hear me/ can’t pick up commands

The iPhone 12 has at least 3 different microphones in different places for the phone for different purposes

At the bottom of the phone, the left speaker grill is the mic for voice calls

One near your proximity sensor, used for voice commands for Siri

The one in the back of your in the camera square. There is a tiny hole for the mic to pick up audio input while recording a video

Now your microphone issue may be caused by any of the one or all 3 microphones not working. There are some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes to try before you come to a decision.

Make sure if you use a protective cover for your phone. It doesn’t obstruct any speaker grills or mic holes

Clear the phone to check and make sure there isn’t any debris in there

Try recording your voice in a voice memo to make sure the mic works

If the mic works in voice memo make sure the app you are running has permission to use the microphone of your iPhone 12

go to: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and make sure the app is listed there for it to use the microphone.

If none of the fixes work for you, you may need it to be looked at by professional technicians. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in repairing and resolving issues in your iPhone 12. ifixit bd has multiple service points located in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We offer quick service for your ease of access. On top of that, we provide a 30-days service warranty for applicable services provided by us.

We ensure quality and do not compromise with it. Therefore, we use genuine Apple products to replace and repair your iPhone woes. So, visit your nearest ifixit bd service point to repair your iPhone 12 mic issues today.

data.title: Button Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 8 plus has 4 physical buttons and 1 switch to ensure maximum accessibility to its users. The buttons and the switches are:

  • Volume Up (+) button
  • Volume down (-) button
  • Ringer Switch
  • Power Button
  • Home button

The newer iPhone models have discontinued the Home button, which used to serve both the purpose of a home button and a fingerprint sensor. Apple has discontinued Home Buttons since the iPhone X models and has continued on the same policy till later. The iPhone 8 plus has a home button. It does not have a Face ID or a face unlock feature. Now with time, the buttons of your iPhone 8 plus may face wear and tear and may cease to function properly. The most common issues faced regarding the buttons of smartphones are:

  • The Sound doesn’t increase/decrease when I press the volume up or down key.
  • The buttons are stuck and can’t be pressed
  • The switch doesn’t work/automatically switches between ringer and silent mode
  • Home button doesn’t work/unlock the phone.

These are the most common issues regarding the physical buttons in the smartphone. However, Apple recommends restarting the device and updating the iOS in this case. And if it still does not fix the issues, it needs to be getting looked at by professionals. iPhone recommends using Assistive touch for the longevity of the physical buttons of the iPhone 8 plus.

data.description:
The new iPhone 8 offers one of the best displays consisting of a retina display and a significantly high DPI. Not all damage in display comes from dropping the device from the hands and shattering it. Some users of the iPhone 8 have reported a sudden black screen without any prior damage history. The No light on Display issue of the iPhone 8 is where the user can’t see what’s happening on the phone. The phone runs okay. The phone vibrates and the user can hear the notification sounds and other inputs. But the problem is they can not see any of it because the phone display is just plain black. But the phone will respond or might even have incoming calls.

The key symptoms of the “No light on Display” issues are:

  • The Phone display boots up with an Apple logo but doesn’t get past the black screen.
  • The phone has calls, notifications but doesn’t show anything on display
  • iPhone can charge (you can hear the sound that the phone makes while charging) but won’t show anything on the display.

This “No light on display” is usually an internal issue with the LCD connector. However, Apple recommends some processes to practice on your phone to make sure the black screen is not a software glitch.

  • Force Restart your iPhone.
  • Connect the lightning cable, charge it for 10 minutes. Then try force restarting the iPhone.
  • UNCONVENTIONAL: But press the screen into the phone so it may reconnect any dislodged LCD connector. This fix is not recommended however it resolved a lot of the user's Black Display issue.

If none of the fixes work to resolve the issue on your iPhone, you may need to get it looked at by experienced professionals who specialize in iPhone issues. data.title: Stuck On Logo
data.description:
The new iPhone X offers its users better optimization and balance in software than the previous iPhone models. However, no matter hard they try there can always be some technical issues that can result in your iPhone malfunctioning. The Apple logo stuck issue was also found in previous iPhones and it’s a frustrating issue. Your iPhone boots up, but instead of going to the home screen, it is stuck on the boot menu. This problem happens mainly/most of the time because of a software issue that happens due to an unclean or interrupted update.

This Stuck on Apple logo issue might happen in other instances too. Possible reasons might be:

  • The iPhone has taken in some physical damage. (Dropping from hand)
  • Update was disrupted due to Wi-Fi disturbance/metered connection or cellular data loss.
  • A third-party app may have access to vital permissions that can disrupt iPhones' productivity.
  • It is rare; however, your phone might be facing a hardware issue. Sometimes faulty hardware prevents the phone from booting up.

These issues however can be resolved if it is just a bug or a glitch in the iOS software. You may try the following steps and see if it works for you.

  • Force Restart your iPhone X

(Press volume up (+) and then quickly press volume down (-) button and hold the iPhone X power button as long as the apple logo appears again)

  • Update your iOS Software.

(If, while in the progress of updating your software, the progress bar under the Apple logo has not moved for an hour, you may connect your iPhone to a PC and select “Update” when prompted)

  • Remove all third-party apps from your phone. Install Apps only from the Apple App store
  • Turn off the auto-update of your iOS apps to prevent further interruptions. BUT BE SURE TO UPDATE THEM ON A REGULAR BASIS MANUALLY

data.title: Boot Loop
data.description:
The iPhone 11 Pro offers the users a new iOS version (iOS 13 upgradable to iOS 14) and updates it forward. Users need to update iOS regularly to maintain the stable and smooth operation of the iPhone. However, sometimes a user may face some unforeseen problems. Like the Boot loop in this instance, where the phone starts and shows the Apple logo. Then goes black and again shows only the apple logo on the screen, the phone can show nothing beyond that.

This issue happens mostly when there is a failed or interrupted software update happens on your phone. Also, other issues may cause your phone to boot loop such as:

  • Physical Damage (Dropping the phone from your hand, etc.)
  • The battery connector may have gotten loose or have gone bad
  • Hardware Damage
  • Improper or failed update that is missing necessary files to get the phone started

If you think one of the above issues is causing the boot looping error on your phone, you may just try these fixes listed below and see if they work to resolve your issue.

  • Force Restart Your iPhone 11 pro
  • (press the volume up button (+) then release the button. And then quickly press and release the volume down (-) and then hold the power button again until your screen turns black and shows the apple logo)
  • Check if your iPhone is fully charged or is charging properly
  • Connect your iPhone to your computer and try restoring or updating the software through the iTunes application

If your phone still doesn’t recover from boot looing after trying these fixes, something may have gone wrong which can only be fixed by a professional iPhone technician. data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole. Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water. However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:

Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth

You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there.

NEVER CHARGE YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU HAVE MADE SURE IT IS COMPLETELY DRY

If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth.

If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers.
