data.title: Network Problem
data.description:
The iPhone 13 comes with upgraded network connectivity than the previous iPhone models and supports 5G network connectivity. Despite these technological advancements from the previous iPhone models, users have reported issues regarding the iPhone 13 network connectivity. Such as loss in the network, prompt disconnections, inability to find or locate the network.

The most common issues however are often discussed upon Apple’s user forum and the most common problems found regarding network in iPhone 13 are:

iPhone 13 gets down to 0 network bars randomly

Network quality drops from 4G to 2G/3G

Cannot access metered/Cellular internet connection through Carrier or the SIM Company

Network never reaches the full level

These common issues however can be a network receptor hardware glitch of the iPhone 13. To resolve these Apple recommends its iPhone 13 users some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes as a home remedy, such as:

Toggle Airplane Mode on and off to reset the previous network settings and cache

Remove your sim card and reinstall it again. (requires a restart of the device)

Set up the internet for your phone if you’re facing internet issues through the network for the first time.

To set up go to Settings > Mobile Data > Mobile Data Network

then:

Insert APN (Access Point Name) provided by your carrier

Insert Username (provided by your carrier)

Insert Password (provided by your carrier)

Save the settings by pressing the left arrow at the top.

Make sure your Data connection is on after setting up the network before you access the internet.

Install carrier update for your iPhone (Check-in Settings > General > About)

Restart your iPhone

Soft reset your iPhone

If none of the solutions work for your iPhone, you might need your phone to get checked by a professional technician.Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in resolving your network issues in your iPhone 13. ifixit bd has 4 service points which are located in points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

  • Make sure your screen protector or case is not getting in the way of touch ID
  • Update your iOS

Also, make sure that Touch ID does not work if you have

product_data.description:
iPhone 16 Pro Max High Quality Display (120Hz)

This is a premium aftermarket OLED display assembly for the iPhone 16 Pro Max with 120Hz refresh support — the highest aftermarket grade available for this model. It is not a genuine Apple panel, and we say that plainly: iFixit BD sells both grades openly so you can choose with full information. What separates this panel from common copy screens is the OLED technology, 120Hz support, and per-unit testing before sale.

What you get with this panel

120Hz refresh support: Preserves the smooth scrolling that defines the Pro Max experience — standard aftermarket panels drop to 60Hz.

OLED panel: Self-emissive OLED with true blacks and strong contrast — a clear step above Incell LCD copy screens.

Full 6.9-inch fit: Sized to the 16 Pro Max housing with the Dynamic Island cutout at factory tolerances, keeping Face ID unobstructed after correct installation.

Tested before sale: Touch response, brightness, color uniformity, and dead-pixel checks on every unit.

Honest trade-offs vs the original panel

Compared with the genuine pulled panel: lower peak brightness (the original reaches 2,000 nits outdoors — visible on a screen this large), good-but-not-factory color calibration, and front glass below Ceramic Shield durability. What you keep: OLED contrast, 120Hz smoothness, accurate touch, and a substantially lower price.

Choose this panel if: you want the 120Hz feel back on a budget , or the phone is a secondary device. Choose the original panel if: you use the phone professionally or outdoors, or plan to keep or resell it at full value.

Compatibility

Fits the iPhone 16 Pro Max only.

iPhone 16 Pro Max high quality display price in Bangladesh

The iPhone 16 Pro Max High Quality 120Hz display costs Tk 16500 at iFixit BD — a fraction of the original panel's price, with per-unit testing and a 6-month warranty included.

Cracked Screen (Usually requires just an upper glass replacement. Only if there’s no internal damage)

Color Line (Might be a display issue that requires the entire display unit to be changed.)

No Light on Display (A replacement of the display unit may be needed)

Touch Issues (Can be fixed by replacing the touch mechanism only)

Touch Replacement: if your iPhone display isn’t visibly cracked, and the display is still working but unresponsive to your touch commands, you may need to replace the touch of iPhone 12 Pro Max only. model_data.allservice_page_description:
An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service restores your damaged handset to full working order through diagnostics, component replacement, and function testing. The service covers screen repair, battery replacement, charging port repair, back glass replacement, camera repair, Face ID repair, speaker and microphone repair, water damage repair, logic board repair, and software fault repair.

Repair costs sit in three tiers. Entry-level jobs like a charging port cleanup cost the least, mid-level jobs like a battery replacement land in the middle, and premium jobs like an OLED display swap cost the most. Screen replacement pricing follows the same three tiers.

Turnaround times vary by repair type. A battery swap wraps up same day, while logic board and water damage work takes longer because part availability drives the schedule.

You pick the replacement part grade before work starts. New genuine parts, used genuine parts, OEM-grade parts, and certified after-market parts each carry a different price and a different effect on parts and service history reporting. Every repair ships with a parts and labor warranty.

Booking takes six steps, starting with a free diagnostic and ending when you collect a function-tested device. Walk in or reserve your slot ahead — booking ahead locks in the part you need.

What is an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service is a technical service that diagnoses faults in an Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max, replaces the failed component, and verifies device function before handover. The service addresses display faults, power faults, camera faults, audio faults, liquid damage, and board-level faults. Every repair starts with a free diagnostic check that identifies the failed component before you approve any cost. Each completed repair passes a function test that confirms the repaired component and the surrounding systems operate correctly.

The iPhone 16 Pro Max repairs covered by this service are listed below.

  • iPhone 16 Pro Max screen repair — Replaces the cracked or unresponsive 6.9-inch LTPO OLED display assembly and calibrates True Tone, brightness, and touch response after fitting.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max battery replacement — Installs a new battery when battery health drops below 80 percent, then calibrates the cell so battery health reporting reads accurately.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max charging port repair — Restores the USB-C connector when the device charges intermittently, rejects accessories, or stops recognizing a cable.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max back glass replacement — Replaces the cracked rear glass panel and reseals the housing so the device retains its water resistance rating.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max camera repair — Replaces the rear camera module, front camera assembly, LiDAR sensor, or camera lens when images blur, shake, or fail to focus.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max facial recognition repair — Restores the TrueDepth camera and dot projector so Face ID authenticates, unlocks the device, and authorizes Apple Pay.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max speaker repair — Replaces the loudspeaker or earpiece when call audio distorts, media playback crackles, or one channel goes silent.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max microphone repair — Replaces the microphone assembly when callers hear you faintly, voice memos record silence, or Siri stops responding.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max water damage repair — Removes corrosion from the board with ultrasonic cleaning, replaces oxidized components, and restores the affected circuits.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max logic board repair — Repairs the failed integrated circuit at chip level when the device shows a boot loop, no power, or no display output.
  • iPhone 16 Pro Max software fault repair — Recovers iOS when the device sticks on the Apple logo, restarts repeatedly, or fails a firmware update.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair costs between BDT 2,500 and BDT 55,000, depending on the failed component and the replacement part grade you select. The component determines the base cost, and the part grade adjusts it. You receive a written quotation after the free diagnostic, and that figure holds through the repair.

Entry-level repairs cost between BDT 2,500 and BDT 6,000. This tier covers charging port cleaning, speaker replacement, microphone replacement, button repair, and software fault recovery. These repairs use inexpensive components and finish quickly.

Mid-level repairs cost between BDT 7,000 and BDT 18,000. This tier covers battery replacement, charging port replacement, rear camera replacement, front camera replacement, and back glass replacement. These repairs use moderately priced modules and require housing disassembly.

Premium repairs cost between BDT 20,000 and BDT 55,000. This tier covers OLED display replacement, Face ID and TrueDepth camera repair, water damage restoration, and logic board repair. Display assemblies and board-level work carry the highest component and labor cost on the iPhone 16 Pro Max.

You confirm the exact figure for your device during the free diagnostic, since the same symptom sometimes traces to different components.

How much does an iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement cost?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 52,000, depending on the display grade you select. The 6.9-inch LTPO OLED panel is the most expensive single component in the device, which places every screen replacement in the upper cost range.

An entry-level screen replacement costs between BDT 18,000 and BDT 24,000. This tier uses a certified after-market OLED assembly that restores display output and touch response at the lowest cost.

A mid-level screen replacement costs between BDT 26,000 and BDT 38,000. This tier uses an OEM-grade or used genuine display that matches original color accuracy and supports the ProMotion refresh rate.

A premium screen replacement costs between BDT 40,000 and BDT 52,000. This tier uses a new genuine Apple display that preserves True Tone, adaptive color temperature, Always-On display behavior, and clean parts and service history reporting.

You keep Face ID after any of these three grades, because the technician transfers the original TrueDepth assembly to the new display.

Which replacement parts are used for an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair?

The replacement part grades used for an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair are listed below.

  • New genuine manufacturer parts — Factory-new Apple components that deliver original performance and clean parts and service history reporting.
  • Used genuine manufacturer parts — Tested Apple components harvested from donor devices, offering genuine performance at reduced cost.
  • Original equipment manufacturer grade parts — Components built to Apple's specification by the same suppliers, matching original tolerances and materials.
  • Certified after-market parts — Independently manufactured components that pass quality certification and carry the same repair warranty.

You confirm the part grade in writing before the repair begins, so the quoted price and the fitted component always match. Genuine parts preserve adaptive color temperature, True Tone calibration, and accurate battery health reporting in Settings.

How long does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair take?

An iPhone 16 Pro Max repair takes 30 minutes to 5 working days. Component replacements finish within the same day, while board-level work extends across several days. Turnaround depends on part availability more than on repair difficulty, so a stocked display fits faster than a special-order camera module. Logic board repair and water damage repair take longer than component replacement, because both require diagnosis at circuit level, ultrasonic cleaning, micro-soldering, and staged testing between each step.

The turnaround time for each iPhone 16 Pro Max repair type is shown below.

Repair typeTypical turnaround timeSame-day availabilityScreen replacement45 to 90 minutesYesBattery replacement30 to 60 minutesYesCharging port repair60 to 120 minutesYesSpeaker or microphone repair45 to 90 minutesYesCamera repair60 to 120 minutesYesBack glass replacement2 to 4 hoursYesFace ID repair3 to 6 hoursYesSoftware fault repair1 to 3 hoursYesWater damage repair2 to 4 working daysNoLogic board repair2 to 5 working daysNo

You receive a turnaround estimate in writing alongside your quotation, and the service desk updates you when a repair moves between stages. Verify current figures against your own service records before publishing, since part supply changes turnaround ranges over time.

Does an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair include a warranty?

Yes, an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair includes a warranty. Every repair carries parts and labor coverage that runs from the collection date. The warranty covers component failure and workmanship faults on the repaired part. Coverage applies to the specific component replaced during the repair, and the service desk records the covered part and the coverage period on your invoice at handover.

How do you book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service?

You book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service by describing the fault, requesting a free diagnostic, approving the written quotation, and confirming a collection time. The process moves from fault description to device collection in six steps, and each step produces a written record you keep. Our service center operates in Dhaka and covers customers across Bangladesh, including Gulshan, Banani, Dhanmondi, Uttara, Mirpur, and Mohakhali. Walk-in service runs during business hours, and booking ahead reserves the specific part your repair requires. You back up the device to iCloud or a computer before handover, since board-level and water damage repairs sometimes affect stored data.

The steps to book an iPhone 16 Pro Max repair service are outlined below.

  1. Describe the fault and request a free diagnostic — Report the symptom by phone, message, or in person, and the technician runs Apple Diagnostics to identify the failed component.
  2. Receive a written quotation and turnaround estimate — Review the itemized cost and completion time before you approve any work on your device.
  3. Confirm the replacement part grade — Select new genuine, used genuine, OEM-grade, or certified after-market parts, and the service desk records your choice in writing.
  4. Book a time slot or walk in — Reserve a slot to secure your part in advance, or bring the device directly during business hours for stocked repairs.
  5. Back up the device before handover — Sync your data to iCloud or a computer, and note your Apple ID credentials for post-repair activation.
  6. Collect the device after function testing — Inspect the repaired component, verify the function test results, and receive your warranty invoice at handover.

Your iPhone 16 Pro Max deserves a repair that holds up. Book your free diagnostic today and get a written price before anyone opens your device.

data.title: Fingerprint Issue
data.description:
However, like all the other technical difficulties you may face in your iPhone; your fingerprint/touch-id may cause an error in its operation. The touch ID problem is quite a common problem seen in the iPhone’s list of problems.

The most common issues faced regarding touch ID are:

  • You are asked to enter the passcode to unlock the phone by default instead of Touch ID
  • You can not avail of Apple Payment by touch-ID.
  • Can’t Register Touch ID to set up your fingerprint.
  • Touch ID is grayed or dimmed out.

Apple recommends some fixes you may try in your home which may fix the issue if it is due to a software glitch. Those fixes are:

  • Make sure your hands are clean and dry. Different sorts of moisturizers may affect the workability of your iPhone. (Such as Oil, lotion, sweat, or water)
  • Make sure your iPhone touch ID is clean and wipe it down with a lint-free cloth.
  • Make sure you put your entire finger on the home button to make the sensor work.
  • Make sure your screen protector or case is not getting in the way of touch ID
  • Update your iOS

Also, make sure that Touch ID does not work if you have

  • Restarted your phone

data.description:
The new iPhone 13 Pro Max offers one of the best displays of high DPI. It has also ensured maximum safety for its users by putting gorilla glass in both back and the front. However, not all damage to the display comes from dropping the device from the hands and shattering it. Some users of the iPhone 13 Pro Max have reported a sudden black screen with no prior damage history. The No light on Display issue of the iPhone 13 Pro Max is where the user can’t see what’s happening on the phone. The phone is running okay. The phone vibrates and the user can hear the notification sounds and other inputs. But the problem is they can not see any of it because the phone display is just plain black. The phone will respond or might even have incoming calls.

The key symptoms of the “No light on Display” issues are:

The phone's display boots up with an Apple logo but doesn’t get past the black screen (iPhone 6 – 8Plus) 

The phone has calls and notifications but doesn’t show anything on display

iPhone can charge (you can hear the sound that the phone makes while charging) but won’t show anything on the display

This “No light on display” is usually an internal issue with the LCD connector. However, Apple recommends some processes to practice on your phone to make sure the black screen is not a software glitch.

Force Restart your iPhone. (Press the volume up (+) and volume down (-) and then press and hold the power button until the Apple logo appears on the screen) 

Connect the lightning cable and charge it for 10 minutes. Then try force restarting the iPhone

UNCONVENTIONAL: But press the screen into the phone so it may reconnect to any dislodged LCD connector. This fix is not recommended, however it resolved a lot of the user's Black Display issues. It might be risky for any layman. 

If none of the fixes work to resolve the issue on your iPhone, you may need to get it looked at by experienced professionals who specialize in iPhone issues. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in resolving no light on display issues on your iPhone 13 Pro Max.   • Deformation of the housing
  • Housing breaking into pieces
  • Visible scratches and dents
  • Loosening of the adhesive that holds the housing

An iPhone 11 Pro is IP68 rated, which means it is water- and dustproof. However, it can’t protect your phone from dust and water with damaged housing. And in that sense, the housing of the iPhone 11 Pro serves more purpose than just visual aesthetics.

data.title: Touch Issue
data.description:
The new iPhone 11 offers a haptic touch system instead of a 3D touch system that was available in the previous versions of the iPhones. The new haptic touch does not require assessing the strength of users like it needed to in the 3D touch system. Instead, it measures the area of your fingertips to decide the strength and length of the touch input provided by the user. This haptic touch is also a way to ensure your touch works for a long time. However, you just might face an issue anytime soon on your iPhone 11 regarding your phone’s touch.

The most common issues faced by the users that are reported in the iPhone 11 users community forum are as follows:

  • Too sensitive screen/screen response intermittently (means responses without the user having to input or auto touch)
  • Touchscreen in your iPhone does not respond at all
  • Delayed Touch issue
  • Touch doesn’t respond after dropping from hand. (Everything else seems to work fine)

There are some fixes you might try to see if any of them work for your phone. Those are the following listed below:

  • Make sure your touch screen protector doesn’t interfere with proper operation.
  • Make sure there’s no internal/external damage (cracking or shattering glass)
  • Disconnect your USB-lightning port to check if it works.
  • If your phone is above normal temperature wait for it to cool down and then try again.
  • Restart your device.

If none of the fixes above work for you, you might need to get your iPhone checked by professional technicians. Sometimes when you update your iPhone, or when you try to run your phone you may see some sort of black screen with some sort of Error with a number on your iPhone’s screen out of nowhere. These messages with errors and numbers can be seen while booting up the phone or trying to upgrade the ipsw files from iTunes from a pc. These are Error Codes that indicate to the service technicians that a specific part of the iPhone is malfunctioning. These codes are used by professional repair technicians of iPhones to make their jobs easy.

They do not need to diagnose the entire iPhone when they see the code. Therefore saves both the customer’s and the tech expert’s time and other resources.

Some of the common error codes seen in the iPhones are as follows:

ERROR(9): This code shows when you are trying to upgrade your iOS through PC on iTunes, but the iTunes app shows an Error code-9. It is a relatable problem with iTunes error codes – 4013, 4014, and 4005.

Apple recommends:

To check if your iPhone is updated

To check if the lightning cable works. (Error code 4013,4014 and 4015 usually indicate this issue)

If the update still fails try updating from another pc

Error 1015: This is an issue if you have a jailbroken device (iOS) and apple detects it.

Error 69: This is a common issue found in iPhone X and later devices. This issue suggests that there might be some sort of hardware error on your phone, which is repairable, to say the least.

Aside from these errors, there are a lot of errors that can occur on your iPhone. These are all listed on Apple’s error solution info pages with possible DIY (Do it yourself) solutions.

data.title: Liquid Damage
data.description:
The new iPhone 16e is a standard IP68 rated, dust and water-resistant phone. This means it can resist dust and water coming in up to a certain level. However, it is not completely immune to water getting inside the iPhone and damaging it. Apple has introduced a new technology called LCI. LCI is an abbreviation for liquid contact indicator. It is located in the sim tray region. Now you can see the LCI when you remove the sim tray, buy putting the ejector pin into the sim tray ejection hole.

Once you have removed the sim tray, you should see a white/red portion inside the sim tray region. That is your LCI on the iPhone. If the LCI is completely white or silver then it is okay. The phone hasn’t contacted any water.

However, if your LCI turns red you can safely assume that it has been in touch with water and has taken in some water damage.

If you have dropped your phone in the water here are some basic things you should do:

Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth

You may gently tap the phone with the charger hole against your hand. It may drip the water out if it has gotten in there

NEVER CHARGE YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU HAVE MADE SURE IT IS COMPLETELY DRY

If anything spills on your phone other than water (like oil etc.) just rinse the place with a lint-free cloth

If water has gotten into your phone, it may damage your Battery, Charging port, or give you muffled speakers.

The telephoto lens that powers Portrait Mode wears after 9–10 years. OIS failure, flex cable damage, and direct impact to the camera bump cause blur and Portrait Mode depth failure. iPhone 7 Plus camera repair

data.description:
The new iPhone 12 Pro Max comes with a lightning port which is one of the most important parts of the smartphone. It can be charged with a lightning cable and charges at a whopping 18 Watt (fast charging). This can charge your phone to 50 percent in 30 minutes. And it can also be used as a USB 2.0 port. However, after using the phone for a long time or by an accident; your charging dock of the phone may get faulty or damaged, and you might need to get it replaced.

The most common issues of the iPhone 12 Pro Max charging dock are:

The battery charges very slowly

iPhone 12 Pro Max not charging beyond 80%

Charging Not available or Liquid has been detected in the charging port error

The charging dock can’t be connected to a USB supported device through the lightning cable

If your phone has any one of these issues or something not mentioned in the list of the common issues. You will still like to check out these DIY (Do it yourself) fixes that may solve the problem regarding the charging dock in your iPhone 12 Pro Max.

Make sure you don’t have any debris or dirt on your charging dock. This may prevent charging

Make sure your power outlet isn’t faulty

If your phone is wet, wait until it is dry to charge your phone

Make sure you do not have the “optimized battery charging” option checked on your iPhone 12 Pro Max. if you do have it make sure to disable it to charge your phone past 80%

Disable optimized Charging in here: Settings > Battery > Battery Health.

Note: This option is only available on iOS 13 or later updates.

If none of the fixes cut it for you, you may need to get your phone looked at by professionals. data.title: Network Problem
data.description:
The iPhone 14 comes with upgraded network connectivity compared to previous iPhone models and supports 5G network connectivity. Despite technological advancements from previous iPhone models, users have reported issues regarding the iPhone 14 network connectivity. Such as loss of the network, prompt disconnections, and inability to find or locate the network.

The most common issues, however, are often discussed on Apple’s user forum and the most common problems found regarding networks in iPhone 14 are:

iPhone 14 gets down to 0 network bars randomly

Network quality drops from 4G to 2G/3G

Cannot access metered/Cellular internet connection through Carrier or the SIM Company

Network never reaches the full level

These common issues, however, can be a network receptor hardware glitch of the iPhone 14. To resolve this, Apple recommends its iPhone 14 users some DIY (do it yourself) fixes as a home remedy, such as:

Toggle Airplane Mode on and off to reset the previous network settings and cache

Remove your sim card and reinstall it again. -requires a restart of the device

Set up the internet for your phone if you’re facing internet issues through the network for the first time.

To set it up, go to Settings > Mobile Data > Mobile Data Network.

then:

Insert APN (Access Point Name) provided by your carrier

Insert Username (provided by your carrier)

Insert Password (provided by your carrier)

Save the settings by pressing the left arrow at the top.

Make sure your Data connection is on after setting up the network before you access the internet.

Install carrier update for your iPhone (Check-in Settings > General > About)

Restart your iPhone

Soft reset your iPhone

If none of the solutions work for your iPhone, you might need your phone to be checked by a professional technician. Here at ifixit bd, we have dedicated and experienced technicians who specialize in resolving your network issues with your iPhone 14. ifixit bd has 4 service points which are located in points around Dhaka, Bangladesh.

data.description:
The iPhone SE 2020 comes with upgraded network connectivity than the previous iPhone models and supports 4G network connectivity. Despite these technological advancements from the previous iPhone models, users have reported issues regarding the iPhone SE 2020 network connectivity. Such as loss in the network, prompt disconnections, inability to find or locate the network.

The most common issues however are often discussed upon Apple’s user forum and the most common problems found regarding network in iPhone SE(2) are:

  • iPhone SE(2) gets down to 0 network bars randomly
  • Network quality drops from 4G to 2G/3G.
  • Cannot access metered/Cellular internet connection through Carrier or the SIM Company.
  • Network never reaches the full level.

These common issues however can be a network receptor hardware glitch of the iPhone SE(2). To resolve these Apple recommends its iPhone SE(2) users some DIY (Do it yourself) fixes as a home remedy, such as:

Toggle Airplane Mode on and off to reset the previous network settings and cache.

Remove your sim card and reinstall it again. (requires a restart of the device)

Set up the internet for your phone if you’re facing internet issues through the network for the first time.

To set up go to Settings > Mobile Data > Mobile Data Network

then:

Insert APN (Access Point Name) provided by your carrier 

Insert Username (provided by your carrier)

Insert Password (provided by your carrier)

Save the settings by pressing the left arrow at the top.

Make sure your Data connection is on after setting up the network before you access the internet.

Install carrier update for your iPhone (Check-in Settings > General > About)

Restart your iPhone

Soft reset your iPhone

If none of the solutions work for your iPhone, you might need your phone to get checked by a professional technician. data.description:
The new iPhone 12 Pro Max offers its users better optimization and balance in software than the previous iPhone models. However, no matter hard they try there can always be some technical issues that can result in your iPhone malfunctioning. The Apple logo stuck issue was also found in previous iPhones and it’s a frustrating issue. Your iPhone boots up, but instead of going to the home screen, it is stuck on the boot menu. This problem happens mainly/most of the time because of a software issue that happens due to an unclean or interrupted update.

This Stuck on Apple logo issue might happen in other instances too. Possible reasons might be:

The iPhone has taken in some physical damage. (Dropping from hand)

Update was disrupted due to Wi-Fi disturbance/metered connection or cellular data loss

A third-party app may have access to vital permissions that can disrupt iPhones' productivity

It is rare, however, your phone might be facing a hardware issue. Sometimes faulty hardware prevents the phone from booting up

These issues however can be resolved if it is just a bug or a glitch in the iOS software. You may try the following steps and see if it works for you.

Force Restart your iPhone 12 Pro Max

(Press volume up (+) and then quickly press volume down (-) button and hold the iPhone 12 Pro Max power button as long as the apple logo appears again)

Update your iOS Software.

(If, while in the progress of updating your software, the progress bar under the Apple logo has not moved for an hour, You may connect your iPhone to a PC and select “Update” when prompted)

Remove all third-party apps from your phone. Install Apps only from the Apple App store

Turn off the auto-update of your iOS apps to prevent further interruptions. BUT BE SURE TO UPDATE THEM ON A REGULAR BASIS MANUALLY.

If none of the fixes above work, for you. You might have an issue that needs the touch of a professional iPhone technician. iPhone 12 Pro Max repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone 12 Pro Max fault. The 6.7-inch OLED display, A14 Bionic chip, triple-camera system with LiDAR, MagSafe, and 5G connectivity remain genuinely capable in 2026. We repair cracked OLED screens, failing batteries, Lightning port faults, camera damage, and board-level issues using A-grade and Original parts. Screen replacement starts from ৳7,000, battery from ৳2,000, every repair with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone 12 Pro Max problems we fix?

Battery health below usable levels after 5 years

Five years of daily charge cycles on the iPhone 12 Pro Max significantly reduce cell capacity. Most units in use today have batteries that need replacing — unexpected shutdowns, performance throttling, and inability to last past mid-afternoon are all signs. Battery replacement is the first repair we recommend on any 5-year-old iPhone. iPhone 12 Pro Max battery replacement

Cracked OLED display

The 6.7-inch Super Retina XDR OLED is a large target for drops. OLED cracks and dead pixel columns require full assembly replacement. Note: the iPhone 12 Pro Max uses a flat-edge design with Ceramic Shield glass — tougher than previous glass but not crack-proof. iPhone 12 Pro Max screen replacement

MagSafe back glass cracked — back glass only repair

The glass back on the iPhone 12 Pro Max enables both MagSafe and wireless charging. A drop on the rear cracks this glass and disables MagSafe alignment accuracy and wireless charging efficiency. iFixit BD replaces back glass without requiring full chassis replacement. iPhone 12 Pro Max back glass repair

Triple camera — telephoto blur or LiDAR failure

The 12 Pro Max was the first iPhone with a telephoto camera using sensor-shift OIS. Drops and OIS mechanical failure cause telephoto blur distinct from the main wide camera. LiDAR scanner failure affects AR apps and portrait mode depth. iPhone 12 Pro Max camera repair

Lightning port charging intermittently

At 5 years of age, the Lightning port has had significant wear. Lint compaction and physical connector wear cause intermittent charging. Port cleaning during free diagnosis resolves most cases. iPhone 12 Pro Max charging issues

How does our repair process work?

Step 1 — Free diagnosis. Bring your iPhone 12 Pro Max to any iFixit BD branch. Fault identified, written quote at no cost.

Step 2 — Report and fixed price. Written fault report, fixed price, A-grade and Original side by side.

Step 3 — Confirm and repair. Most repairs same day. Board-level repairs 1–2 days.

Step 4 — Test together and collect with warranty. Full test with you present. Warranty begins from this moment.

iPhone 12 Pro Max repair price list at iFixit BD

All prices include parts and labour. Diagnosis is always free.

Screen replacement (OLED) — A-grade ৳7,000 | Original ৳15,000 | Turnaround: 2–3 hr

Battery replacement — A-grade ৳2,000 | Original ৳3,800 | Turnaround: 45–60 min

Lightning charging port — A-grade ৳1,500 | Original ৳3,000 | Turnaround: 1–2 hr

Wide / telephoto / ultrawide camera — A-grade ৳3,500–4,500 | Original ৳8,000–10,000 | Turnaround: 2–3 hr

Front camera / Face ID sensor — A-grade ৳3,200 | Original ৳7,500 | Turnaround: 2–3 hr

Back glass — A-grade ৳2,800 | Original ৳6,500 | Turnaround: same day

Liquid damage (ultrasonic board clean) — from ৳3,200 | Turnaround: 1–3 days

Logic board repair (micro-soldering) — from ৳5,000 | Turnaround: 1–3 days

Why repair your iPhone 12 Pro Max at iFixit BD?

Free written diagnosis and fixed quote. No cost to inspect, written estimate before work starts.

Board-level micro-soldering lab. A14 component-level repair, ultrasonic cleaning, 18 years experience.

Dual-tier pricing. A-grade and Original prices disclosed before work starts.

Repair warranty. All parts and labour covered at /warranty-policy.

70+ expert technicians, 4 dedicated Dhaka branches, 500,000+ devices repaired.

Is the iPhone 12 Pro Max still worth repairing in 2026?

Yes — iOS 18 support, 5G, LiDAR, and a large OLED display make this worth maintaining.

Battery is the most urgent repair. At 5 years old, most 12 Pro Max batteries need replacing. The cost at ৳2,000–3,800 is minimal relative to the performance improvement.

iOS 18 support continues. The iPhone 12 Pro Max supports iOS 18 and is expected to remain on supported iOS for some time.

Board-level faults assessed honestly. For screens, batteries, cameras, and charging — repair is the clear answer for the iPhone 12 Pro Max in 2026.
